title: The Agentic ETF: How Agentic Trading Becomes an Asset Class
summary: Three structural trends are converging in public markets: the exchange-traded fund (ETF) has become the dominant fund wrapper, actively managed ETFs are the fastest-growing segment within it, and algorithmic systems now mediate the overwhelming majority of trading volume. We argue that their intersection defines a nascent asset class -- the \emph{Agentic ETF}, a fund whose investment process is delegated to autonomous, large-language-model-driven trading agents that reason over data and execute without a human in the loop. We define agentic trading and distinguish it from rule-based algorithmic trading and robo-advice, decompose the agentic-trading infrastructure into six layers, and identify the incumbent players and structural gaps at each layer. We then present ScalarField.io as a reference implementation of an integrated agentic-trading stack -- spanning a unified multi-venue execution registry, isolated strategy agents with continuous broker reconciliation, first-party market data, and metered compute -- and map its primitives to each layer of the stack. A transparent, assumption-stated sizing exercise suggests the Agentic ETF could plausibly reach hundreds of billions to low trillions of dollars in assets under management by 2030.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Agentic ETF"这一新兴资产类别：由LLM驱动的自主交易代理全权管理并执行，无需人类干预。作者定义代理式交易、拆解其六层基础设施、以ScalarField.io为参考实现，并估算其2030年AUM可达数千亿至低万亿量级。
AI.motivation: 公开市场三大结构性趋势正在交汇：ETF已成为主流基金载体，主动管理型ETF是其中增长最快的细分，而算法系统主导了绝大多数交易量。三者交叉处催生了一种新资产类别，值得系统定义与描绘。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建+案例研究：界定代理式交易并与规则型算法交易、智能投顾相区分；将代理式交易基础设施拆解为六层，识别各层现有玩家与结构性缺口；以ScalarField.io为集成式代理交易技术栈的参考实现，将其原语映射到各层。
AI.result: ScalarField.io涵盖统一多场所执行注册表、具持续券商对账的隔离策略代理、第一方市场数据与计量式计算；基于明确假设的规模测算显示，Agentic ETF到2030年AUM可能达数千亿至低万亿美元。
AI.conclusion: Agentic ETF是一种初生的资产类别，其可行性依赖于代理交易技术栈各层的整合与填补；若当前趋势延续，其规模潜力巨大，但仍属前瞻性推测。

title: When the Rule-Maker Runs the World Championship: Late Patches and Procedural Accountability in League of Legends
summary: Riot Games, which runs the League of Legends World Championship (Worlds), also changes the game shortly before each tournament. This concentration of authority raises a governance question: Who scrutinizes how the benefits and burdens of late rule changes are distributed? We examine all ten championships from 2016 to 2025, combining 1,097 games, 215 team-years, and LLM coding of 1,090 champion changes across 40 patches. On average, 33% of a team's prior picks were on champions with net nerfs in the patches it had not played before Worlds, and 8% were on champions with net buffs. Within a year, the median gap between the most and least affected teams was 23 percentage points for nerfed picks and 12 for buffed picks. Nerfs fell mainly on the most-contested champions and buffs on less-contested ones, as Riot's published balancing criteria anticipate. Pools concentrated on the prevailing meta therefore had more negative net exposure, and even the winners of a year's four major regional leagues differed in net exposure about as much as four randomly drawn teams. Higher buff exposure was associated with additional opponent bans on buffed champions, although its size depends on the model. Among quarterfinalists, the most buff-exposed team of each year reached six of ten finals and won four titles. The team with the most negative net exposure reached two finals and won one. These exploratory descriptions identify unequal exposure, not causal gains or losses. The association between net exposure and winning remains uncertain, at +1.3 percentage points per standard deviation with a 95% interval from -0.9 to +3.7. We argue that scrutiny of late rulemaking should not depend on proving that a patch changed who won Worlds. Earlier patch commitments, team-level impact disclosure, independent review, and a formal opportunity to challenge decisions would make publisher authority more accountable.

AI.tldr: 本文分析2016-2025年英雄联盟全球总决赛前补丁改动对战队的影响分配，发现各队受削弱/增强影响不均，但这种"暴露度"与夺冠的因果关系仍不确定，因此主张对后期规则制定的问责不应依赖证明补丁改变了胜负。
AI.motivation: Riot Games在每届世界赛前集中修改游戏，这种权力集中引发治理问题：谁在审查后期规则改动所带来的收益与负担如何分配？作者希望将治理问责与"补丁是否改变冠军归属"这一因果难题脱钩。
AI.method: 研究全部十届赛事（2016-2025），整合1,097场比赛、215个战队年，并用LLM对40个补丁中的1,090项英雄改动进行编码，衡量各队既有英雄池在赛前补丁中的净增强/削弱暴露度，并做描述性与关联性分析。
AI.result: 平均33%的既有选人属于遭受净削弱的英雄，8%属于净增强英雄；同一年内最受影响与最不受影响队伍的中位差距为削弱23个百分点、增强12个百分点。削弱集中于高争夺度英雄、增强集中于低争夺度英雄。即使四大区域联赛冠军之间的暴露度差异也与随机抽取的四队相当。增强暴露度较高与对手对被增强英雄的额外禁用相关。暴露度与胜负的关联不确定（每标准差+1.3个百分点，95%区间-0.9至+3.7）。
AI.conclusion: 这些探索性结果揭示的是暴露不均，而非因果得失。作者主张：对后期规则制定的审查不应以证明补丁改变冠军为前提；应通过提前公布补丁承诺、战队层面的影响披露、独立审查及正式的申诉机会，使发行商权力更具可问责性。

title: Dynamic Modeling, Efficiency Analysis, and Hierarchical Control of Industrial Airborne Pulp Dryers
summary: A first-principles dynamic modeling and control framework for industrial airborne pulp dryers is presented. The proposed nonlinear model integrates airflow, pressure, moisture, psychrometric, heat-transfer, and fan electromechanical dynamics within a unified state-space formulation. An efficiency analysis framework incorporating overall efficiency, thermal efficiency, fan efficiency, and specific moisture evaporation ratio (SMER) is also developed. To enhance process performance, a hierarchical DSM-based control architecture combining cascade and non-cascade control loops with supervisory optimization is proposed. The model was implemented in MATLAB/Simulink and evaluated under thermal, compositional, hydraulic, and mechanical disturbances. Simulation results demonstrated accurate moisture regulation, effective disturbance rejection, and favorable energetic performance, achieving an overall efficiency of 85.8%, a thermal efficiency of 86.9%, and an average SMER of 1.39 kg/kWh. To the best of the authors' knowledge, this work represents one of the first comprehensive dynamic modeling and control studies of industrial airborne pulp dryers and provides a proof-of-concept platform for future digital-twin, advanced control, and energy-optimization applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出工业气流纸浆干燥机的第一性原理动态建模与控制框架，集成多物理场状态空间模型与层级DSM控制架构，实现精确水分调节与高效能表现。
AI.motivation: 工业气流纸浆干燥机缺乏综合的动态建模与控制研究，需要一个概念验证平台以支持未来数字孪生、先进控制与能源优化应用。
AI.method: 构建统一状态空间非线性模型，集成气流、压力、水分、湿度学、传热与风机机电动态；建立包含整体效率、热效率、风机效率及SMER的效率分析框架；提出基于DSM的层级控制架构，结合串级与非串级回路及监督优化，并在MATLAB/Simulink中实现与测试。
AI.result: 在热、组分、水力与机械扰动下，模型实现精确水分调节与有效扰动抑制，整体效率85.8%、热效率86.9%、平均SMER为1.39 kg/kWh。
AI.conclusion: 这是首批针对工业气流纸浆干燥机的综合动态建模与控制研究之一，为数字孪生、先进控制与能源优化提供概念验证平台。

title: Memory Prediction Excess: A Probabilistic Quantity for Predictive Gain and Memory Length in Stochastic Processes
summary: A central question in the prediction of stochastic processes is the extent to which past information can improve the probability of correctly predicting the next state. We introduce the Memory Prediction Excess (MPE) to address this question quantitatively. The MPE measures the average improvement in prediction accuracy obtained by using the entire observed history relative to using only the static marginal distribution, in discrete-time finite-state processes. It is defined as the difference between the expected optimal conditional prediction accuracy and the optimal static prediction accuracy. Its basic properties are examined: the MPE is always non-negative; it admits an upper bound depending on the static accuracy, attained if and only if the future is almost surely a deterministic function of the past; and degenerate cases in which the MPE vanishes are characterized. A normalized version, taking values in the unit interval, is introduced as a dimensionless measure of predictive efficiency. A lower bound is derived by comparing predictions based on histories of different lengths, showing that the expected optimal prediction accuracy is monotone with respect to the history length. The framework is extended to finite-length histories, where the finite-history MPE (FH-MPE) measures the predictive gain attainable when only the most recent observations are retained. This leads to the notion of a minimal memory length required to achieve the same predictive performance as the full history. For finite-order Markov chains, this minimal memory length is shown to be bounded by the Markov order. The MPE and its variants are formulated in terms of conditional probabilities and prediction accuracies, offering a probabilistic perspective on the predictive utility of memory that is complementary to classical information-theoretic approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出"记忆预测增益"(MPE)量化历史信息对预测的改进，并给出性质、归一化、下界及有限记忆扩展。
AI.motivation: 核心问题：随机过程预测中，历史信息能在多大程度上提升正确预测下一状态的概率？需要一个定量的度量来刻画记忆的预测效用。
AI.method: 在离散时间有限状态过程中定义MPE，即最优条件预测精度与最优静态预测精度之差。考察其基本性质，引入归一化版本，通过比较不同长度历史的预测导出下界，并扩展至有限历史情形(FH-MPE)与最小记忆长度概念。
AI.result: MPE非负；上界依赖静态精度，当且仅当未来几乎必然为过去的确定性函数时取到；刻画了MPE退化(消失)的情形；导出归一化度量与基于历史长度的下界，证明期望最优预测精度对历史长度单调；有限阶马尔可夫链的最小记忆长度被马尔可夫阶数所界定。
AI.conclusion: MPE及变体以条件概率与预测精度表述，为记忆的预测效用提供了一种互补于经典信息论方法的概率视角。

title: A Finite Bid--Ask Spread from Replenishment Displaced from the Quote
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Reproducibility code and computational supplement: https://github.com/timgebbie/two-field-spread-reproducibility
summary: We give a unified analytic account of a finite bid--ask spread in a two-field reaction--diffusion order book. The model retains separate bid and ask densities in operational time, with diffusion, cancellation, reaction and external order creation. On the symmetric equal-coefficient branch, the imbalance field determines the reaction price, while the total standing density carries the spread geometry. A market-making source is introduced by withholding order placement over a finite interval around the reaction boundary, representing round-trip replenishment displaced from the quote. Under a separated, quasistationary and weak-overlap approximation, transport penetrates inward from the placement edges over the cancellation length, giving the quoted spread as the sub-threshold core of the placement-source-free interval. Market orders remove standing density at the observed quote, whereas replenishment is delivered outside it and must diffuse back across the penetration depth. We derive the resulting delayed and attenuated quote-level response in operational time. On that branch, finite spread and price impact arise from distinct response sectors, while their calendar-time appearance requires a separate observation clock.

AI.tldr: 该文用双场反应扩散订单簿模型，统一解析了有限买卖价差：做市源在反应边界附近留空，使报价内出现子阈值核心区，形成价差，并推导出延迟衰减的报价响应。
AI.motivation: 希望统一解释订单簿中有限买卖价差的形成机制，区分价差与价格冲击的不同来源，并说明它们在操作时间与日历时间中的表现差异。
AI.method: 建立含买、卖两个密度的反应扩散订单簿；采用对称等系数分支，用失衡场决定反应价格、总密度决定价差几何；引入做市源在反应边界附近有限区间内撤单，并用分离、准静态、弱重叠近似推导运输与穿透长度。
AI.result: 在放置源缺失区间的子阈值核心处得到报价价差；市价单移除报价处存量，补单在报价外送达并需扩散回穿穿透深度，由此得到操作时间中延迟且衰减的报价层响应。
AI.conclusion: 在该分支上，有限价差与价格冲击来自不同的响应部门；它们在日历时间中的显现需要单独的观察时钟。

title: Can Power Draw Constrain Covert Compute? Limits of Analogue Verification for AI Governance
summary: Frontier AI treaties or agreements on limiting computation require external verification; an external auditor must be able to confirm how much computation actually ran and that parties are adhering to the agreement. Analogue, off-chip measurements such as power draw provide an information channel for verification. It is unknown how well these analogue channels can constrain computation against an adversary who actively tries to subvert the audit. We derive a closed form for $β$, the largest hidden computation a power trace cannot exclude, as a fraction of the declared machine capacity. Measurements on NVIDIA A100 GPUs constrain $β= 1.16$ in the worst case, while adversarial matched-energy strategies are shown to hide at least $β= 0.41$ of compute. Analogue power measurements alone therefore constrain compute weakly. Additional restrictions granted by the threat model, such as the ability of the verifier to re-execute the declared work at an observed operating point, let the verifier push $β$ down to $0.059$ in the maximally restricted case. This gives a quantitative estimate of what analogue measurements can contribute to compute verification.

AI.tldr: 本文研究前沿AI协议中基于功耗等模拟信号验证算力的可行性，推导出隐藏算力上限β的闭式解。
AI.motivation: 限制算力的AI条约或协议需要外部验证，审计方须确认实际运行的算力并核实各方是否遵守协议。功耗等片上外的模拟测量提供了验证信息渠道，但尚不清楚在对手主动破坏审计时这些模拟渠道能多好地约束算力。
AI.method: 推导β的闭式解——即功耗轨迹无法排除的最大隐藏算力占声明机器容量的比例；在NVIDIA A100 GPU上进行测量；并分析对抗性的能量匹配策略。
AI.result: A100测量在 worst case 下约束β=1.16，而对抗性能量匹配策略至少可隐藏β=0.41的算力。因此单靠模拟功耗测量对算力的约束很弱。在威胁模型允许的额外限制（如验证方可在观测工作点重执行声明工作）下，最大受限情形可将β降至0.059。
AI.conclusion: 该工作定量估计了模拟测量对算力验证的贡献，表明仅靠功耗测量约束力弱，但结合重执行等额外限制可显著提升验证能力。

title: Model Predictive Control for Safety-Critical Systems Using Taylor's Theorem with Lagrange Remainder
summary: Safety-critical Model Predictive Control (MPC) formulations based on Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) often require multiple tuning parameters and may become conservative or difficult to keep feasible, particularly for high-relative-degree constraints. To address these limitations, in this paper we draw inspiration from the recently introduced Taylor-Lagrange Control (TLC) method, and propose an MPC formulation based on a Taylor expansion with Lagrange remainder (MPC-TLR). To enable digital implementation, we develop a numerical approximation of the Lagrange remainder under zero-order-hold control. The resulting safety constraint includes a tunable margin to account for approximation errors and balance safety, feasibility, and conservativeness. Comparisons with MPC using high-order CBFs (MPC-HOCBF), discrete-time high-order CBFs (MPC-DHOCBF), and direct safety constraints (MPC-DC) on a unicycle obstacle-avoidance problem show that MPC-TLR yields safer trajectories than MPC-DHOCBF and MPC-DC, while requiring fewer tuning parameters and being less conservative than MPC-HOCBF. Its broader control-input coverage under the adopted discretization can improve feasibility and control performance for short prediction horizons.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于泰勒展开与拉格朗日余项的MPC公式(MPC-TLR),借鉴TLC方法,用零阶保持下的数值近似拉格朗日余项,并以可调裕度平衡安全性、可行性与保守性,在独轮车避障任务上验证优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 基于控制障碍函数(CBF)的安全关键MPC通常需要多个调参参数,对高阶相对度约束易保守且难以保持可行性。本文旨在解决这些局限。
AI.method: 受Taylor-Lagrange Control启发,提出基于泰勒展开加 Lagrange 余项的MPC公式(MPC-TLR);针对数字实现,给出零阶保持控制下Lagrange余项的数值近似;所得安全约束含可调裕度以补偿近似误差。
AI.result: 在独轮车避障问题上,与MPC-HOCBF、MPC-DHOCBF及直接安全约束(MPC-DC)相比,MPC-TLR轨迹比MPC-DHOCBF和MPC-DC更安全,调参更少,且比MPC-HOCBF更不保守;其离散化下更广的控制输入覆盖可在短预测时域内提升可行性与控制性能。
AI.conclusion: MPC-TLR以更少调参实现更安全、更低保守性的安全关键MPC,尤其适用于高阶相对度约束与短预测时域场景。

title: Low-Rank and Structured Sparse Tensor Decomposition for Anomaly Detection in Multivariate Functional Data
summary: Multivariate functional data arise in many modern manufacturing systems, where multiple sensors record densely sampled process trajectories. Monitoring such data is challenging because nominal variation is strongly correlated across samples, sensors, and time, while faults may appear either as isolated deviations or as structured departures concentrated within a limited number of sensor-specific temporal trajectories. We propose two unsupervised sparse tensor decomposition methods that preserve this multimode structure. Entrywise Sparse CP Decomposition (ES-CP) uses an entrywise \(\ell_1\) penalty to identify localized anomalies, whereas Fiberwise Sparse-Group Lasso CP Decomposition (FG-Lasso) combines entrywise and fiberwise penalties to detect both localized deviations and anomalies concentrated within temporal fibers. Both methods represent nominal process behavior through a low-rank CP decomposition and are estimated using alternating optimization with closed-form sparse-component updates. Two simulation studies evaluate performance under different fault structures, signal severities, noise levels, and missing observations. FG-Lasso attains or ties the highest macro F$_1$ score in almost all settings in the first study and achieves the highest macro F$_1$ score. In a multichannel forging-process case study, FG-Lasso and ES-CP obtain macro F$_1$ scores of 0.85 and 0.82, respectively, compared with 0.69 or lower for TRPCA and PCA-based anomaly detectors. The results demonstrate that explicitly matching the sparse penalty to the anticipated fault structure improves both anomaly detection and fault localization in high-dimensional functional processes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出两种无监督稀疏张量分解方法（ES-CP与FG-Lasso），用于多变量函数型数据的异常检测与故障定位，实验证明FG-Lasso表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 现代制造系统中多传感器采集的函数型数据具有跨样本、传感器、时间的强相关性，故障可能表现为孤立偏差或集中于特定传感器时间轨迹的结构化异常，现有方法难以同时刻画多模态结构与两类故障。
AI.method: 提出ES-CP（逐元素ℓ1惩罚，检测局部异常）和FG-Lasso（结合逐元素与fiberwise稀疏组lasso惩罚，同时检测局部偏差与时间纤维内异常）；两者均以低秩CP分解建模正常行为，采用交替优化与闭式稀疏更新求解。
AI.result: 两组仿真在不同故障结构、信号强度、噪声与缺失下评估，FG-Lasso几乎在所有设置中取得最高或并列最高的宏观F1；锻造过程案例中FG-Lasso与ES-CP的宏观F1为0.85和0.82，显著优于TRPCA和PCA类方法（≤0.69）。
AI.conclusion: 将稀疏惩罚与预期故障结构显式匹配，可有效提升高维函数型过程中的异常检测与故障定位性能。

title: Modelling Regime Shifts in Continuous Intraday Electricity Markets with State-dependent Hawkes Processes
summary: The growing importance of intraday trading in Europe, driven by the increasing penetration of renewable energy sources, has led to higher volatility and periods of market stress. Understanding how order flow behaves under varying liquidity conditions requires models that adapt to the state of the market. This paper proposes a multivariate state-dependent Hawkes process to model the flow of orders across different liquidity regimes in the intraday continuous electricity market. The observed market states are identified using a proposed Liquidity Stress Index (LSI), which quantifies stress using the bid-ask spread in the limit order book, order book volume, and mid-price volatility. Transitions between states induce changes in the intensity parameters, resulting in piecewise dynamics that reflect regime-specific order-flow behavior. The model is calibrated on January-March 2024 Dutch intraday continuous cross-border intraday (XBID) hourly order data from EPEX SPOT. The estimated dynamics show that order flow is strongly self-exciting and near-critical, that executed trades trigger new same-side orders while the reverse effect is negligible, and that liquidity stress mainly strengthens transaction self-excitation rather than reshaping the cross-side structure. Robustness checks over the LSI composition and the state partition show that the results are driven by the regime construction itself: alternative index compositions fit within a narrow band, three states fit better than two, and removing the states clearly degrades the fit relative to a single-regime Hawkes benchmark. The results highlight both the value of conditioning order-flow models on liquidity stress and the limits of a single-exponential specification when event frequencies are highly imbalanced.

AI.tldr: 本文提出状态依赖的多元Hawkes过程，用流动性压力指数(LSI)划分日内电力市场的流动性状态，建模不同状态下的订单流动态，并在荷兰XBID数据上验证了状态构建的有效性。
AI.motivation: 欧洲日内电力市场中可再生能源渗透率上升，导致波动性和市场压力上升，订单流行为随流动性状态变化，需能随市场状态自适应的模型。
AI.method: 构建多元状态依赖Hawkes过程，用基于买卖价差、订单簿量和中间价波动率的LSI识别市场状态；状态转移改变强度参数形成分段动态；在2024年1-3月EPEX SPOT荷兰XBID小时订单数据上校准，并做LSI构成与状态划分的稳健性检验。
AI.result: 订单流强自激且接近临界；成交触发同侧新订单，反向效应可忽略；流动性压力主要增强交易自激而非改变跨侧结构。三状态优于两状态，LSI不同构成差异小，去掉状态相比单状态基准拟合明显变差。
AI.conclusion: 将订单流模型以流动性压力为条件有重要价值；单一指数设定在事件频率高度不均衡时存在局限。

title: From Algorithmic Marginalization to AI-Mediated Re-Centering: Can Culturally Grounded AI Bring Hakka Language and Culture Back into Mainstream Society?
comment: 16 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Research Note. A version is forthcoming in the GHAS Newsletter, Consortium of Global Hakka Studies (GHAS)
summary: As large language models increasingly mediate writing, translation, information retrieval, and education, the technological support available to a language may influence its position in contemporary social life. For minority and minoritized languages, this raises a dual problem: inadequate functionality can encourage movement toward dominant languages, while apparently fluent assistance can normalize culturally distinctive expression. This conceptual Research Note develops a framework connecting algorithmic cultural marginalization, cultural grounding, and AI-mediated cultural re-centering. Algorithmic cultural marginalization describes the interaction of representational asymmetry, functional exclusion, homogenizing transformation, and recursive feedback. Cultural grounding identifies interventions across resources, models, services, and governance. Cultural re-centering concerns changes in accessibility, actual language use, public visibility, participation, and the circulation of new knowledge. Drawing on research on language shift and language technologies, the paper uses Hakka in Taiwan as an illustrative case and develops eight propositions for subsequent empirical investigation. Its central argument is that expanded AI access should be assessed alongside the retention of linguistic variation and community authority. The framework distinguishes technological availability from social use, and factual accuracy from cultural fidelity, without assuming that AI can substitute for intergenerational transmission. It provides a basis for investigating whether minority-language AI expands meaningful domains of use or reproduces linguistic marginalization through convenience and standardization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个概念框架，连接"算法文化边缘化""文化基础化"与"AI中介的文化再中心化"，以台湾客家话为例，提出8个命题，主张AI普及应与语言变异保留及社群权威并行评估。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益介入写作、翻译、检索与教育，技术支持的强弱可能影响语言的社会地位。对少数族群语言而言存在双重困境：功能不足会推动使用者转向主流语言，而看似流利的AI辅助又可能将独特的文化表达标准化、同质化。
AI.method: 这是一篇概念性研究笔记。作者构建理论框架：算法文化边缘化（表征不对称、功能排斥、同质化转换、递归反馈四者交互）、文化基础化（资源、模型、服务、治理四层干预）、文化再中心化（可及性、实际使用、公共可见度、参与、新知识流通的变化）。结合语言转用与语言技术研究，以台湾客家话为说明性案例，形成8个待检验命题。
AI.result: 论文为后续实证研究提供了概念工具与8项命题，但作为概念性研究，未报告实证数据或量化结果。
AI.conclusion: 核心论点是：AI可及性的扩张应与语言变异的保留和社群权威的维护一同评估。框架区分了技术可用性与社会使用、事实准确性与文化忠实性，并不假设AI能替代代际传承。它为研究"少数族群语言AI究竟拓展了有意义的语用领域，还是通过便利与标准化复制语言边缘化"提供了基础。

title: Frequency-Dependent Breakdown of Litz-Wire Insulation Under Repetitive Bipolar Square-Wave Voltages
summary: This paper investigates the dielectric breakdown behavior of Litz wire insulation subjected to repetitive fast-edge bipolar square-wave voltages representative of wide-bandgap (WBG) power converter stress. Two conductor sizes, 14 AWG and 16 AWG, were tested in a twisted-pair configuration over frequencies ranging from 1 kHz to 30 kHz using a controlled high-voltage pulse generator with 200 ns rise time. The breakdown voltages obtained at each frequency were statistically analyzed using the weighted two-parameter Weibull method in accordance with IEEE Std 930-2004. Between 1 and 30 kHz, the mean breakdown voltage decreases by approximately 10.7% for the 14 AWG construction and 20.0% for the 16 AWG construction. The 14 AWG specimens exhibit a modest increase between 1 and 5 kHz followed by a decline, whereas the 16 AWG mean decreases across the tested frequencies. The Weibull shape parameter varies nonmonotonically with frequency, characterizing differences in the dispersion of the measured breakdown voltages. These findings provide construction-specific breakdown data relevant to Litz-wire insulation assessment in high-frequency power electronic applications. Possible contributions from charge accumulation, localized discharge activity, and dielectric heating are discussed, but were not directly verified in this study.

AI.tldr: 研究宽带隙变流器应力下利兹线绝缘在快速边沿双极性方波电压下随频率的击穿行为。
AI.motivation: 宽带隙功率变流器带来高频、快速边沿电压应力，利兹线绝缘在高频下的击穿特性尚缺乏针对不同线径的数据参考。
AI.method: 对14 AWG与16 AWG利兹线，采用绞线对配置，在1 kHz–30 kHz、200 ns上升沿的可控高压脉冲发生器下测试，并用IEEE Std 930-2004加权的两参数Weibull方法统计分析击穿电压。
AI.result: 1–30 kHz间平均击穿电压14 AWG下降约10.7%、16 AWG下降约20.0%；14 AWG在1–5 kHz略有上升后下降，16 AWG则全程下降。Weibull形状参数随频率非单调变化。
AI.conclusion: 提供了针对具体线径结构的利兹线绝缘击穿数据，服务于高频电力电子应用评估；电荷积累、局部放电和介质发热的可能贡献仅为讨论，未直接验证。

title: Data Fusion for Errors-in-Variables
summary: We study errors-in-variables problems in which a target study contains only a single error-prone surrogate of an unobserved exposure, while an external source study provides repeated surrogate measurements from a different population. The measurement error distribution is allowed to depend on the observed error-free variables, and the error-free variable distribution itself may differ between studies. We introduce a conditional transportability assumption that enables the use of external repeated measurements under source-target heterogeneity. Together with additional replicate-error conditions, it identifies the target conditional measurement-error distribution. Building on this identification result, we develop a data-fusion estimator for a broad class of target functionals. The estimator combines conditional deconvolution, flexible nuisance estimation, and orthogonal correction that reduces first-order sensitivity to nuisance estimation. For the proposed estimator, we develop a unified spectral theory covering both diffuse-spectrum and finite atomic-spectrum target functionals, derive a general asymptotic expansion, and establish consistency and target-specific convergence-rate bounds. The resulting convergence-rate bounds depend jointly on the spectral properties of the measurement error, the latent exposure, and the target functional. For finite atomic-spectrum targets, we further establish joint Gaussian and bootstrap limits, yielding inference for smooth moment transformations under an additional centering condition. In the reported simulations, Fuse-EIV has small bias for the primary exposure-related coefficient. Applications to the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey illustrate how accounting for population heterogeneity and error heteroscedasticity can change empirical conclusions.

AI.tldr: 该文研究目标研究中仅有单一易错替代变量、外部研究提供重复替代测量但总体异质时的变量误差问题，提出条件可迁移性假设实现测量误差分布识别，并构建数据融合估计器Fuse-EIV，建立谱理论、渐近展开与收敛率界限。
AI.motivation: 目标研究通常只有一个易错的暴露替代变量，缺乏重复测量，而外部数据源虽含重复测量却来自不同总体、误差分布也可能异质。现有方法难以在源-目标总体异质下借用外部数据识别目标总体的测量误差分布并做有效估计。
AI.method: 提出条件可迁移性假设，结合重复误差条件识别目标条件测量误差分布；基于该识别结果构建Fuse-EIV数据融合估计器，融合条件反卷积、灵活冗余参数估计与正交修正以降低一阶敏感度。针对弥散谱与有限原子谱目标泛函建立统一谱理论、一般渐近展开，并给出相合性与目标特定的收敛率界限。
AI.result: 给出依赖测量误差、潜在暴露与目标泛函三者谱性质的联合收敛率界限；对有限原子谱目标建立联合高斯与自助极限，在额外中心化条件下实现光滑矩变换的推断；模拟显示Fuse-EIV对主要暴露相关系数偏差较小；NHANES应用表明考虑总体异质性与误差异方差会改变实证结论。
AI.conclusion: 条件可迁移性使外部重复测量可在源-目标异质性下被借用并识别目标误差分布；Fuse-EIV及其谱理论为单一替代变量情形提供了具有正交性和收敛率保证的半参数推断框架，并揭示异质性与异方差对实证结论的实质影响。

title: Online Sign Language Interpretation System
comment: This is a public release of a study carried out in 2002-2003, originally in French for archival and historical purposes about the evolution of sign language support by information technologies. The translation was supported by AI (Claude) and checked by the original first author
summary:
The Walloon Region commissioned this study to improve deaf people's access to public services for the new millennium. It focuses on sign language users, about 25,000 adults in the French-speaking Community, for whom written French is close to a foreign language. The core problem is a severe shortage of interpreters: only about twenty work in French-speaking Belgium, so appointments take weeks to arrange and emergencies cannot be covered.
  The study assessed three options. The recommended one, remote video interpretation, could be deployed at the time of writing: a professional interpreter joins the deaf person and the employee by videoconference, saving travel time and enabling an emergency service. Similar services already ran in Sweden, Finland, the Netherlands and France. Prototype tests in May 2003 were a clear success and showed that interpretation needs at least CIF video above 256 kbps, ideally 384 kbps. The system suits simple administrative tasks better than emotional, medical or legal situations.
  The second option, fully automated interpretation, was not yet feasible, although partial systems using speech recognition and signing avatars could already serve kiosks, websites and routine procedures.
  The third option looks further ahead: UMTS and WiFi could eventually support mobile signed video calls and remote interpretation, provided quality of service is guaranteed.
  The main recommendation is a first pilot in real conditions before any wide rollout, supported by high-bandwidth links as part of e-government modernisation. The system is meant to relieve interpreters, not replace them, so their training, status and numbers should improve. The authors also call for digital training for deaf people, awareness among public-service staff, more sign language content online, and a multidisciplinary avatar project with Belgian, French and European partners.

AI.tldr: 瓦隆地区委托研究如何提升聋人接入公共服务，提出以远程视频手语口译为推荐方案，并建议先试点再推广。
AI.motivation: 法语区约2.5万成年手语使用者视书面法语近似外语，而比利时法语区手语译员仅约20人，预约需数周、紧急情况无法覆盖，故需改善公共服务可及性。
AI.method: 评估三种方案：远程视频口译（当时可部署，瑞/芬/荷/法已有类似服务，2003年5月原型测试成功，需≥CIF 256kbps、理想384kbps）、全自动口译（尚不可行，但语音识别与手语虚拟人可用于自助终端/网站/常规流程）、UMTS与WiFi支持的移动手语视频通话（更远期，需保障服务质量）。
AI.result: 远程视频口译原型测试明确成功，适合简单行政事务，优于情感、医疗或法律情境；全自动方案尚不可行；移动方案待技术成熟。
AI.conclusion: 建议先在真实条件下试点再广泛推广，依托高带宽链路作为电子政务现代化一部分；系统旨在减轻而非取代译员，应提升其培训、地位与人数，并推动聋人数字培训、公务员意识、在线手语内容及比法欧合作虚拟人项目。

title: Interleaved Projected Gradient Descent for Safe Imitation Learning
comment: Submitted to the 2027 American Control Conference (ACC). 9 pages, 3 figures
summary: We propose an imitation-learning design for neural-network control policies under state and input constraints. Training alternates a standard imitation gradient step with a block of $k$ safety steps that pull the network's actions toward their projection onto the safe set; at run time, the controller is the trained network alone, with no safety filter. We analyze this scheme as inexact projected gradient descent in the space of policy actions. When the projected actions are recomputed at every safety step and each step moves the actions consistently toward the safe set, letting $k$ grow logarithmically yields asymptotic constraint satisfaction on the training states and bounds the distance to the constrained optimum of the imitation loss; with the projected actions held fixed, the same holds only if they are exactly representable by the network. On a nonlinear autonomous racing task, we compare our method with adding a weighted constraint-violation penalty to the imitation loss. With a sufficiently large weight, our method matches the lap time of unconstrained imitation while reducing the fraction of violating episodes from $15\%$ to $1\%$, about six times fewer than the penalty approach at its best weight. Its lap times are less sensitive to the weight, which instead sets how quickly violations vanish during training. In racing, the safety corrections are sparse and the conditions of the analysis do not hold; the gain arises instead through the data collected during training. These gains come at the cost of additional training computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合安全性投影的模仿学习训练方案，用于带状态和输入约束的神经网络控制策略，训练时交替进行模仿梯度步和k步安全投影步，运行时仅使用训练好的网络。理论分析表明，k对数增长可实现渐近约束满足，竞速任务上把违规率从15%降至1%。
AI.motivation: 在状态和输入约束下训练神经网络控制策略时，需兼顾模仿学习性能与安全性。传统做法是加入约束违反惩罚项，但其权重敏感且效果有限，作者希望找到一种更稳健、约束满足更好的训练方法。
AI.method: 提出模仿学习设计：训练交替执行标准模仿梯度步与k步安全步，将网络动作拉向安全集投影；运行时控制器仅用网络，不设安全滤波器。将该方案分析为动作空间中的非精确投影梯度下降。两种变体：投影动作每步重算并一致朝安全集移动；或投影动作固定不变。
AI.result: 理论：投影动作每步重算且一致朝安全集移动时，k对数增长可对训练状态渐近满足约束并约束到模仿损失约束最优的距离；投影动作固定时，仅当网络能精确表示投影才成立。非线性自主竞速任务：足够大权重下，方法匹配无约束模仿的圈速，违规episode比例由15%降至1%，约为惩罚方法最佳权重的六分之一；圈速对权重较不敏感，权重主要控制违规消失速度。竞速中安全修正稀疏，分析条件并不成立，增益来自训练数据；代价是额外训练计算。
AI.conclusion: 该训练方案在竞速任务上以额外训练计算为代价，显著减少违规且圈速接近无约束模仿，比惩罚方法更稳健；但实际增益机制与理论分析条件不完全一致，主要来自训练中采集的数据。

title: sHAIL-Causal: A Sequential Staircase Procedure for Invariant Causal Predictor Discovery
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Introduces the general sHAIL learning framework and its causal specialization
summary: We introduce sHAIL-Causal, the causal specialization of the Saturated Hierarchical Atomic Incremental Learning (sHAIL) paradigm: a sequential staircase procedure that ascends a nested hierarchy of hypothesis classes H_0 < H_1 < ... < H_K once a saturation signal indicates that mastery of the current stage has plateaued. Where general sHAIL leaves the saturation criterion open, sHAIL-Causal instantiates it with a joint criterion of goodness-of-fit saturation and cross-environment invariance, replacing the complexity control of Structural Risk Minimization. We show, theoretically and by simulation, that complexity-only staircases are seduced by confounded predictors that lower empirical risk without reflecting stable causal structure, whereas an invariance-gated staircase provably halts at the true causal predictor set under a per-variable Richness condition. We show that naive greedy search fails to recover the causal set even under Richness, trace the failure to non-monotonicity of the invariance statistic along single-variable paths, and validate a fix combining bounded-exhaustive block-seeding with a calibrated acceptance threshold. We then extend the guarantee to environments arriving sequentially, yielding a confidence guarantee that stays valid at every arrival, which one-shot exhaustive search cannot offer without repeating its full combinatorial search. We close by formalizing the intervention of a wise teacher who lifts a saturated learner off a plateau of boredom.

AI.tldr: 提出sHAIL-Causal，用"拟合优度饱和+跨环境不变性"联合准则替代SRM的复杂度控制，证明不变性门控的阶梯搜索能停在真实因果预测集，并扩展到序贯到达环境与教师干预。
AI.motivation: 通用sHAIL仅用复杂度/拟合优度的饱和信号来爬升嵌套假设类阶梯，容易被"混淆预测子"诱惑：这些预测子能降低经验风险却不反映稳定因果结构。作者希望为因果学习提供原则性的阶段晋升准则，从而恢复真正的因果预测集。
AI.method: 将sHAIL因果特化：在嵌套假设类H_0<...<H_K上序贯爬升，用拟合优度饱和与跨环境不变性的联合准则作为门控；理论上在逐变量"Richness"条件下分析不变性门控阶梯的停止点；指出沿单变量路径不变性统计量非单调导致朴素贪心搜索失败，并提出"有界穷举块播种+标定接受阈值"的修正；进一步扩展到环境序贯到达的情形，给出每次到达都有效的置信保证；最后形式化"智慧教师"对饱和学习者的干预。
AI.result: 理论与仿真表明：仅靠复杂度的阶梯会选中混淆预测子；不变性门控的阶梯在Richness条件下可证明停在真实因果预测集；朴素贪心即使满足Richness也失败，其根源是不变性统计量的非单调性；所提修正（块播种+标定阈值）有效；序贯扩展给出每个到达时刻都成立的置信保证，而单次穷举搜索无法在不重复组合搜索的情况下做到。
AI.conclusion: 把不变性作为阶梯晋升的门控而非仅用复杂度控制，是实现可靠因果发现的关键；序贯不变性保证优于一次性穷举，教师干预为跳出饱和平台提供了形式化途径。

title: FactorBench: A Portfolio-Aware Benchmark for Automated Factor Mining
summary: Factor mining seeks to discover signals from financial data that predict future asset returns and guide portfolio construction. Automated factor mining now spans genetic programming, reinforcement learning, generative models, and large language model agents. Yet it remains unclear whether advances across these paradigms yield more generalizable, distinct, and economically useful financial signals. We introduce FactorBench, a portfolio-aware benchmark comparing roughly five thousand mined factors from nine automated mining methods across five equity markets. A shared data and evaluation contract supports both symbolic expressions and executable Python factors, connecting heterogeneous discovery algorithms to common signal combination and portfolio construction procedures. FactorBench traces the outputs of mining systems across three levels: factor validity, temporal generalization, and predictiveness beyond measured risk and style exposures; within- and across-method pool distinctness, including similarity to the benchmark Alpha101; and composite-signal quality and after-cost long-only and long--short portfolio performance. After systematically assessing whether advances in factor mining translate into signal quality and portfolio performance, FactorBench finds that no paradigm consistently dominates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FactorBench，一个组合感知的基准测试，比较9种自动因子挖掘方法在5个股票市场中挖掘的约5000个因子，从因子有效性、时序泛化、风险风格外预测力、方法内/间独特性及组合表现五方面评估。
AI.motivation: 自动因子挖掘已涵盖遗传规划、强化学习、生成模型和LLM智能体等多种范式，但这些方法的进步是否能产生更泛化、独特且有经济价值的金融信号仍不清楚，缺乏统一评估基准。
AI.method: 构建FactorBench：统一数据与评估契约，兼容符号表达式与可执行Python因子，将异构发现算法接入共同的信号组合与组合构建流程；在因子有效性、时序泛化、超出风险与风格暴露的预测力三个层面追踪挖掘系统输出，并评估方法内/间因子池独特性（含与Alpha101的相似度）及复合信号质量和含成本的多空/纯多头组合表现。
AI.result: 系统评估约5000个因子后发现，没有任何单一范式在所有指标上持续占优。
AI.conclusion: 因子挖掘范式的进步并不必然转化为信号质量与组合表现的全面优势，不同方法各有优劣。

title: Adversarial Training for Deep Hedging in Nonstationary Markets
summary: Deep hedging learns trading policies from historical or simulated market trajectories, yet under nonstationarity these training paths may not represent future market conditions. We propose WRAP (Wasserstein-Reweighting Adversarial Perturbation), a drift-aware adversarial training framework derived from a two-budget distributionally robust optimization (DRO) formulation. The formulation is anchored to a weighted empirical reference distribution whose fixed baseline weights are chosen to balance sampling uncertainty against temporal drift. Around this reference distribution, the ambiguity set addresses two complementary forms of distributional misspecification by allowing an adversary to reweight the observed trajectories subject to a $φ$-divergence constraint and perturb their paths subject to an optimal-transport (OT) constraint. We derive a joint first-order expansion in which the leading-order increase over the nominal expected loss decomposes into a reweighting contribution determined by the dispersion of hedging losses across trajectories and a transport contribution determined by the sensitivity of the loss to path perturbations. This expansion yields an explicit finite-dimensional adversarial attack that replaces the distributional inner supremum with a tractable first-order approximation. Across stationary and nonstationary Heston dynamics and a generalized affine diffusion (GAD), the experiments show complementary benefits from reweighting and transport, with joint adversarial training providing the largest gains under nonstationarity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WRAP框架，将深度对冲的对抗训练建模为双预算分布鲁棒优化，同时用φ-散度重加权轨迹、用最优传输扰动路径，并推导一阶展开得到可计算的对抗攻击。
AI.motivation: 深度对冲依赖历史或模拟轨迹训练，但在市场非平稳时这些轨迹无法代表未来市场分布，导致策略泛化性差。
AI.method: 构建锚定于加权经验参考分布的双预算DRO：基线权重平衡采样不确定性与时间漂移；歧义集允许对手在φ-散度约束下重加权轨迹、在OT约束下扰动路径。推导联合一阶展开，将分布内上确界替换为可处理的有限维一阶对抗攻击。
AI.result: 一阶展开将名义期望损失增量分解为重加权贡献（由各轨迹对冲损失离散度决定）与传输贡献（由损失对路径扰动的敏感度决定）。在平稳与非平稳Heston动态及GAD上，重加权与传输各有互补收益，联合对抗训练在非平稳下增益最大。
AI.conclusion: WRAP通过结合重加权与路径扰动两类对抗机制，有效提升非平稳市场下深度对冲策略的鲁棒性。

title: Verified, not generated: expert-verified AI study materials and the distribution of learning gains in a university course
summary: Experimental studies of generative AI in education mostly report average effects, yet field evidence shows that AI can narrow attainment gaps or widen them. We argue that the direction depends on the judgement burden, the expertise a learner must supply to screen AI output before learning from it, and that expert verification before release moves this burden from students to an accountable tutor. We test the argument in a two-cohort difference-in-differences design in which one half of a compulsory firstyear university economics course received AI-generated podcasts, FAQs and quiz-based study guides, produced with a source-grounded model and checked by a named graduate teaching assistant (170 students; 340 examination marks). Access was associated with a 2.34-mark advantage on a 50-mark component. The share of marks below the upper-second classification boundary fell by 24.7 percentage points relative to the counterfactual, effects were significant at every threshold from 23 to 31 marks and at none above, and roughly three-quarters of the average originated in the bottom quintile. The threshold estimate is robust to removing the lowest-scoring students from the pre-intervention cohort; the average effect is not. Interviews and feedback from 36 students indicate that the verification label gave students a reason to engage with AI-generated material without ending their scrutiny of it. Evaluations of AI learning resources that report only mean effects cannot detect whether the students the resources are meant to help are the ones who gain.

AI.tldr: 研究提出"判断负担"理论：AI生成学习资源对学生的影响方向取决于学生需投入多少专业能力去筛查AI输出；由导师事先验证可把负担从学生转移到导师。在一门大学经济学必修课中做双队列DID实验（170名学生、340个考分），发现AI资源使成绩提高2.34分（满分50），且效应集中于成绩较差的学生。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式AI教育研究多报告平均效应，但实地证据显示AI既可能缩小也可能扩大成绩差距。作者认为方向取决于"判断负担"——学习者需多少专业知识来筛查AI输出后再加以学习；若由专家在发布前验证，则该负担从学生转移到负责任的导师身上。
AI.method: 在一门大学一年级经济学必修课中开展双队列双重差分设计：一半学生获得AI生成的播客、FAQ和基于测验的学习指南（由溯源模型生成，并经具名研究生助教核查）；共170名学生、340个考试成绩。辅以36名学生的访谈与反馈。
AI.result: 使用AI资源与50分制组成部分中2.34分的成绩优势相关；低于二等一分类界限的成绩比例相对反事实下降24.7个百分点；效应在23至31分的所有阈值上显著，在更高阈值上均不显著；约四分之三的平均效应来自最低五分位组。阈值估计在剔除干预前队列中最低分学生后仍稳健，但平均效应不再稳健。访谈显示验证标签促使学生接触AI材料而未放弃对其的审视。
AI.conclusion: 验证机制可将判断负担从学生转移到导师，从而实现"既促进参与又保持批判性审视"。仅报告平均效应的AI学习资源评估无法判断资源是否真正惠及了本应受益的学生；应重视效应分布而非仅均值。

title: Economic resources, sporting efficiency and uncertainty: a stochastic optimization model of football performance in Africa
summary:
We propose a stochastic optimization framework in which football performance is modeled as the result of an efficiency-driven production process under uncertainty. The model incorporates economic inputs, a latent efficiency variable evolving according to a stochastic differential equation, and a control variable representing investment in sports development. We derive the associated discounted Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman (HJB) equation, characterize the optimal investment policy, prove a verification theorem under explicit growth conditions, and show that a bounded investment budget is required for the control problem to be well posed. We relate our efficiency measure to the stochastic frontier and data envelopment analysis (SFA/DEA) traditions used elsewhere in sports economics, and clarify what a dynamic control formulation adds relative to those static approaches. The theoretical results are illustrated with a numerical solution of the HJB equation -- validated by a grid-refinement convergence study -- and Monte Carlo simulations. A cross-sectional analysis of the 24 AFCON 2025 national teams, based on GDP, population, and FIFA ranking data, estimates country-specific conditional log-efficiency residuals using heteroskedasticity-robust inference.
  We show that these residuals are mechanically and strongly correlated with FIFA points by construction, quantify this dependence, and interpret the results accordingly. Teams such as Senegal and Morocco consistently outperform their GDP-implied potential, whereas others, including South Africa and Tanzania, tend to underperform.
  While these patterns are broadly consistent with observed AFCON outcomes, the estimated residual also captures unobserved factors, such as institutional quality, diaspora talent, and demographic structure, that are not included in the model.

AI.tldr: 该文建立一个随机优化框架，将足球表现视为不确定性下效率驱动的生产过程，推导HJB方程、刻画最优投资策略并给出验证定理；用数值解与蒙特卡洛模拟验证，并对AFCON 2025的24支国家队进行横截面效率残差分析。
AI.motivation: 将体育经济学中静态的SFA/DEA效率测度推广到动态控制视角，刻画投资与效率演化的最优政策。
AI.method: 以经济投入、按随机微分方程演化的潜在效率变量及体育发展投资控制变量构建模型；推导贴现HJB方程，刻画最优投资策略，在显式增长条件下证明验证定理，并指出控制问题适定需有界投资预算；用HJB数值解（网格细化收敛验证）与蒙特卡洛模拟演示；对AFCON 2025的24队基于GDP、人口、FIFA排名数据，用异方差稳健推断估计国别条件对数效率残差。
AI.result: 证明有界投资预算是控制问题适定的必要条件；数值解经网格收敛验证，蒙特卡洛模拟支持理论；横截面残差与FIFA积分在构造上强相关并被量化；塞内加尔、摩洛哥持续超出GDP隐含潜力，南非、坦桑尼亚等则表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 动态控制框架相对SFA/DEA静态方法提供了更丰富的政策含义；但残差也混杂制度质量、侨民人才与人口结构等未建模因素，故结果需谨慎解读。

title: Network Experiments with Edge Treatments and Node Outcomes
summary: We present a methodology for analyzing node-level outcomes while experimenting with edge-level treatments in a population connected by an undirected graph. Under our design, nodes are randomly assigned to test or control, and each edge inherits the treatment of its endpoints, with conflicts resolved by randomization. We use each node's assigned status as an instrument for its treatment exposure. We show that the Wald estimator is consistent for the global average treatment effect (GATE), even when the edge weights used to construct the exposure are misspecified. We formalize the assumptions needed both in terms of the linearity of potential outcomes and the sparsity of the graph, and prove the asymptotic normality of the Wald estimator. The estimator is straightforward to implement, requiring no assignment simulations over the graph. Our Monte Carlo study demonstrates the strong performance of our approach in the context of a social platform.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在无向图中进行边级处理实验、分析节点级结果的方法，用节点分配状态作为工具变量，证明Wald估计量对GATE一致且渐近正态。
AI.motivation: 在由无向图连接的总体中，实验通常对边（而非节点）施加处理，但关注的却是节点级结果，且边权重构造的暴露可能存在误设，需要一种稳健的因果推断方法。
AI.method: 节点随机分配到处理组或对照组，每条边的处理继承其端点状态，冲突通过随机化解决；以节点自身分配状态作为其处理暴露的工具变量，使用Wald估计量。对潜在结果线性和图稀疏性做出假设，并证明估计量的一致性（即使边权重误设）和渐近正态性，无需在图上进行分配模拟。
AI.result: Wald估计量对全局平均处理效应（GATE）一致，且具有渐近正态性；在社交平台情境下的蒙特卡洛研究显示该方法表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法实现简单、无需图上的分配模拟，能在边级处理实验中对节点级结果稳健地估计GATE，适用于社交平台等网络环境。

title: A Functional Representation of Credit Behavior for Probability of Default Modeling
summary: This paper proposes a framework for modeling probability of default via functional data analysis. By representing a series of credit variables as functions, we investigate whether intra-monthly information improves default predictability in linear models. We further show how a range of widely used variables, among them available funds, utilization rate, and overdraft, can all be derived from three quantities observed over time. Namely, 1) the type of each account, 2) the balance of the account, and 3) the size of the credit limit on the account. Retaining these quantities as continuous-time processes, rather than reducing them to monthly aggregated values, yields a continuous faithful representation of the borrower. When analyzing these three processes, we discovered that recurring events associated with the ordinal position among banking days created strong cyclical patterns. We therefore develop a relative time framework that aligns the recurring events across borrowers, ensuring that borrowers possess the same cyclical pattern, regardless of real time. We assess the framework using functional logistic regression. This approach accommodates the continuous representation while remaining closely related to a logistic regression model commonly used in credit risk practice, due to strict regulatory constraints. We show that, when equipped with an effective functional representation of transactional trajectories, the proposed model attains predictive performance on par with XGBoost while consistently outperforming logistic regression. Importantly, the model balances predictive performance of a machine learning model with the interpretability of linear default models, potentially enabling financial institutions to use the model, even under strict regulation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于函数型数据分析的违约概率建模框架，用连续时间过程表征借款人行为并引入相对时间对齐周期性事件，通过函数逻辑回归在保持可解释性的同时达到XGBoost级别的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 信贷违约预测实践中受严格监管约束，常用逻辑回归但其预测力受限；同时月度聚合数据丢失了月内信息，可能遗漏有价值的违约信号。
AI.method: 将信用变量表示为函数，从账户类型、账户余额、信用额度三个时间过程推导常用变量；保留连续时间过程而非月度聚合；发现银行工作日序位相关的周期性模式，构建相对时间框架对齐借款人的周期性事件；用函数逻辑回归建模。
AI.result: 月内信息提升线性模型违约预测力；函数表征下模型预测性能与XGBoost相当，且持续优于逻辑回归。
AI.conclusion: 该框架兼顾机器学习模型的预测性能与线性违约模型的可解释性，有望在严格监管下被金融机构采用。

title: Zero-Shot Visualization: Exploring Text Corpora with User-Prompted Axes
summary: We study the application of large language models (LLMs) to the visual exploration of textual corpora. We introduce zero-shot visualization (ZSV), a task in which users specify concepts in natural language and documents are mapped onto the corresponding concept axes for visualization. Building a ZSV system of practical value is non-trivial, as it requires choices at the intersection of feature functions, efficient implementation tradeoffs, and pre/post-processing decisions affecting visualization quality. To that end, we establish a benchmark that compares methods spanning embedding similarity, direct semantic judgments, and conditional likelihood estimation in this setting. Across multiple datasets and use cases we evaluate the properties of different scoring methods and design choices in terms of semantic faithfulness, score fidelity, and computational cost. Our results identify that scoring based on next-token probabilities offers the strongest practical trade-off among the evaluated methods. We further apply this approach to unlabeled corpora to examine its behavior in realistic exploratory settings. These experiments highlight additional design considerations, including the use of graded axes together with binary relevance filtering, and reveal a compositional sentiment bias in off-topic documents. Based on these findings, we provide practical guidelines for constructing end-to-end ZSV baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出零样本可视化(ZSV)任务，用户用自然语言指定概念，将文档映射到概念轴上可视化，并建立基准评测多种打分方法。
AI.motivation: 作者希望将大语言模型应用于文本语料的视觉探索，需要构建有实用价值的ZSV系统，但其中涉及特征函数、实现权衡和预处理/后处理等复杂设计选择，缺乏系统性评测。
AI.method: 建立了一个基准，比较嵌入相似度、直接语义判断和条件似然估计三类方法；在多个数据集和用例上，从语义忠实性、分数保真度和计算成本评估不同打分方法与设计选择。
AI.result: 基于下一词概率的打分方法在评测方法中提供最佳的实际权衡；在无标注语料上的实验发现应结合分级轴与二元相关性过滤，并揭示离题文档中存在组合式情感偏差。
AI.conclusion: 基于这些发现，论文为构建端到端ZSV基线提供了实用指南。

title: GAMEGO: Training Game-Dev Agents with Synthetic Trajectories Anchored in Real-World Assets
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in web front-end execution, with browser-based game generation emerging as a particularly prominent frontier. While previous efforts frequently rely on complex multi-turn workflows or focus on static game evaluation benchmarks, this work targets direct end-to-end real-world game synthesis driven by coding agents. However, generating complex games directly from sparse user queries often forces coding agents to make underspecified assumptions, yielding incomplete mechanics, disconnected gameplay flows, and limited visual aesthetics. To resolve this issue, this paper presents GameGo, a scalable framework that systematically transforms brief game seeds into comprehensive Product Requirements Documents grounded in industry game-development practices. To retain core gameplay constraints without restricting design exploration, GameGo uses task-specific dynamic compression to maximize information density while preserving instruction following. Based on this pipeline, GameGoData is constructed with 55,060 development trajectories across 2D, 2.5D, and 3D games, alongside GameGoBench, a benchmark comprising 124 diverse game queries. Training GameGoCoder on GameGoData yields a model that outperforms matched baselines and is comparable to frontier models across gamedev benchmarks. All code, datasets, and models will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出GameGo框架，将简短游戏创意转化为产品需求文档，构建数据集与基准并训练出GameGoCoder模型，性能优于同类基线、接近前沿模型。
AI.motivation: LLM在网页前端游戏生成方面应用前景大，但现有工作依赖复杂多轮流程或仅做静态评测。直接从稀疏用户查询生成复杂游戏会导致假设不充分，产生机制不完整、玩法割裂、视觉美感不足的问题。
AI.method: GameGo系统性地将简短游戏种子转化为符合行业游戏开发实践的产品需求文档（PRD）；采用任务特定的动态压缩，在保留核心玩法约束的同时不限制设计探索，最大化信息密度并保证指令遵循。基于该流程构建了涵盖2D/2.5D/3D的55,060条开发轨迹数据集GameGoData，以及含124个多样游戏查询的GameGoBench基准，并训练了GameGoCoder模型。
AI.result: GameGoCoder在游戏开发基准上优于匹配的基线模型，并与前沿模型相当。
AI.conclusion: GameGo提供了从稀疏创意到完整游戏的可扩展端到端方案，相关代码、数据集与模型将公开。

title: TEMPEST: Temporal Embeddings for Scalable Driver Identification via Angular Margin Learning
summary: Scalable driver identification requires embedding models that maintain discriminative performance as fleet size grows, yet existing triplet-loss formulations degrade rapidly with driver pool size and overfit to session-specific patterns under rigorous temporal evaluation. We introduce TEMPEST, a Temporal Convolutional Network embedding model trained with an additive angular margin (ArcFace) loss that enforces global class-level separation in a normalized angular space. TEMPEST maps 60-second multimodal driving windows to compact 96-dimensional embeddings, supporting truly dynamic enrollment without any retraining or classifier refitting. Under rigorous temporal evaluation on a 45-driver dataset, TEMPEST achieves 91.71% Rank-1 accuracy, outperforming the best classical model by 17.9 pp and the strongest triplet-loss baseline by 58.4 pp. TEMPEST degrades by only 4.3 pp when growing the subject pool from 10 to 45 drivers, compared to 22 pp and 32.5 pp for supervised and unsupervised triplet-loss baselines, and its cross-session advantage is corroborated on the public KIA Soul dataset, where it outperforms the best classical model by 7.3 pp within-session and 14.3 pp cross-session. With 720K parameters, a 2.80 MB footprint, and 50-epoch convergence, TEMPEST establishes a rigorous, reproducible baseline for scalable behavioral driver biometric identification.

AI.tldr: TEMPEST是一种基于时序卷积网络和ArcFace损失的驾驶员嵌入模型，在归一化角度空间实现全局类别分离，支持动态注册，跨会话与规模化性能显著优于三元组损失基线。
AI.motivation: 可扩展的驾驶员识别要求嵌入模型随车队规模增长保持判别力，但现有三元组损失方法在池规模增大时性能急剧下降，且在严格的时序评估下易过拟合到会话特定模式。
AI.method: 采用时序卷积网络（TCN）结合加性角度间隔（ArcFace）损失训练，将60秒多模态驾驶窗口映射为紧凑的96维嵌入，实现无需重训练或分类器重拟合的动态注册。
AI.result: 在45名驾驶员数据集上，Rank-1准确率达91.71%，超过最佳经典模型17.9个百分点、最强三元组损失基线58.4个百分点；驾驶员池从10增至45时仅下降4.3个百分点（对比基线22和32.5个百分点）。在公开KIA Soul数据集上会话内超最佳经典模型7.3个百分点、跨会话超14.3个百分点。模型仅720K参数、2.80 MB、50轮收敛。
AI.conclusion: TEMPEST为可扩展的行为驾驶生物识别建立了严谨且可复现的基线，兼顾高性能、轻量化与动态注册能力。

title: Personalized Recommendations Without Inducing Congestion: Mitigating Disparities in the NYC High School Match
summary: Algorithmic recommendations can help participants navigate large matching markets. For example, recommendations for school and college choices may reduce information frictions and disparities in access to high-performing programs. At scale, however, recommenders in capacity-constrained settings can be self-defeating: if they steer too many users toward the same items, then even users who were originally predicted to have a high chance of matching to an item may not, due to increased competition. In this paper, we formalize this phenomenon of recommendation-induced congestion; motivated by the NYC high school match, we show that naive recommendations can cause sharp decreases in program acceptance rates, most affecting applicants with the fewest nearby options. Next, we propose and theoretically analyze a congestion-aware, bilevel optimize-and-simulate approach to allocate recommendations and improve match outcomes safely, in equilibrium. Finally, we deploy this approach in the 2025-26 admissions cycle of the NYC high school match, aiming to reduce disparities by highlighting personalized lists of nearby, high-performing programs where an applicant has a high predicted offer likelihood. In a randomized controlled trial, we find that 16.4% of treatment applicants ranked a recommended program, versus 10.5% of control applicants who ranked a program they would have been recommended (57% relative increase; $p$=0.011); 5.6% of treatment applicants matched to such a program, versus 3.3% of control applicants (71% relative increase; $p$=0.071); further, no treatment applicant was rejected from a recommended program. Our findings suggest that recommenders should be analyzed and designed as market-shaping interventions.

AI.tldr: 算法推荐在容量受限的匹配市场中可能自我挫败：引导过多用户竞争同一项目会引发拥堵，反而降低录取率。本文形式化该现象，提出拥堵感知的双层优化方法，并在2025-26纽约高中录取中用RCT验证其有效缩小信息差距。
AI.motivation: 大规模匹配市场中，推荐可降低信息摩擦与入学不平等；但在容量受限下，推荐若过度集中于同一项目会加剧竞争，使原本高匹配概率用户也难以录取，尤其损害附近选择少的申请人。
AI.method: 以纽约高中匹配为背景，形式化推荐引发的拥堵现象；提出并理论分析一种拥堵感知的"双层优化-模拟"（bilevel optimize-and-simulate）推荐分配方法，以安全地改善均衡下的匹配结果；随后在2025-26纽约高中录取周期部署，进行随机对照试验（RCT）。
AI.result: RCT显示：处理组16.4%将推荐项目列入志愿，对照组仅10.5%（相对提升57%，p=0.011）；5.6%处理组匹配到此类项目，对照组3.3%（相对提升71%，p=0.071）；且无处理组申请者被推荐项目拒绝。
AI.conclusion: 推荐系统应被视作塑造市场结果的干预手段进行设计与分析；拥堵感知的推荐可安全改善匹配并减少不平等。

title: Nonlinear Thermal Modeling and Predictive Control for Spacecraft Optical Temperature Regulation
summary: Maintaining a stable thermal environment is critical for spacecraft carrying precision optics, as temperature gradients and thermal expansion can alter the geometric alignment of optical components, compromise wavefront sensing, and degrade image quality even when active thermal systems provide real-time control. In particular, the temperature of the optical payload must be controlled to sub-Kelvin tolerances about the desired setpoint, a requirement that is often difficult to achieve with conventional reactive control methods. To this end, this paper develops a novel nonlinear thermal model for the optical system of a spacecraft, accounting for conduction, radiation, and the changing radiative environment induced by the spacecraft's orbit. Using this model, we develop a model predictive control (MPC) methodology that enables closed-loop thermal regulation of the optical compartment under realistic orbital conditions. Since only partial, noise-corrupted temperature measurements are available, an Unscented Kalman Filter is employed to estimate the full thermal state, yielding a certainty-equivalence MPC controller obtained via recursive online optimization. The thermal model is validated against a high-fidelity thermal simulator, and the proposed approach is compared against conventional PID control, the prevailing method for on-orbit thermal regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对航天器光学载荷亚开尔文级热控需求，建立包含传导、辐射及轨道辐射环境变化的非线性热模型，并结合无迹卡尔曼滤波与模型预测控制（MPC）实现闭环热调控。
AI.motivation: 精密光学航天器对温度梯度与热膨胀极为敏感，可能破坏光学元件几何对准、影响波前传感并降低成像质量。光学载荷温度需控制在设定点附近亚开尔文级容差内，而传统反应式控制方法难以满足该要求。
AI.method: 建立考虑传导、辐射及轨道变化辐射环境的非线性热模型；基于该模型设计MPC方法，实现真实轨道条件下光学舱的闭环热调节；由于仅有部分含噪温度测量，采用无迹卡尔曼滤波估计完整热状态，通过递归在线优化得到确定性等价MPC控制器。
AI.result: 热模型经高保真热仿真器验证；所提方法与传统PID控制（当前在轨热控主流方法）进行了对比。
AI.conclusion: 非线性热建模结合UKF状态估计与MPC在线优化，为航天器光学载荷亚开尔文级热调控提供了优于传统PID的可行方案。

title: Learning Decision-Stump Thresholds in Context: Dynamics of Softmax Attention
summary: Estimating a decision threshold requires locating observations near an unknown boundary. We study how gradient-based pretraining learns this statistical rule in a two-parameter softmax-attention model with a fixed feature and inequality direction. Pretraining uses labeled contexts and their true thresholds; a fresh threshold must be inferred from context alone. Under a large-resolution initialization, constant-step gradient descent on $m$ tasks with $n$ examples each produces a frozen estimator with error $\widetilde O((m\wedge n)^{-1}+N^{-1})$ for each fixed interior threshold and every fresh-context size $N$. The two terms separate finite-pretraining accuracy from fresh-context localization. The mechanism is coordinated parameter divergence: population training calibrates the relative label and feature scores, then increases the attention scale as $t^{1/4}$, giving population threshold error $O(t^{-1/4})$. To transfer this mechanism to a fixed finite corpus, we control gradient errors relative to the shrinking directions of progress at successive parameter scales. This certifies a growing training interval without requiring long-time tracking of the population trajectory. We also identify the boundary limitation of the one-head model and explain statistically what a reflected symmetrization could achieve.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二参数softmax注意力模型中梯度预训练如何学习估计决策阈值这一统计规则，证明其误差为Õ((m∧n)^{-1}+N^{-1})，揭示机制为参数的协同发散。
AI.motivation: 估计决策阈值需要定位靠近未知边界的观测，这是重要的统计问题。作者希望理解梯度预训练如何在注意力模型中习得该统计规则，并刻画预训练精度与新鲜上下文定位能力的分离。
AI.method: 在一个含固定特征和不等式方向的二参数softmax注意力模型上，用带真实阈值的标注上下文进行预训练，再从上下文单独推断新阈值。采用大分辨率初始化、恒步长梯度下降，在m个任务（各n个样本）上训练。分析协同参数发散机制，并用相对于收缩方向控制梯度误差的方法将人口训练机制迁移到固定有限语料。
AI.result: 在人口层面，训练先校准标签与特征的相对分数，再以t^{1/4}增大注意力尺度，得到人口阈值误差O(t^{-1/4})。在有限预训练下，得到冻结估计器误差Õ((m∧n)^{-1}+N^{-1})，对每个固定内部阈值和任意新鲜上下文规模N成立。两项分别对应有限预训练精度与新鲜上下文定位。作者在不需要长期跟踪人口轨迹的情况下证明了增长训练区间，并识别了单头模型的边界局限，解释反射对称化在统计上能达到什么效果。
AI.conclusion: 梯度预训练确实能在该softmax注意力模型中习得阈值估计规则，其误差由预训练规模与新鲜上下文规模共同决定。协同参数发散是核心机制，单头模型存在边界局限，反射对称化可能提供改进方向。

title: Exponential investors with weakly mean-reverting prices
summary: We investigate a continuous-time financial market where the asset price exhibits weak (sublinear) mean reversion and has a nonzero drift. Complementing earlier work on strong (superlinear) mean reversion, we show that, for an investor maximizing expected exponential utility, the certainty equivalent grows as $O(T^{2β+1})$ where $0<β<1$ is the strength of mean reversion. An explicit asymptotically optimal strategy is also given.

AI.tldr: 研究弱（次线性）均值回归、非零漂移资产市场中指数效用最大化：确定性等价以 O(T^{2β+1}) 增长，并给出显式渐近最优策略。
AI.motivation: 此前研究多关注强（超线性）均值回归，弱（次线性）均值回归情形尚需补充，以完善不同均值回归强度下的最优投资理论。
AI.method: 在连续时间金融市场中设定资产价格具弱均值回归（强度 0<β<1）且含非零漂移，针对最大化指数效用的投资者进行渐近分析，并构造显式策略。
AI.result: 该投资者确定性等价随时间以 O(T^{2β+1}) 量级增长，与强均值回归情形形成对照。
AI.conclusion: 弱均值回归市场存在显著获利空间，且可用显式渐近最优策略实现。

title: The Noise Is the Signal: Correlated Sampling Error Is Rank-Informative for Proxy Metric Selection
summary: North-star metrics such as customer lifetime value are often too slow and noisy to decide a short A/B test. Teams therefore rely on a proxy metric, commonly chosen by how closely its effects tracked the north star's across past experiments. Validating that choice, or any method for making it, is hard: the only benchmark is the noisy north star, and the number of available past experiments is limited. In addition, proxy and north-star effects are estimated on the same customers, so their sampling errors are correlated. Recent work at major experimentation platforms removes this shared error as contamination, improving estimates of the true-effect covariance. Choosing a proxy, however, is a ranking problem, and a better estimate need not give a better ranking. We measure agreement free of shared error by estimating the two effects on disjoint random halves of each experiment's customers. In an archive of 262 experiments and 69 candidate proxies, the shared error ranks the candidates in a similar order to this agreement (Spearman correlation 0.65): it carries information about proxy quality. The more of it a correction removes, the worse the ranking because removal discards part of the signal but leaves the main sources of ranking noise, the noisy north star and the limited number of experiments, untouched. Archive-calibrated simulations, in which the correct ranking is known, confirm this even when every correction receives the true sampling covariance. Held-out real experiments, evaluated on disjoint customer halves so that shared error cannot bias the comparison, closely reproduce the predicted ordering (Spearman correlation 0.93). Correction can still pay off with more experiments, but the number needed rises steeply with the north star's noise. We map this crossover and give platform teams three inexpensive checks for deciding from their own archive whether and how strongly to correct.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑近期主流实验平台流行的"去除代理指标与北极星指标共享误差"做法，指出选代理是排序问题，而去污染会同时丢弃信号，反而可能恶化排序；作者用拆分客户随机半样本的方法测量无共享误差的一致性，并以262个实验、69个候选代理验证。
AI.motivation: 北极星指标（如客户终身价值）用于短期A/B测试太慢太吵，团队需要用代理指标；选代理本质是排序问题。近期工作把代理与北极星的共享抽样误差当"污染"去除，但更好的估计未必带来更好的排序，且验证这种选择缺乏无偏基准。
AI.method: 在每个实验的客户中拆成两个互斥随机半样本，分别估计代理效应与北极星效应，从而在无共享误差条件下测量两者一致性（agreement）。用262个实验、69个候选代理的档案，并配合已知正确排序的档案校准模拟，以及按客户拆分评估的留出真实实验进行验证。
AI.result: 共享误差给出的排序与无偏一致性排序相似（Spearman 0.65），说明其含代理质量信息；但修正去除得越多，排序越差，因为去除的既有信号又有噪声，而主要排序噪声源（嘈杂北极星、实验数量有限）未变。模拟显示即使修正使用真实抽样协方差也如此；留出实验高度复现预测顺序（Spearman 0.93）。实验更多时修正仍可能有益，但所需数量随北极星噪声陡增。
AI.conclusion: 去污染并非总有益，可能损害代理指标排序；其收益取决于实验数量与北极星噪声水平。作者给出交叉点图谱，并为平台团队提供三项低成本检查，用以判断自家档案是否该修正及修正强度。

title: Local $W^{2,1}_{p}$ convergence of penalization for time-inconsistent stopping problems
summary: This paper studies the penalization method for a general class of time-inconsistent stopping problems. Inspired by some existing results on penalization for optimal stopping problems, we introduce the penalized PDE problem and the penalized control problem for time-inconsistent stopping problems, uncovering some interesting discrepancy stemming from the time-inconsistency. As the penalization tends to infinity, we develop some novel arguments to rigorously establish the local $W^{2,1}_{p}$ convergence results for the solution of the penalized PDE problem to a solution of the variational inequality associated to the time-inconsistent stopping problem. Under an additional concavity assumption, we further derive the convergence of the penalized time-inconsistent control problem to the time-inconsistent stopping problem. We revisit two examples of time-inconsistent stopping to numerically illustrate the convergence theory.

AI.tldr: 研究时间不一致停止问题的罚方法，建立罚PDE与罚控制问题，证明解在W^{2,1}_p意义下收敛到变分不等式的解。
AI.motivation: 受最优停止问题罚方法的启发，将罚方法推广到时间不一致停止问题；因时间不一致性导致罚化问题存在特殊差异，需新论证加以处理。
AI.method: 引入罚化PDE问题与罚化控制问题，刻画由时间不一致性引起的差异；发展新论证，使罚参数趋于无穷时证明罚PDE解到时间不一致停止问题对应变分不等式解的局部W^{2,1}_p收敛；在额外凹性假设下证明罚化时间不一致控制问题收敛到原问题；并用两个例子数值说明。
AI.result: 建立了罚PDE解的局部W^{2,1}_p收敛结论；在凹性假设下获得罚控制问题的收敛性；数值示例验证了收敛理论。
AI.conclusion: 罚方法可推广到时间不一致停止问题，虽有时间不一致性带来的差异，但通过新论证仍可获得严格收敛结果。

title: Vine Copula VAR:From Recursive Margins to Joint Forecast Inference
summary: Joint-event forecasts often combine a dependence estimate based on past forecast errors with newly estimated marginal distributions. When each historical error retains the marginal fit available at its issue date, inference must account for an overlapping sequence of estimation errors. We derive their joint influence with the terminal forecast estimates in a stable Vine Copula VAR with normal innovation margins and a fixed, correctly specified Gaussian or positive Clayton vine. An intercept identity and the stable VAR filter reduce the historical correction to harmonically weighted innovation moments, while terminal slope uncertainty remains. The resulting covariance estimator gives asymptotically valid repeated-sample intervals for fixed one-sided event probabilities at the realized forecast state. In the Gaussian submodel, retaining issued transforms adds a positive semidefinite covariance term relative to refitting margins on the same observations. Monte Carlo simulations show that terminal-margin uncertainty is quantitatively more important than this additional term and that logit intervals improve lower-tail coverage in the designs studied. A real-time forecasting application to U.S. macroeconomic releases shows how marginal estimation contributes to uncertainty in predicted probabilities of joint contractions and identifies limitations of the stationary marginal model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究联合事件预测中历史预测误差的边际估计误差推断问题，推导其在稳定Vine Copula VAR中的联合影响，提出渐近有效的协方差估计量。
AI.motivation: 联合事件预测通常使用基于过去预测误差的依赖估计与新估计的边际分布。当每个历史误差保留其发布时的边际拟合时，推断需处理相互重叠的估计误差序列，这一问题此前未得到妥善解决。
AI.method: 在带正态新息边际及固定且正确设定的高斯或正Clayton vine的稳定Vine Copula VAR中，推导历史误差与终端预测估计的联合影响。利用截距恒等式和稳定VAR滤波将历史校正简化为调和加权的新息矩，同时保留终端斜率不确定性。
AI.result: 所提协方差估计量在实现预测状态下，对固定单侧事件概率给出渐近有效的重复抽样区间。高斯子模型中，保留已发布变换相对于重新拟合边际会额外增加一个半正定协方差项。蒙特卡洛模拟显示终端边际不确定性在数量上更重要，logit区间在所研究设计中改善了低尾覆盖率。美国宏观经济实时预测应用展示了边际估计对联合收缩预测概率不确定性的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 终端边际不确定性是主要来源，logit区间有助于改善低尾覆盖；所提方法可量化联合收缩预测概率的不确定性并识别平稳边际模型的局限。

title: Capacity, Responsiveness and Alignment: What Makes a Latent Structure Actionable
summary: Localizing latent structures in the activation space of language models (LMs) is central to understanding and controlling their behavior. Yet, localized structures can differ substantially in their causal influence, raising the question of what makes a structure actionable. We tackle this question by casting causal influence as a product of three factors and showing empirically that they act as interpretable, distinct constraints: capacity, measuring the sensitivity of the model's output to movement along the structure, responsiveness, capturing how promotable the concept is given the current context, and alignment, reflecting how well the structure aligns with the context-specific representation of the concept. Across 4 LM families and 50 concepts, we observe that causal effectiveness requires all factors to be high; low capacity and responsiveness reduce it by 84% and 95%, respectively, while low alignment can reverse it, suppressing concept expression. Moreover, we find that causality is context-dependent rather than an intrinsic property of the structure, with causally effective directions forming a low-dimensional subspace that varies across contexts. By restricting the training of linear probes to this subspace, we introduce causal probes that achieve 17%-118% improvement in steering across models, with only 3% reduction in concept detection.

AI.tldr: 论文将因果影响力分解为容量、响应性和对齐三个因素，实证表明三者需同时较高才能实现有效的概念操控，且因果方向是上下文依赖的，据此提出仅在因果子空间训练线性探针的方法。
AI.motivation: 语言模型激活空间中的潜在结构虽可被定位，但其因果影响力差异很大，尚不清楚什么样的结构具有可操作性/可干预性，因此需要厘清因果影响力的构成因素。
AI.method: 将因果影响力建模为三个可解释且相互独立的约束的乘积：容量（输出对沿该结构移动的敏感度）、响应性（给定上下文下概念的易激发程度）、对齐（结构与上下文特定概念表征的契合度）。在4个LM家族、50个概念上做实证分析，并据此仅在因果有效方向形成的低维子空间内训练线性探针（causal probes）。
AI.result: 因果有效性需要三个因素都高；低容量和低响应性分别使因果效果下降84%和95%；低对齐甚至可反转方向、抑制概念表达。因果性是上下文依赖而非结构内在属性，因果有效方向构成随上下文变化的低维子空间。causal probes在跨模型操控上提升17%–118%，概念检测仅下降3%。
AI.conclusion: 因果影响力由容量、响应性和对齐共同决定，且具有上下文依赖性；将探针约束到因果子空间能在几乎不损失检测性能的前提下显著提升概念操控效果，为可解释性与可控性提供了新视角。

title: Text2Dashboard: A Governed Agent Architecture for Natural-Language Dashboard Generation over Enterprise DataBrain
summary:
Text2Dashboard is a DataBrain-specific prototype that turns natural-language analytic requests into inspectable dashboards. An installable Codex plugin and standalone Agent Runtime combine schema-constrained model decisions with typed tools, persistent state, and deterministic Hooks for approval, audit, checkpointing, recovery, and failure handling. The pipeline resolves entities, discovers metadata, enforces read-only SQL, composes dashboards, and applies static checks, dynamic preflight, and browser inspection. The model proposes actions while deterministic software controls execution and records state transitions.
  We evaluate the workflow on frozen real-DataBrain tasks and controlled Hook faults. Strict success was 6/8 on metadata and SQL tasks: metadata selection passed 4/4, all four SQL tasks met semantic criteria, and 2/4 met the exact output-column contract. The final release passed 4/4 single-panel dashboard tasks, one two-panel task, and one existing-dashboard refinement; a parameterised task exceeded its step limit. All ten fault scenarios met their specified outcomes without unapproved external side effects. Model inference accounted for over 97\% of observed runtime in every reported group. These small, DataBrain-specific results do not establish production readiness, general text-to-SQL accuracy, or an efficiency advantage over manual dashboard construction.

AI.tldr: Text2Dashboard是一个DataBrain专用的原型系统，通过Codex插件与Agent Runtime将自然语言分析请求转化为可审查的仪表盘。它结合模式约束的模型决策、类型化工具、持久状态与确定性Hooks（审批、审计、检查点、恢复、故障处理），经实体解析、元数据发现、只读SQL、仪表盘组合及静态检查/动态预检/浏览器检查等流程。在冻结任务上严格成功率为metadata 4/4、SQL 4/4满足语义但2/4满足精确输出列合同，仪表盘任务4/4单面板通过，10个故障场景全部符合预期，模型推理占运行时间>97%。作者强调结果规模小、专用性强，不足以证明生产就绪。
AI.motivation: 将自然语言分析请求转化为可检查、可审计的仪表盘，同时让模型仅提出行动，由确定性软件控制执行并记录状态转移，以提升可靠性与可追溯性。
AI.method: 采用Codex插件与独立Agent Runtime，结合模式约束的模型决策、类型化工具、持久状态和确定性Hooks（审批、审计、检查点、恢复、失败处理）。流程包括实体解析、元数据发现、只读SQL强制、仪表盘组合，以及静态检查、动态预检和浏览器检查。
AI.result: 在冻结的真实DataBrain任务与受控Hook故障上评估：元数据和SQL任务严格成功6/8，其中元数据选择4/4通过，四个SQL任务均满足语义标准、2/4满足精确输出列合同；最终版本通过4/4单面板仪表盘任务、一个双面板任务和一个已有仪表盘细化，一个参数化任务超出步数限制；十个故障场景全部达到规定结果且无未授权外部副作用；模型推理在每组中占运行时间>97%。
AI.conclusion: 这些小规模、DataBrain专用结果尚不能证明生产就绪、通用text-to-SQL准确性或相比手工构建仪表盘的效率优势。

title: When Does External Guidance Help LLM Reasoning? A Bias-Variance Theory of Guidance-Augmented GRPO
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become the dominant paradigm for eliciting multi-step reasoning in large language models, and a recent wave of methods (LUFFY, ExPO, PAPO, TAPO) further augments RL with \emph{external guidance} - expert traces, self-explanations, or retrieved thought patterns. Although each method reports empirical gains, none provides convergence rates, bias bounds, or an optimal weighting rule for the guidance signal. We close this gap with \emph{Guidance-Augmented GRPO} (GA-GRPO), a unified theoretical framework that casts external guidance as a stochastic guidance operator G re-writing the question distribution, and analyses the resulting policy-gradient estimator as a biased on-policy estimator whose bias is bounded by the total-variation guidance divergence delta\_G between the guidance-augmented sampling distribution and the policy's own distribution. The framework subsumes vanilla GRPO, LUFFY, ExPO, PAPO, and TAPO as special cases obtained by particular choices of G. Under smoothness and bounded-divergence assumptions we prove that GA-GRPO converges at rate O(1/sqrt(T)) to an O(delta sqrt(T))-neighbourhood of the GRPO stationary point, derive the closed-form MSE-optimal guidance weight lambda-star(T, delta, sigma\_0 squared) = sigma\_0 squared / (sigma\_0 squared + R\_max squared delta squared T), and prove a matching minimax lower bound showing the Omega(delta squared T) bias term is unavoidable. Experiments on Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Base across nine math and OOD benchmarks confirm that optimal-weight GA-GRPO matches or surpasses TAPO, LUFFY, ExPO, and vanilla GRPO while requiring 31\% fewer GPU-hours, and eight analysis experiments validate each theoretical prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出GA-GRPO统一理论框架，将外部引导视为随机引导算子G，分析其策略梯度估计为有偏on-policy估计，偏差由引导分布与策略分布的TV散度delta_G上界控制。
AI.motivation: RLVR及LUFFY/ExPO/PAPO/TAPO等外部引导方法虽有效，但缺乏收敛率、偏差界与最优引导权重规则的理论支撑。
AI.method: 将外部引导建模为改写问题分布的随机引导算子G，统一Subsume GRPO及四种引导方法；在光滑性与有界散度假设下分析策略梯度估计器的偏差与收敛性质，并推导MSE最优引导权重。
AI.result: 证明GA-GRPO以O(1/sqrt(T))收敛至O(delta sqrt(T))邻域；导出闭式最优权重lambda* = sigma_0^2/(sigma_0^2+R_max^2 delta^2 T)；证明Omega(delta^2 T)偏差项不可避免。实验在Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Base九个基准上匹配或超越TAPO等方法，节省31% GPU时长。
AI.conclusion: 为外部引导增强的RLVR提供了首个统一理论分析，给出最优权重规则及理论下界，理论与实验一致。

title: Joint upper-bound coverage and route-choice utility: an empirical evaluation on two urban proxy tasks
summary: Whether more accurate traffic forecasts or higher uncertainty coverage improve route decisions is unclear. We evaluate this question with a frozen protocol that separates speed error, joint candidate path upper bound coverage, route selection, and realized loss. Using processed road speed data from Beijing and Chengdu, we construct offline proxy tasks with 150 origin destination pairs, three candidate paths, and 14 test days per city. We compare raw 90th percentile path time bounds with jointly calibrated upper bounds under minimum bound route choice. Joint coverage rises from 83.19% to 92.26% in Beijing M1, from 75.14% to 88.33% in Chengdu M1, and from 74.01% to 90.64% in Chengdu M2. Yet C2 increases lateness by 0.1633, 0.7848, and 0.9200 percentage points, respectively, and mean travel time by 0.588, 3.082, and 4.418 seconds. In a separate Chengdu predictor comparison, a 14.91% reduction in speed mean absolute error accompanies a 1.4571 percentage point reduction in lateness under C0. Joint coverage is therefore not a surrogate for downstream route utility in these frozen tasks the offline results do not establish online or causal benefits.

AI.tldr: 联合校准的上界虽显著提升路径覆盖度，但反而增加迟到率与平均行程时间；覆盖度并非路径效用的代理指标。
AI.motivation: 验证"更准确的交通预测或更高的不确定性覆盖度"是否能改善路线决策，此前并不清楚。
AI.method: 冻结协议分离速度误差、候选路径联合上界覆盖、路径选择与实现损失；使用北京、成都路网速度数据构建离线代理任务（150个OD对、3条候选路径、每城14个测试日），比较原始90分位路径时间上界与联合校准上界，采用最小上界路径选择。
AI.result: 联合覆盖率提升：北京M1从83.19%→92.26%，成都M1从75.14%→88.33%，成都M2从74.01%→90.64%；但C2下迟到率分别增加0.1633、0.7848、0.9200个百分点，平均行程时间增加0.588、3.082、4.418秒。成都预测器对比中，速度MAE降低14.91%对应C0下迟到率下降1.4571个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在这些冻结任务中，联合覆盖率不是下游路径效用的替代指标；离线结果不支持在线或因果收益。

title: Optimal Search for Finding Satellites Post-Launch
summary: This paper introduces Bayesian Continuation Model Predictive Control (BC-MPC), an adaptive method that replans near-term antenna pointings while continuing a feasible baseline sweep, for finding and establishing contact with spacecraft immediately after launch when their true positions are most uncertain. After separation, launch and deployment errors can leave the spacecraft sufficiently far from its predicted position that operators must actively search for it during ground contacts to establish communications. Each missed detection provides information about which orbital hypotheses remain plausible, but searching one part of the uncertainty region can consume the time needed to reach another. BC-MPC updates a particle-based orbital belief after missed detections and replans antenna pointing guidance while retaining feasibility. Its continuation helps preserve future search coverage that greedy and short-horizon methods can sacrifice for immediate acquisition gains. We compare BC-MPC against the operationally prevalent along-track sweep and additional search algorithms under common search-time budgets, initial uncertainty, and antenna constraints. Across 96 simulated deployments with matched uncertainty, BC-MPC improves acquisition probability over the along-track sweep and reduces restricted mean acquisition time. We additionally evaluate the method using pre-launch, post-launch, and initial acquisition ephemerides for 83 spacecraft from the Transporter-16 rideshare launch. Using either pre-deployment or post-deployment two-line element sets (TLEs) for planning, BC-MPC improves modeled acquisition probability over the along-track sweep by approximately 12 percentage points under the commonly assumed uncertainty model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BC-MPC（贝叶斯延续模型预测控制），一种自适应天线指向规划方法，在保持可行基线扫描的同时重规划近期指向，用于发射后立即搜索并建立与航天器的通信。
AI.motivation: 发射与部署误差可能使航天器偏离预测位置较远，操作员必须在有限地面接触时间内主动搜索。每次未探测提供轨道假设信息，但搜索某一区域可能消耗到达另一区域所需时间，需兼顾即时捕获与未来搜索覆盖。
AI.method: BC-MPC在未探测后更新基于粒子的轨道信念，并在保持可行性的前提下重规划天线指向；采用延续机制以避免贪婪或短视方法牺牲未来搜索覆盖。
AI.result: 在96次匹配不确定性的模拟部署中，BC-MPC相比沿轨扫描提高捕获概率并降低受限平均捕获时间；在Transporter-16的83个航天器上，使用部署前或后TLE规划，捕获概率提升约12个百分点。
AI.conclusion: BC-MPC在共同搜索时间与不确定条件下优于沿轨扫描等搜索算法，兼顾即时捕获与未来覆盖，提升发射后初期搜索与通信建立的效率。

title: A Query Is Not a Commitment: Learning to Correct Expert Answers in Online Deferral
summary: An inaccurate expert can still provide useful information after correction. We study online learning to defer in which the learner chooses an expert and fixes a correction function before purchasing its answer, then applies that function to the answer received. The difficulty is that observed losses reflect both expert quality and an unfinished correction: early errors can discourage queries that would be valuable after learning. We propose ORUCB, which pools shared and expert-specific polynomial responses. A bound on cumulative response-learning error calibrates confidence-weighted risk regression and exploration, allowing the router to account for this error when deciding which answers to buy. Under bounded residuals and disagreements, a fixed feasible model of optimal responses, and linear models of free and optimal queried risk, the calibrated algorithm achieves high-probability pseudo-regret $O(\sqrt T\log(T+1))$ over $T$ rounds for fixed problem parameters. The guarantee permits singular answer distributions and misspecified shared responses; optimality is relative to the bounded response class. On four test streams, the selected cubic policy has lower fee-inclusive cost than seven baselines that deploy answers unchanged. Comparisons with a common correction learner examine routing, while six-price comparisons measure cost and query rates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"延迟学习"（learning to defer）中的在线校正问题：学习者在购买专家答案前先固定一个校正函数，再对收到的答案施加校正。提出ORUCB算法，通过联合建模共享与专家特定的多项式响应，并利用响应学习误差界来校准置信加权风险回归与探索，在温和假设下达到$O(\sqrt{T}\log(T+1))$的高概率伪遗憾。
AI.motivation: 不准确的专家在经校正后仍能提供有用信息。核心难点在于：观察到的损失同时反映专家质量与尚未完成的校正过程，早期误差会抑制那些在学习后才会有价值的查询。因此需要一种能在线联合学习校正函数并决定向哪个专家购买答案的方法。
AI.method: 提出ORUCB算法，将共享响应与专家特定响应池化为多项式形式；通过累积响应学习误差的界来校准置信加权的风险回归与探索，使路由器在决定购买哪个答案时能考虑该误差。算法假设有界残差与分歧、固定的可行最优响应模型、以及自由风险与最优查询风险的线性模型。
AI.result: 在固定问题参数下，校准后的算法实现了$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$级别的高概率伪遗憾，具体为$O(\sqrt{T}\log(T+1))$。该保证允许奇异答案分布和共享响应错误指定，最优性相对于有界响应类成立。在四个测试流上，所选的三次策略在包含费用在内的成本上优于七个直接使用答案的基线；与常见校正学习者的比较考察了路由行为，六种价格比较衡量了成本与查询率。
AI.conclusion: ORUCB通过在线联合学习校正函数与专家路由，有效缓解了早期误差抑制有价值查询的问题，并在理论上达到近最优的伪遗憾界，实验中亦展现出更低的含费成本，验证了校正学习在延迟框架下的可行性与有效性。

title: Optimization by Reparametrization: Time-Warped Mirror Flows with Singular Geometry
summary: Solving data-driven problems requires defining complex models and fitting them to data, neural networks being a motivating example. The fitting procedure can be seen as an optimization problem, which is often non-convex, and hence optimization guarantees are hard to derive. An opportunity is provided by viewing the model of interest as a redundant reparameterization--an overparameterization--of some simpler model for which optimization results are easier to achieve. In this paper, after formalizing the above idea, we revisit some recent results and derive new ones. In particular, we consider the gradient flow of some classes of linear overparameterizations and show that they correspond to suitable mirror flows on the original parameters. Our main contribution relates to the study of the latter, for which we establish well-posedness and convergence. Several specific instances are provided, including fully connected linear networks and networks with weight normalization. The results yield insight into the role of overparameterization in optimization and corresponding implicit regularization properties.

AI.tldr: 将复杂模型视为简单模型的过参数化重参数化，研究线性过参数化的梯度流，证明其等价于原参数上的镜像流，并建立适定性与收敛性。
