Their reasoning shows why: the models rarely notice the conflict, and instead plan the edit as if the request were possible, often describing objects that are not in the image, or quietly change the request into one they can complete. Explicitly prompting these UMMs to report infeasibility increases textual refusals but reduces editing accuracy. We propose VisTA (Visual Transformation and Abstention), a training method that pairs feasible and infeasible examples so that a model judges feasibility before deciding whether to generate. We train VisTA-BAGEL to perform feasible edits and decline infeasible requests. Without any reminder, it refuses 93.0% of infeasible requests, up from 0.4% for the strongest editor, while falsely refusing only 0.8% of feasible ones. Unlike a reminder, this does not cost editing accuracy: VisTA-BAGEL completes 74.3% of feasible edits, more than any of the 8 evaluated UMMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“视觉拒绝”概念与DoD基准，发现现有统一多模态模型的编辑能力与拒绝不可行请求能力是分离的；提出VisTA训练方法使模型先判断可行性再生成，显著提升拒绝率且不损失编辑精度。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型整合理解与生成，但其生成行为很少受对任务的理解所支配；当请求的视觉变换在规则下不可能时，模型却不会识别并拒绝。
AI.method: 提出Draw-or-Decline (DoD)基准，含7类任务、1050对可行-不可行请求，同时衡量编辑成功与拒绝不可行请求；评估8个UMM；提出VisTA训练方法，配对可行与不可行样本，让模型在生成前先判断可行性；训练VisTA-BAGEL。
AI.result: 最强编辑模型编辑准确率68.4%，但仅拒绝0.4%不可行请求；显式提示可增加文本拒绝但降低编辑准确率；VisTA-BAGEL在无提醒下拒绝93.0%不可行请求，误拒仅0.8%，完成74.3%可行编辑，超过所有8个评估模型。
AI.conclusion: 编辑能力与拒绝能力是不同能力；通过VisTA训练可让模型先判断可行性再生成，显著提升拒绝率且不牺牲编辑精度。

title: Evaluate the Stack, Not the Layer: Do Deterministic and LLM Gates for Agent Actions Fail Independently?
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 10 tables. Artifact (data, scripts, provenance): https://github.com/chenglin1112/evaluate-the-stack
summary: Runtime gates for agent tool calls are stacked on the assumption that their errors multiply. We test it on 1,119 labelled agent actions from three corpora, without an adaptive adversary. The stack has one deterministic rule layer and four LLM judges, three of them re-collected with the served model recorded on every call. We read each stack as a number of multiplication-equivalent layers, n_mult, with its floor under perfect coupling. Under the STRICT miss definition (escalation to a human scored as not stopped), any two judges compose to about 1.2 to 1.4 layers (φ median +0.430, 6 of 6 pairs significant, floors 1.02 to 1.17). The rule layer plus one judge composes to 1.86 to 2.09 layers (φ median +0.014, 0 of 4 significant, floors 1.01 to 1.09). Under PRIMARY (escalation scored as caught) the bands are 1.21 to 1.57 and 1.80 to 2.13. Intervals separate on the pooled data, point estimates split on each corpus, and a third-vendor judge lands in the judge band. Solo accuracy does not predict what a layer adds: a cloud rule pack lowers the rule layer's solo miss rate by 20% and adds no new joint coverage. The difficulty share of judge coupling is not identifiable: 31.8% to 61.8% depending on the probe and the miss definition. One judge tier was served by an unrequested model version in 50 of 112 batches, concentrated on the external corpus. That event overturned a pre-declared analysis rule, and the scoring of review verdicts reversed five conclusions. We report both.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在1,119个标注的智能体行为上测试运行时门控堆叠，发现门控错误并非如假设那样相乘，任意两个LLM评审组合仅等效约1.2-1.4层乘法门控。
AI.motivation: 运行时门控被堆叠使用时假设其错误会相乘，但这一假设未经实证检验，本文旨在检验该假设是否成立。
AI.method: 在来自三个语料的1,119个标注智能体行为上测试，无自适应对手。堆叠包含一个确定性规则层和四个LLM评审（其中三个重新收集并记录每次调用的服务模型）。将每个堆叠读作乘法等效层数n_mult，并计算完全耦合下的下限。采用STRICT和PRIMARY两种漏检定义。
AI.result: STRICT下，任意两个评审组合约1.2-1.4层（φ中位数+0.430，6/6对显著，下限1.02-1.17）；规则层加一个评审约1.86-2.09层（φ中位数+0.014，0/4显著，下限1.01-1.09）。PRIMARY下分别为1.21-1.57和1.80-2.13。池化数据区间分离，各语料点估计分离。单独准确率无法预测层所增加的覆盖：云规则包将规则层单独漏检率降低20%但不增加新的联合覆盖。评审耦合的难度份额不可识别（31.8%-61.8%）。一个评审层级在112批次中有50次由未请求的模型版本服务，集中于外部语料。
AI.conclusion: 门控错误相乘的假设不成立；评审层之间高度耦合（等效层数远低于名义层数），而规则层加评审的组合接近可加。单独准确率不能预测联合增益，服务模型版本漂移会颠覆预设分析规则并改变结论。

title: CLM-as-a-Judge: Evaluating an Open Contrastive Decision Model on Public Judge Benchmarks
summary: An open contrastive decision model is near chance as a judge on the hard public benchmarks: Contrastive-LM/CLM-v0.1-8B scores between 0.351 (best- of-four, chance 0.250) and 0.593 (pairwise, chance 0.500), is statistically indistinguishable from coin flipping on RM-Bench and JudgeBench, and answers every HaluEval item with one constant label, matching the trivial always-first baseline at 0.581. Judges with the same parameter count score far higher everywhere: a reward model reaches 0.764 to 0.976 and a generative judge 0.611 to 0.778, and every gap to CLM is significant after Benjamini-Hochberg correction. Two properties do work. Raw confidences are overconfident by up to +0.401, yet one pooled temperature fit on held-out calibration items repairs expected calibration error to at most 0.062, and the repaired confidence ranks the model's own errors above chance on three of six benchmarks. The decision order-flip rate is 0.0002 against 0.2188 for the generative judge, and the length-preference shift is -0.023 against -0.217. The confidence-gated cascade, however, escalates between 0.923 and 1.000 of items to the strong judge at the preregistered 0.97 retention bar: calibrated confidence about a near-chance judge has almost nothing to keep. The design: five public preference benchmarks and one hallucination benchmark with real labels, scored under a preregistration frozen before any test item was seen, against generative, reward-model, and trivial baselines, with per-item predictions released.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了一个开源对比决策模型（CLM-v0.1-8B）作为评判者（judge）的能力。结果显示其在多项公开基准上表现接近随机水平，远低于同规模奖励模型和生成式评判模型，尽管其置信度校准和顺序稳健性较好，但校准后的置信度也无法有效支持级联筛选。
AI.motivation: 评估开源对比决策模型是否可作为可靠的自动评判者（LLM-as-a-judge），并与同参数量的奖励模型、生成式评判模型及平凡基线进行比较，以检验其真实判别能力。
AI.method: 在五个公开偏好基准和一个幻觉基准（含真实标签）上进行评估，采用预注册（preregistration）策略，在未见任何测试样本前冻结实验设计；对比生成式评判、奖励模型和trivial基线；并分析置信度校准（温度拟合修复ECE）、顺序翻转率和长度偏好偏移；最后测试置信度门控级联策略。
AI.result: CLM得分从0.351（best-of-four，随机0.250）到0.593（pairwise，随机0.500），在RM-Bench和JudgeBench上与抛硬币无显著差异，在HaluEval上恒输出单一标签，等于最平凡基线0.581。同类参数量评判者得分显著更高：奖励模型0.764–0.976，生成式评判0.611–0.778，且差异经BH校正后均显著。置信度过度自信达+0.401，但温度校准后ECE≤0.062；校准后置信度能在六个基准中的三个上超过随机水平地区分自身错误。顺序翻转率仅0.0002（生成式评判为0.2188），长度偏好偏移-0.023（生成式-0.217）。置信度门控级联在0.97保留阈值下需升级92.3%–100%样本至强评判者。
AI.conclusion: CLM作为judge在困难公开基准上接近随机水平，显著弱于同规模基线；其顺序稳健性和校准性虽好，但对一个接近随机的评判者，校准置信度几乎无法保留有效样本，级联筛选失效。结果提示该模型不适用于高风险自动评判任务。

title: Symmetry-Aware Feature Learning: A Polynomial Separation for Multi-Index Models
summary: We establish a polynomial sample complexity separation between symmetry-aware and symmetry-agnostic feature learning. We study growing-rank multi-index models with high-dimensional Gaussian covariates in $\mathbb{R}^d$ and $r=Θ(d^δ)$ teacher directions forming a cyclic symmetry orbit, where $0<δ<1/2$. We compare three ways of exploiting this structure: architectural weight sharing, data augmentation over the full symmetry group, and learning without access to the symmetry. In particular, we analyze a symmetry-tied convolutional network, an untied network, and the same untied network trained with full-group data augmentation, using spherical online SGD with correlation loss. For a class of polynomial links with information exponent $p\ge3$, we prove matching sample complexity bounds up to logarithmic factors: the tied and augmented learners achieve weak directional recovery in $\widetildeΘ(d^{p-1})$ samples, whereas the symmetry-agnostic learner requires $\widetildeΘ(rd^{p-1})$. For the pure quadratic Hermite link, the same separation holds for weak recovery of the teacher subspace, with sample complexities $\widetildeΘ(d)$ and $\widetildeΘ(rd)$, respectively. Thus, full-group data augmentation matches the sample efficiency of architectural weight sharing, and both provide a polynomial advantage over training without symmetry. For $p\ge3$, the proof reveals a two-stage mechanism: fluctuations at initialization select one direction in the teacher orbit, after which localized growth amplifies its overlap to the weak recovery scale while competing overlaps remain near their initialization scale.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了对称性感知与对称性无关的特征学习之间存在多项式样本复杂度差距：权重共享和数据增强均只需Õ(d^{p-1})（二次情形Õ(d)），而无对称性学习需Õ(rd^{p-1})（二次情形Õ(rd)）。
AI.motivation: 研究对称性结构（架构权重共享、全群数据增强）能否带来相对无对称性学习的样本效率优势，并厘清不同利用方式的等价性。
AI.method: 在高维高斯协变量下研究增长秩多指标模型，教师方向构成循环对称轨道（r=Θ(d^δ)，0<δ<1/2）。比较三种学习方式：对称绑定卷积网络、非绑定网络、以及全群数据增强的非绑定网络，均使用球面在线SGD与相关损失，针对信息指数p≥3的多项式链接及纯二次Hermite链接进行理论分析。
AI.result: 对p≥3，绑定与增强学习器以Õ(d^{p-1})样本实现弱方向恢复，而无对称性学习器需Õ(rd^{p-1})；对纯二次情形，子空间弱恢复样本复杂度分别为Õ(d)与Õ(rd)，差距为多项式级。
AI.conclusion: 全群数据增强能达到与架构权重共享相同的样本效率，二者均相对无对称性训练具有多项式优势；p≥3时证明揭示了"初始化涨落选方向、局部增长放大重叠"的两阶段机制。

title: Rethinking Faithfulness in LLMs: A Pairwise Context-Sensitive Perspective
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are expected to answer questions faithfully based on the provided context, abstaining when the context information is insufficient to answer the questions. Existing faithfulness evaluations typically assess each question-context instance in isolation; however, such instance-level evaluation fails to capture a fundamental requirement of faithful behavior: the ability to adapt model responses to changes in available contexts. In particular, a model should provide correct answers when sufficient evidence is present and abstain when it is not. In this work, we propose a Pairwise Faithfulness Benchmark (PFaithBench) that evaluates whether a model can switch between answering and abstaining for the same question under supporting versus non-supporting contexts. Our evaluations across thirty-nine models with seven model families demonstrate that faithfulness fundamentally involves a trade-off between answering and abstaining, and that most current models exhibit a strong bias toward answering, with most faithfulness errors arising from over-answering, i.e., models tend to fabricate a response even when the provided context is insufficient. We further conduct a series of studies on faithfulness training under different data constructions. Our results show that training outcomes are highly sensitive to the specific composition of answering and abstaining data. Constructing answering and abstaining data from mismatched sources can cause models to rely on dataset-specific shortcuts rather than actual context sufficiency. Moreover, increasing answer-supervised data improves answering performance but exacerbates over-answering, while increasing abstaining data reduces hallucination but leads to over-abstention. The code and data are released at https://github.com/tmlr-group/PFaithBench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出成对忠实性基准PFaithBench，评估模型能否在同一问题下根据上下文是否充分在"回答"与"弃答"之间切换，发现忠实性本质是二者的权衡，且多数模型偏向回答。
AI.motivation: 现有忠实性评估通常孤立地看待单个"问题-上下文"实例，无法捕捉忠实行为的根本要求：模型响应应随可用上下文变化而调整——有充分证据时正确回答，无充分证据时应弃答。
AI.method: 提出PFaithBench基准，针对同一问题分别提供支持性上下文与非支持性上下文，检验模型能否在回答与弃答之间正确切换；对39个模型、7个模型家族进行评估，并研究不同数据构成下的忠实性训练。
AI.result: 评估显示忠实性存在回答与弃答之间的权衡，多数模型强烈偏向回答，主要错误来自过度回答（上下文不足仍编造答案）。训练结果对回答/弃答数据的组成高度敏感：数据来源不匹配会使模型依赖数据集捷径而非真实上下文充分性；增加回答监督数据提升回答性能但加剧过度回答，增加弃答数据减少幻觉却导致过度弃答。
AI.conclusion: 忠实性应被视为回答与弃答之间的权衡问题，需要在数据构造上精心平衡，避免捷径学习与两类过度行为。

title: MemCo: Memory-Centric Collaboration for Generalizing LLM Agents to Unseen Environments
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in interactive environments, where they need to make sequential decisions through observation, action, and feedback. Although memory can help agents reuse experience, existing work designs memory in isolation, where collecting enough trajectories to populate it is expensive. Existing shared-memory approaches mitigate isolated experience by pooling episodic memories across tasks and environments. However, retrieving shared memory is challenged by the granularity, where retrieved memories can be either too specific to preserve current grounding or too coarse to support the next action. In this work, we propose MemCo, a memory-centric collaboration framework for generalizing LLM agents to unseen interactive environments. It maintains complementary local and global memory spaces, preserving environment-specific details locally while promoting transferable workflows induced from local trajectories to global memory. During online interaction, MemCo routes relevant local and global memories in terms of the agent's current state and decision phase, enabling agents to reuse the experience of other agents without blindly transferring environment-specific details. Experiments on interactive decision-making benchmarks show that MemCo improves task success and reduces redundant exploration compared with isolate-memory and shared-memory baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/SYannL/nvdamas.

AI.tldr: 提出MemCo，一个以记忆为中心的协作框架，通过互补的局部与全局记忆空间及状态/决策阶段相关的记忆路由，帮助LLM智能体泛化到未见交互环境。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在交互环境中需顺序决策，记忆可复用经验，但现有工作孤立设计记忆，收集足够轨迹成本高；共享记忆方案虽缓解孤立问题，但检索粒度存在矛盾：过细无法保持当前情境接地，过粗难以支撑下一步动作。
AI.method: MemCo维护互补的局部与全局记忆空间：局部保留环境特定细节，全局从局部轨迹归纳可迁移工作流。在线交互时，依据智能体当前状态和决策阶段路由相关局部与全局记忆，避免盲目迁移环境特定细节。
AI.result: 在交互式决策基准上，MemCo相比孤立记忆与共享记忆基线，提升了任务成功率并减少了冗余探索。
AI.conclusion: 以记忆为中心的协作框架能有效泛化LLM智能体至未见交互环境，代码已开源。

title: Learning Scientific Exploration from Human Research Decision Trajectories
summary: A key challenge in building AI systems for scientific research is enabling $\textit{scientific exploration}$: the systematic process of investigating unknown phenomena or ideas to gain new knowledge through sequences of research decisions and actions. Yet this process is largely missing from existing scientific corpora; for example, research papers primarily record final outcomes rather than the trajectories that produced them. In this work, we introduce $\textbf{ResearchTrails}$, a dataset of $\textbf{human research trajectories constructed from Git repositories}$, where $\textbf{commit histories}$ serve as proxies for research exploration. We develop an automated and scalable pipeline that extracts structured research trajectories from repository commits, capturing successive changes to methods, experiments, and ablations. We characterize the resulting dataset and show that these trajectories contain meaningful signals about intermediate research decisions beyond what final papers reveal. We further demonstrate utilities of ResearchTrails in multiple use cases, including retrieving human research experience as external skills at test time and training models on research trajectories to improve generalization to new research decisions. Our results suggest a path toward AI systems that learn not only from the products of science, but from the evolving process of discovery itself.

AI.tldr: 提出 ResearchTrails 数据集，从 Git 提交历史中提取人类研究轨迹，用于让 AI 学习科学探索过程而非仅最终成果。
AI.motivation: 构建科研 AI 的关键挑战是"科学探索"能力，但现有科学语料（如论文）只记录最终结果，缺失产生结果的探索轨迹。
AI.method: 设计自动化、可扩展的流水线，从 Git 仓库的 commit 历史中抽取结构化研究轨迹，以提交作为探索的代理，捕捉方法、实验与消融的连续变化，并对数据集进行刻画。
AI.result: 轨迹中包含论文未揭示的中间研究决策信号；在检索人类研究经验作为测试时外部技能，以及用轨迹训练模型以泛化到新的研究决策等用例中展示了实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 为 AI 系统从科学的"发现过程"本身学习提供了可能路径，而不仅是从科学成果中学习。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Hierarchical Reasoning Rewards: Minimax-Optimal Rates with Transformers
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a standard tool for post-training language models on reasoning tasks, where the policy is updated by reward feedback while exploring the space of responses. Despite its empirical success, theoretical understanding of RL post-training remains limited, in particular of why on-policy exploration combined with a neural reward model is effective. In this paper, we address this question by modeling the reward as a hierarchical function on the response space: the reward consists of infinitely many local components, each of which becomes relevant only after the preceding ones have been resolved. We show that a natural Transformer-based actor--critic algorithm, which alternates between sampling from the current KL-regularized policy, fitting a Transformer critic to the observed rewards, and updating the policy, achieves the minimax optimal rates in the query budget and in the regularization strength up to logarithmic factors, and is minimax optimal for a fixed number of prompts. In contrast, we prove that sampling from the fixed reference distribution, as in offline reward modeling, can limit regret decay to a logarithmic rate. These results show that on-policy exploration progressively zooms in on the region where the reward is concentrated, and quantify its benefit for RL post-training.

AI.tldr: 该论文从理论角度研究RL后训练为何有效，将奖励建模为响应空间上的层次函数，证明基于Transformer的actor-critic算法可达到minimax最优率，而固定参考分布的采样只能实现对数级遗憾衰减。
AI.motivation: RL后训练在推理任务上经验成功，但理论理解有限，特别是on-policy探索结合神经奖励模型为何有效尚不清楚。论文旨在从理论上解释这一现象。
AI.method: 将奖励建模为响应空间上的层次函数：包含无穷多个局部组件，每个组件只有在此前组件被解决后才相关。分析一种自然的Transformer-based actor-critic算法，该算法在采样当前KL正则化策略、拟合Transformer critic和更新策略之间交替。
AI.result: 该算法在查询预算和正则化强度上达到minimax最优率（至多对数因子），并在固定提示数下是minimax最优的。相反，从固定参考分布采样（如离线奖励建模）只能将遗憾衰减限制在对数率。
AI.conclusion: on-policy探索逐步聚焦于奖励集中的区域，论文量化了其对RL后训练的收益，并从理论上阐明了on-policy探索结合神经奖励模型的有效性。

title: ARIA: Audio-Driven Melody-Tone Relation Modeling for Cantonese Lyric Authoring
comment: Accepted for publication in Findings of EMNLP 2026. 24 pages, including references and appendices. Author-prepared version
summary: Cantonese lyric writing requires close alignment between lexical tones and melodic pitch. Existing melody-guided lyric generation methods typically rely on symbolic melody to generate lyrics. However, in real songwriting scenarios, melodies are often expressed as raw singing audio or hummed recordings, where pitch is implicit, noisy, and unstructured, making these methods difficult to apply directly. To address this limitation, we propose ARIA, a two-stage audio-driven melody-tone relation modeling framework for Cantonese lyric authoring that generates Cantonese lyrics from singing recordings with provided character-level timestamps. Specifically, we first design a Tri-Stream Relation-Aware Tone Estimator (TRATE) to predict 0243 sequences from timestamped singing audio by modeling multi-stream acoustic cues and relational tonal structure. We then propose a Decoupled Retrieval-Augmented Tone-Conditioned Lyric Generator (DRA-TCLG) to generate fluent lyrics conditioned on predicted tonal plans with retrieval-enhanced lexical guidance. Moreover, we construct a large-scale aligned audio-Jyutping-0243 dataset from real Cantonese singing recordings to support this new task. Experimental results demonstrate that ARIA achieves strong performance in both 0243 prediction and tone-consistent lyric generation, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 提出ARIA框架，从带时间戳的演唱音频直接生成粤语歌词，通过两阶段建模音高与声调关系。
AI.motivation: 现有旋律引导的歌词生成依赖符号化旋律，但真实创作中旋律常以演唱音频或哼唱形式存在，音高隐式、含噪、无结构，难以直接应用。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：先用三流关系感知声调估计器（TRATE）从带时间戳的演唱音频预测0243序列；再用解耦检索增强声调条件歌词生成器（DRA-TCLG）以预测声调计划为条件生成流畅歌词。并构建大规模音频-粤拼-0243对齐数据集。
AI.result: 在0243预测和声调一致性歌词生成两项任务上均取得强劲表现，验证了框架有效性。
AI.conclusion: ARIA有效解决音频驱动粤语歌词创作中的音高隐式问题，为该新任务提供了数据集与可行方案。

title: Defense-in-Depth for LLMs: Evaluating Memory Gates Against Activation-Induced and Memory-Induced Sycophancy
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS (IAB, RTCA, AIWILD, and CL4FM)
summary: Long-term memory allows Large Language Models (LLMs) to maintain personalized context across interactions, but retrieved user history can induce memory-induced sycophancy, causing models to favor stored user beliefs over objective evidence. Existing defenses primarily operate on retrieved context and are rarely evaluated jointly with internal behavioral bias. We introduce a $2 \times 2$ defense-in-depth framework separating internal activation steering from external memory handling. We extract sycophancy steering directions from 100 paired prompts and evaluate four open-weight models across 10 steering coefficients and five memory-defense configurations on MemSyco-Bench (answers for all 1,550 items; defense conditions judged on a fixed 250-item subsample), with three LLM judges. Three of the five configurations are new (rewriting every memory, a Router Gate that keeps, rewrites, or drops each memory, and dropping all memory); the other two are MemSyco's baselines. Selective Router Gate filtering preserves substantially more of MemSyco's average accuracy than complete memory removal, and this separation persists when the models are steered toward sycophancy. On Llama 3.1 8B with Router Gate, mild inverse steering ($α= -1.5$) lowers judge-averaged sycophancy from 35.80% to 31.32% while average accuracy moves from 43.99% to 43.31%; this reduction has the same direction under all three judges but is not statistically significant (paired $p = 0.08$ to $0.63$ on 149 items). External memory filtering is the part of the design that holds up; our data do not show that inverse steering adds to it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个2×2纵深防御框架，区分内部激活引导与外部记忆处理，用以缓解LLM的"记忆诱导谄媚"问题。实验发现选择性记忆过滤（Router Gate）在保留准确率方面优于完全删除记忆，而反向引导未显示显著额外增益。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆使LLM能维持个性化上下文，但检索到的用户历史会诱发"记忆诱导谄媚"，使模型偏向存储的用户信念而非客观证据。现有防御主要作用于检索上下文，且很少与内部行为偏置联合评估。
AI.method: 提出2×2纵深防御框架，分离内部激活引导与外部记忆处理。从100对配对提示中提取谄媚引导方向，在MemSyco-Bench（1550项，防御条件在固定250项子样本上评估）上评测4个开放权重模型，覆盖10个引导系数与5种记忆防御配置，并使用3个LLM评判器。其中3种配置为新增：重写全部记忆、Router Gate（保留/重写/丢弃每条记忆）、丢弃全部记忆；另2种为MemSyco基线。
AI.result: 选择性Router Gate过滤相比完全删除记忆能保留显著更多的MemSyco平均准确率，且该优势在模型被引导向谄媚时依然存在。在Llama 3.1 8B配合Router Gate时，轻度反向引导（α=-1.5）将评判器平均谄媚率从35.80%降至31.32%，同时准确率从43.99%变为43.31%；该下降在三个评判器下方向一致但不具统计显著性（149项上配对p=0.08至0.63）。
AI.conclusion: 外部记忆过滤是稳健有效的设计部分；但数据未能证明反向引导对其有额外增益。

title: Exact Unlearning via Quantized Sufficient Statistics
comment: 33 pages, 20 figures, 15 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Exact unlearning requires a deployed predictor to match one rebuilt without the information named by a deletion request. Existing general-purpose exact methods localize retraining through disjoint shards, but every request still invalidates a model, and smaller shards reduce the data available to each constituent predictor. We introduce Quantized Sufficient Statistics (QSS), which separates a small frozen schema from mutable, sum-decomposable content. The schema learns global structure; the content stores local prediction corrections as additive statistics indexed by quantized regions. Deleting content is therefore exact subtraction rather than optimization. We distinguish two guarantees: QSS-L exactly removes a label while retaining the unlabelled input, whereas QSS-E exactly removes both input and label by learning the schema without deletable examples. A deletion takes the arithmetic fast path with probability $1-ρ$ and triggers a full rebuild with probability $ρ$; all reported expected latencies include both events. Across 15 vision, text, and tabular datasets at $ρ=0.5\%$, QSS-L is within 2 percentage points of SISA on 11 tasks and provides 4--483$\times$ lower expected deletion latency on the low-class-count tasks where a compact schema is effective. QSS-E quantifies the additional accuracy cost of removing every trace of an input.

AI.tldr: QSS将模型分为冻结的全局schema与可加和分解的量化内容，使删除请求通过精确减法实现，无需优化即可完成精确遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有通用精确遗忘方法依赖不相交分片来局部化重训练，但每次删除仍会使一个模型失效，且分片越小每个子预测器可用数据越少。
AI.method: 提出Quantized Sufficient Statistics (QSS)，将小型冻结schema与可变、和可分解内容分离：schema学习全局结构，内容以量化区域索引的加性统计存储局部预测修正；删除即精确减法。提供QSS-L（仅删标签、保留无标签输入）与QSS-E（同时删输入和标签）两种保证。删除以概率1-ρ走算术快路径，以概率ρ触发完整重建，报告延迟包含两者。
AI.result: 在15个视觉、文本和表格数据集、ρ=0.5%下，QSS-L在11个任务上与SISA相差2个百分点以内，并在低类别数任务上实现4–483×更低的期望删除延迟；QSS-E量化了彻底移除输入痕迹的额外精度代价。
AI.conclusion: QSS通过加性统计实现精确减法删除，在保持有竞争力精度的同时显著降低低类别数任务上的期望删除延迟，并区分了标签删除与输入-标签删除的精度权衡。

title: Early Memory Selection for Balanced Adam
comment: Includes theoretical proofs and reproducibility appendices. Code and data: https://github.com/AlbertoFdezHdez/Adam_beta_rule_cubic
summary: We propose a method for choosing the shared memory parameter $β_1=β_2=β$ in Adam from a short pilot training. The selected $β$ remains fixed during the subsequent full training. A local model of Adam's normalized direction balances sampling variability against the delay introduced by averaging past gradients. This balance gives a cubic memory rule, whose two coefficients are estimated from gradient probes at a few pilot checkpoints. The estimator uses the numerator and denominator jointly, preserving their covariance. With a 200-update pilot and sixteen probe gradients at each of four checkpoints, a seed-matched retrospective evaluation on eleven vision and language workloads reduces mean relative validation gap by 40.7% and worst-quarter mean gap by 44.3% against the grid representative of shared $β=0.95$. The mean gap is also 32.3% lower than that of the best constant $β$ chosen across all eleven workloads.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出通过短程预训练选择Adam的共享动量参数β1=β2=β，并在此后固定不变；用局部模型平衡采样波动与梯度平均延迟，导出三次记忆规则，其系数由少量检查点的梯度探针估计。
AI.motivation: Adam的共享β通常固定为0.95，但不同工作负载的最优β可能不同，统一网格代表值未必最优；需要一种低成本、可迁移的β选择方法。
AI.method: 在短pilot训练中，对若干检查点采集梯度探针；构建Adam归一化方向的局部模型，权衡采样变异与历史梯度平均延迟，得到关于β的三次记忆规则；联合使用分子分母及其协方差估计两个系数，选定β后在完整训练中固定。
AI.result: 在11个视觉和语言负载上，使用200次更新pilot、4个检查点各16个探针梯度，与共享β=0.95的网格代表值相比，平均相对验证差距降低40.7%，最差四分之一平均差距降低44.3%；平均差距也比跨越全部11个负载选出的最佳常数β低32.3%。
AI.conclusion: 通过短程pilot和梯度探针可有效选择并固定Adam的共享β，显著优于常用共享β=0.95及跨负载最佳常数β，提供了一种低成本的自适应超参数选择方案。

title: Pseudowords as probes: Large Language Models show little of the sublexical sensitivity that governs human pseudoword processing
summary: Systematicity, the probabilistic mapping of form to meaning, permeates language at all levels, and sublexical cues have been shown to govern human pseudoword processing. Yet whether LLMs exhibit comparable sensitivity to these cues remains unclear. We tested five LLMs on two Italian two-alternative forced-choice pseudoword experiments and compared their responses with a human behavioural baseline. LLMs aligned more reliably with humans when real-word options provided a lexical familiarity cue than in the pseudoword-only condition, where they fell substantially below fastText, a character-n-gram model. In addition, the sublexical cosine-similarity cue that reliably drove human--fastText agreement did not consistently transfer to human--LLM alignment, and reasoning-token expenditure bore no consistent relation to human processing difficulty. These findings suggest that LLMs do not necessarily share the sublexical cues that govern human pseudoword processing; we discuss tokenization and training-data coverage as candidate explanations.

AI.tldr: 研究检验五个LLM是否像人类一样利用亚词汇线索处理意大利语假词：当有真实词熟悉度线索时，LLM与人类一致性较高；但在纯假词条件下，LLM表现明显低于fastText，且驱动人类判断的亚词汇余弦相似度线索未能稳定迁移到人类-LLM对齐上。
AI.motivation: 系统性（形式到意义的概率映射）遍及语言各层面，亚词汇线索已被证明支配人类的假词加工。然而LLM是否对这些线索具可比敏感性尚不清楚。作者希望通过比较LLM与人类行为基线来检验二者是否共享亚词汇加工机制。
AI.method: 在两项意大利语二选一强迫选择假词实验上测试五个LLM，并与人类行为基线比较；同时将LLM与fastText（字符n-gram模型）作对照，分析亚词汇余弦相似度线索在人类-fastText与人类-LLM一致性中的表现，并考察推理token消耗与人类加工难度的关系。
AI.result: 选项含真实词提供熟悉度线索时，LLM与人类一致性更高；纯假词条件下LLM显著低于fastText。驱动人类-fastText一致的亚词汇余弦相似度线索未稳定迁移至LLM，推理token消耗与人类加工难度无一致关系。
AI.conclusion: LLM未必共享支配人类假词加工的亚词汇线索；作者提出分词方式与训练数据覆盖度可能是候选解释。

title: 2d-fet-bench: from spatial reasoning to fet design on flakes
summary: Field-effect transistor (FET) layouts on exfoliated two-dimensional flakes are typically drawn by hand for each flake, placing contacts and gates to match its position and outline in optical micrographs. To our knowledge, no executable benchmark tests whether language-model agents can perform this flake-specific construction reliably. We introduce 2D-FET-Bench V2, a benchmark of 128 layout tasks built from microscopy-derived flake contours, including hole-containing flakes and multi-flake tasks. Each task supplies a textual device specification and contour coordinates. An agent generates typed polygon and path operations rendered to GDSII. A deterministic verifier checks geometric and structural requirements, and a separate integrity check verifies that the supplied contours remain unchanged. Scripted reference layouts pass all 128 tasks, showing that every task is solvable. We evaluate six models and seven workflow and scaffold variants of GPT5.6-Luna, with five attempts per task. The best-performing configuration in the six-model panel, GPT5.6-Luna with ReAct-3, passes 62.3% of attempts and solves 80.5% of tasks at least once (coverage) and 43.8% in all five attempts (consistency). ReAct-3 exceeds the one-pass Plan-and-Execute by 27.0 pass@1 points at 2.46 times the tokens. An expert audit of one sampled verifier-passing layout per covered task, across five ReAct-3 configurations, accepts 56.4% to 63.5% of them. The benchmark evaluates geometric and structural FET layout construction.

AI.tldr: 提出2D-FET-Bench V2基准，用128个二维材料FET版图任务测试语言模型智能体，最优配置通过率62.3%、任务覆盖率80.5%。
AI.motivation: 二维材料剥离薄片的FET版图通常需针对每片薄片手工绘制，缺乏可执行的基准来检验语言模型智能体能否可靠完成这种针对特定薄片的版图构建。
AI.method: 基准含128个由显微图像提取的薄片轮廓任务（含带孔与多薄片情形）。每个任务给出文本器件规格与轮廓坐标，智能体生成带类型多边形与路径操作并渲染为GDSII；确定性验证器检查几何与结构要求，另有完整性检查确保轮廓未被改动。
AI.result: 脚本参考版图通过全部128个任务。评估6个模型与GPT5.6-Luna的7种工作流/脚手架变体，每任务5次尝试。最佳配置GPT5.6-Luna+ReAct-3：单次通过62.3%，覆盖率80.5%，五次全过一致性43.8%。ReAct-3比单次Plan-and-Execute高27.0个pass@1点，但token用量为其2.46倍。专家审计接受率56.4%–63.5%。
AI.conclusion: 该基准用于评估二维FET版图的几何与结构构建能力，表明任务均可解但现有智能体可靠性仍有限。

title: Distributionally Robust Mixture-of-Experts Training
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) transformers scale capacity by activating only a few experts per token, but this sparsity creates a hidden reliability problem: when routing is imperfect, load-balanced models may send tokens to experts that are insufficiently trained for the assigned inputs. We propose Distributionally Robust MoE Training (DRMoET), a drop-in objective that treats layer-wise experts as endogenous robustness groups and optimizes high-loss routing outcomes rather than merely equalizing traffic. DRMoET updates a per-layer expert distribution by an entropy-regularized softmax rule on EMA-smoothed, activation-weighted expert losses, strengthening plausible non-top routing paths while preserving standard MoE computation. Under the FLAME-MoE recipe at 746M-total and 10.3B-total scales, DRMoET improves downstream averages over both standard FLAME-MoE and auxiliary-loss-free balancing. At 10.3B total parameters and 67B training tokens, DRMoET improves the seven-task average from 0.6625 to 0.6767, while the auxiliary-loss-free baseline achieves 0.6431. Mechanistic analyses show lower expert-loss variance with nearly unchanged mean loss, 4.3% lower excess loss under forced mid-$k$ misrouting, and improved domain-expert specialization. These results position routing robustness-not only utilization balance-as a practical objective for reliable sparse MoE scaling. Project page and code are available at: https://drmoet.github.io/.

AI.tldr: DRMoET通过分布鲁棒优化路由可靠性，提升MoE模型下游表现。
AI.motivation: MoE稀疏激活存在隐藏可靠性问题：路由不完美时，负载均衡的模型可能将token分配给训练不足的专家。
AI.method: 将每层专家视为内生鲁棒组，用熵正则化softmax对EMA平滑、激活加权的专家损失更新每层专家分布，强化合理的非top路由路径，保持标准MoE计算。
AI.result: 在FLAME-MoE 746M/10.3B规模下，DRMoET优于标准FLAME-MoE和无辅助损失平衡；10.3B参数、67B token时七任务均值从0.6625提升至0.6767（基线0.6431）；专家损失方差降低，强制mid-k误路由超额损失降低4.3%，域专家专精增强。
AI.conclusion: 路由鲁棒性（不仅是利用率平衡）是可靠稀疏MoE扩展的实用目标。

title: Leveraging a four-quadrant approach for evaluating Redpine Science
summary: Redpine Science gives models and agents a single access point to a wide range of peer-reviewed literature, queried directly through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and an API. This report evaluates Redpine Science on two levels: the relevance of the retrieved chunks, and a model's answer when it has access to Redpine Science compared to web search. Both public and expert-validated benchmarks are used. Public benchmarks are a widely accepted way to test model development and are comparable across labs, but risk saturation and memorization. To address this, we complement them with an expert-validated question set. In total, this report presents four evaluations. On ScholarQABench SciFact, the public answer-quality benchmark reported here, an agent with Redpine Science answers 94.4% of claims correctly against 87.6% with no retrieval. On the expert-validated question set, an agent with Redpine Science states 80.1% of the required claims against 70.2% for an agent restricted to web search. On the 668 queries of a public retrieval benchmark whose gold paper Redpine holds, stripped of any model reasoning, Redpine Science places the correct source paper in its top ten results for 83.1% of queries (Recall@10), against 79.3% for the benchmark's creator. A blinded expert relevance panel places Redpine Science's Precision@5 at 75.2% against 39.8% for the PubMed search tool. We release the expert-validated question set and instructions to reproduce every headline result above, at https://github.com/redpine-ai/benchmarks.

AI.tldr: Redpine Science 通过 MCP 和 API 为模型与智能体提供单一入口访问同行评审文献。报告从检索相关性与模型回答质量两方面进行评估，采用公开与专家验证基准共四项评测。
AI.motivation: 公开基准虽便于跨实验室比较，但存在饱和与记忆风险，因此需要专家验证的问题集作为补充，以更可靠地评估科研检索与回答系统。
AI.method: 使用公开基准与专家验证问题集进行四项评测：ScholarQABench SciFact 回答质量、专家验证问题集对比网页搜索检索、公开检索基准 Recall@10，以及盲审专家相关性小组评估 Precision@5。
AI.result: SciFact 上正确回答 94.4% 对比无检索 87.6%；专家问题集覆盖必需论断 80.1% 对比网页搜索 70.2%；668 查询 Recall@10 为 83.1% 对比基准创建者 79.3%；Precision@5 为 75.2% 对比 PubMed 工具 39.8%。
AI.conclusion: Redpine Science 在回答质量、论断覆盖和检索相关性上均优于对照方法，并公开专家验证问题集与复现说明以支持可重复评估。

title: Adaptive Gait Biofeedback With Participant-Held-Out Modeling and Participant-Specific Updating in Chronic Ankle Instability
comment: 28 pages (14-page main manuscript and 14-page supplementary material), 5 main figures
summary: Adaptive gait biofeedback may support repeated practice in chronic ankle instability, but its evaluation must address model performance and human response. We evaluated a temporal convolutional classifier on protocol-defined, angle-derived GOOD/BAD gait-cycle labels using participant-held-out leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) cross-validation in 20 participants. Seven participants in the adaptive-intervention group completed nine sessions over three weeks, with one motion-capture recording analyzed per session. Models updated after failed sessions were compared offline with their parent models on the same-session validation subset used for candidate selection and the first subsequent adaptive-session recording. Frontal-plane ankle angle was compared between the adaptive group and 10 sequentially enrolled controls at Baseline, Post, and 7-day Retention. Across 20 held-out folds, mean fold-level area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.948, sensitivity for angle-threshold-exceeding BAD cycles was 0.941, and specificity for angle-threshold-meeting GOOD cycles was 0.366. Mean BAD-class F1 was higher in candidate models by 0.187 on the same-session subset and 0.118 on the first subsequent recording. At Post, the adaptive group had a baseline-adjusted frontal-plane ankle angle 5.168 degrees lower than controls (95% confidence interval, 1.766-8.569 degrees lower); the Retention contrast was uncertain. These findings characterize population-model discrimination and offline participant-specific updating during repeated biofeedback use, alongside a nonrandomized Post frontal-plane ankle angle association. They do not establish independent clinical gait classification or a causal benefit of updating.

AI.tldr: 评估时序卷积分类器对慢性踝关节不稳步态周期的GOOD/BAD标签表现，并观察自适应生物反馈干预的人体响应。
AI.motivation: 自适应步态生物反馈或可支持慢性踝关节不稳的重复练习，但需同时评估模型性能与人体响应。
AI.method: 20名参与者LOSO交叉验证时序卷积分类器；7名自适应组完成3周9次训练，每次分析一次动作捕捉；比较更新模型与母模型；比较自适应组与10名对照的额面踝角。
AI.result: AUROC 0.948，BAD敏感度0.941，GOOD特异度0.366；更新模型BAD类F1更高（同次0.187，后续0.118）；Post时自适应组额面踝角较对照低5.168度（95%CI 1.766-8.569），Retention不确定。
AI.conclusion: 描述了群体模型判别与离线个体更新，并发现非随机Post踝角关联；未建立独立临床步态分类或更新的因果收益。

title: Hybrid Latent Attention for Looped Language Models
summary: Looped language models apply the same stack of layers T times to each token, which deepens the model without adding parameters but multiplies its key-value (KV) cache by T. The larger cache limits how many sequences a GPU can decode at once and slows each decoding step, which reads the whole cache. We propose Hybrid Latent Attention (HLA), which keeps exact keys and values within a sliding window of W recent tokens and stores each older token as a compact latent that the query of each loop reads directly, without reconstructing keys and values. We uptrain HLA on Ouro looped models (T=4) with 1.4B and 2.6B parameters, keeping the pretrained weights frozen and training only the added parameters to reproduce the original attention. The cache shrinks by 10.7x per token, fitting 4.0-8.8x as many concurrent sequences per GPU, and decoding throughput improves by 2.5x at 1K-token contexts and by up to 7.4x at 16K. HLA retains over 97% of the original accuracy on math, knowledge and reasoning benchmarks, and 96-100% on long-context retrieval up to 16K tokens. After supervised fine-tuning, it performs on par with the fine-tuned original model on competition-level math.

AI.tldr: 提出混合潜在注意力HLA，通过在滑动窗口内保留精确KV、将旧token压缩为latent来大幅缩减循环语言模型的KV缓存，兼顾效率与精度。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型对每个token重复应用同一组层T次，加深了模型但不增加参数，却使KV缓存扩大T倍。更大的缓存限制了GPU可同时解码的序列数，并因每次解码需读取整个缓存而拖慢速度。
AI.method: HLA在W个近期token的滑动窗口内保留精确的key和value，将每个更早的token存为紧凑latent，由每次循环的查询直接读取，不重构key和value。在Ouro循环模型（T=4）上对1.4B和2.6B参数模型进行uptrain，冻结预训练权重，仅训练新增参数以复现原注意力。
AI.result: 每token缓存缩减10.7倍，每GPU可容纳4.0-8.8倍并发序列；1K上下文解码吞吐提升2.5倍，16K下最高提升7.4倍。数学、知识和推理基准上保留超过97%原精度，16K以内长上下文检索保留96-100%。监督微调后在竞赛级数学任务上与微调后的原模型持平。
AI.conclusion: HLA在几乎不损失精度的前提下显著降低了循环语言模型的KV缓存开销并提升解码效率，是一种有效的循环模型加速方案。

title: When Does AI Supervision Help? A Role-Aware Study of Network Fraud Decision Management with Blockchain Auditability
summary: When does a second artificial intelligence (AI) component improve a primary network-fraud decision rather than add operational burden? We study this question through a role-aware Decider-Supervisor (DS) framework with blockchain auditability, evaluating four directional configurations that combine centralised machine learning, a Federated Averaging (FedAvg)-trained federated meta-model, and Base or Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) large language model variants. The analysis compares primary-only and supervised decisions using non-hard fraud performance, intervention burden, conditional calibration, traffic-mix and Review-capacity sensitivity, dependability tests, and blockchain lifecycle controls. The deterministic hard gate resolves 89.994% of fraudulent requests, leaving the non-hard population as the main AI decision setting. Conditional validation calibration does not produce a consistently transferable supervisory advantage on deployment replay. DS-3 QLoRA is the least disruptive supervised configuration, but it still underperforms its primary FedAvg stage in F1 and total errors. Across 36 reweighted traffic mixtures, supervision reduces total errors only for DS-4 Base in two extreme high-fraud scenarios. Blockchain tests support digest verification, tamper detection, authorisation, single-use review resolution, and post-finalisation integrity, while exposing a pre-finalisation single-write limitation. The results show that the value of AI supervision depends on role assignment, calibration, escalation policy, traffic composition, and lifecycle controls rather than on the presence of a second model alone.

AI.tldr: 本文通过角色感知的Decider-Supervisor框架研究第二个AI组件何时能改善网络欺诈决策，发现其价值取决于角色分配、校准、升级策略、流量构成与生命周期控制，而非单纯增加第二个模型。
AI.motivation: 探究引入第二个AI组件是否能真正改善主网络欺诈决策，还是仅增加运营负担，明确其有效条件。
AI.method: 提出带区块链审计能力的角色感知Decider-Supervisor框架，评估四种方向性配置，结合集中式ML、FedAvg联邦元模型及Base/QLoRA大语言模型变体，并进行非硬欺诈性能、干预负担、条件校准、流量混合与审查容量敏感性、可靠性及区块链生命周期控制等分析。
AI.result: 确定性硬门控解决89.994%欺诈请求；条件验证校准未带来一致可迁移的监督优势；DS-3 QLoRA干扰最小但仍不如其FedAvg主阶段；36种流量混合中仅DS-4 Base在两种极端高欺诈场景降低总错误；区块链测试支持多项完整性控制但暴露预最终化单写限制。
AI.conclusion: AI监督的价值取决于角色分配、校准、升级策略、流量构成与生命周期控制，而非仅存在第二个模型。

title: Reward-Driven Learning under Prompt-Level Differential Privacy
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains a language model on problems that may themselves be confidential, and the trained model can reveal which problems it saw. We study RLVR under prompt-level differential privacy: the released weights must be (ε,δ)-differentially private with respect to the presence of any one training problem. Taking the group of responses to one prompt as the privacy record, our method aggregates their gradients, clips the prompt's contribution once, adds Gaussian noise, and composes the privacy loss across updates, so the budget depends on neither the number of responses per prompt nor the clipping norm; to our knowledge this is the first differential privacy guarantee for RLVR training. We train Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct with LoRA at a per-run budget of ε=8 and compare, on the same prompts and at the same budget, a control that removes only the reward signal and two private supervised fine-tuning recipes. The reward signal improves accuracy over the control by 2.65 points on MATH and 3.24 on GSM8K, in every seed; the improvement survives a format-robust scorer, at 1.3 points on MATH, and is not explained by response length. At the same budget the private model outperforms both supervised recipes on MATH and GSM8K by 2.3 to 3.8 points, retains 85--90% of the gain of non-private GRPO on these tasks, and on MATH the noise of an eightfold tighter budget costs at most 1.2 points. The reward effect also carries to CommonsenseQA, an exploratory non-mathematical task. Verifier feedback thus remains a usable learning signal under prompt-level privacy.

AI.tldr: 本文首次为RLVR训练提供提示级差分隐私保证，在ε=8预算下验证奖励信号仍能有效提升模型数学推理能力。
AI.motivation: RLVR训练所用问题可能本身是保密的，训练后的模型会泄露它见过哪些问题，因此需要在提示级差分隐私下研究RLVR的可行性。
AI.method: 将同一提示的所有响应作为一个隐私记录，聚合梯度后对提示贡献只剪裁一次并加入高斯噪声，跨更新组合隐私损失；预算不依赖响应数量或剪裁范数。用LoRA在ε=8下训练Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct，并与去除奖励信号的对照组及两种私有SFT配方比较。
AI.result: 奖励信号相比对照在MATH提升2.65分、GSM8K提升3.24分且每个随机种子都成立；格式鲁棒评分器下MATH仍提升1.3分，且不能由响应长度解释。同预算下私有模型在MATH和GSM8K上比两种SFT配方高2.3~3.8分，保留非私有GRPO 85~90%的增益；预算收紧八倍在MATH上最多损失1.2分。奖励效应还能迁移到CommonsenseQA。
AI.conclusion: 在提示级隐私约束下，验证器反馈仍是可用的学习信号，RLVR可在差分隐私下有效训练。

title: Structured but Silent: Probing Capability Requirements in LLM Hidden States
summary: Reliable tool use requires more than triggering a mechanism or matching a query to an API description. Before selecting a specific tool, an agent must first infer the capability requirements implied by the user query. In this paper, we investigate whether these query-side capability requirements are linearly decodable from LLM hidden representations prior to generation, and how this hidden-state accessibility compares with explicit verbal classification. We introduce TACIT, a framework that decomposes external requirements along three fundamental axes: Source, Transformation, and World Effect, defining eight structurally distinct capability classes. Using 1,600 balanced training queries from benchmarks, synthetic examples, and new domain scenarios, we train linear probes on pre-generation hidden states from four open-weight LLM families. Our empirical results demonstrate that fine-grained capability structures are linearly decodable with high accuracy across all models. Crucially, however, we expose a representation-to-verbalization gap: these same models are significantly less reliable when asked to explicitly classify the same queries in natural language. This disconnect indicates that information about required external capabilities is linearly accessible in LLM hidden representations but not reliably expressed, a phenomenon we define as "structured but silent."

AI.tldr: 研究用户查询所需的"能力需求"能否在LLM生成前的隐状态中被线性解码，并对比其与显式语言分类的差异。
AI.motivation: 可靠的工具使用不仅需要触发机制或匹配API描述，还需在选工具前推断查询蕴含的能力需求。作者想探究这些需求是否可从隐状态线性解码，以及"隐状态可及性"与显式语言分类的对比。
AI.method: 提出TACIT框架，将外部需求分解为Source、Transformation、World Effect三个轴，定义8类结构不同的能力类。用来自基准、合成样例和新领域场景的1,600条平衡训练查询，在4个开源权重LLM家族生成前的隐状态上训练线性探针。
AI.result: 细粒度能力结构在所有模型上都能以高准确率线性解码；但同一批模型在自然语言显式分类同一查询时可靠性显著更低，出现"表示-语言化差距"。
AI.conclusion: 所需外部能力的信息在LLM隐状态中线性可及，却无法被可靠表达，作者将其定义为"structured but silent"（结构存在但沉默）现象。

title: Constant-Curvature Sliced Gromov-Wasserstein for Heterogeneous Cross-Curvature Alignment
summary: Recent advances in representation learning have highlighted the utility of constant-curvature models, such as hyperbolic and spherical spaces, for modeling complex data. Mixed-curvature models further enhance this by integrating multiple constant-curvature components. However, these models typically learn each component space independently because spaces with different curvatures are inherently heterogeneous and lack a unified metric. Consequently, they lack explicit mechanisms to enforce geometric consistency across various spaces. Moreover, the problem of comparing probability distributions across mixed-curvature spaces remains unexplored. To compare distributions on heterogeneous spaces, Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) distances provide a principled framework by aligning their intra-space geometries. Building on this, we propose constant-curvature sliced Gromov-Wasserstein (CCSGW), a novel divergence for aligning distributions supported on heterogeneous constant-curvature spaces. We first introduce the missing geodesic-based one-dimensional projections for spherical spaces, and then extend sliced GW to constant-curvature spaces, enabling efficient and principled comparison across manifolds with different curvatures. This formulation preserves intrinsic geometric relationships while avoiding the high computational cost. We provide theoretical analysis showing that CCSGW controls intrinsic geometric discrepancy across heterogeneous spaces, promoting distribution-level geometric consistency. By integrating CCSGW into existing mixed-curvature learning tasks, including graph anomaly detection, graph node classification, and multimodal learning, we observe consistent performance gains across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: 提出CCSGW——面向异构常曲率空间的切片Gromov-Wasserstein散度，通过补齐球面一维投影并推广切片GW实现跨曲率分布对齐，理论与实验均有收益。
AI.motivation: 混合曲率模型整合多个常曲率分量，但各分量独立学习（不同曲率空间异构、无统一度量），缺乏跨空间几何一致性约束；且异构曲率空间间如何比较概率分布尚未被探索。
AI.method: 以GW距离为对齐框架，提出CCSGW：先引入球面缺失的基于测地线的一维投影，再将切片GW扩展到常曲率空间，实现不同曲率流形间高效、有原则的分布比较，保留内在几何关系并避免高计算成本。
AI.result: 理论分析表明CCSGW可控制异构空间间内在几何差异、促进分布级几何一致性；将其集成到图异常检测、图节点分类和多模态学习等混合曲率任务中，在多种设置下均获得一致性能提升。
AI.conclusion: CCSGW为异构常曲率空间上的分布对齐提供了有原则且高效的散度度量，可用于增强现有混合曲率学习任务的性能。

title: The Labeling Problem in Hallucination Detection Benchmarks: An Empirical Evaluation
comment: 27 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations & Datasets Track. Data: https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/PCHISZ. Code: https://github.com/jova486/LPHB
summary: In recent years, several methods for detecting when large language models (LLMs) hallucinate have been developed. These methods are often benchmarked with open-domain question answering (QA) datasets containing questions and corresponding short reference answers. First, an LLM is used to generate answers to questions within the QA dataset. Then, some automated labeling strategy is used to label these answers as hallucinated or not by comparing them with the reference answers in the dataset. This evaluation setting creates a methodological ambiguity between two criteria: reference faithfulness (whether the answer is fully supported by the reference) and factual correctness (whether the answer is free from contradictions and factually false specific claims). In practice, automated labelers may apply the former criterion even when the intended target is the latter. We study this potential criterion mismatch using 900 human-labeled question-answer pairs spanning three commonly used QA datasets and three generator models, with labels targeting answer-level factual correctness. We evaluate lexical similarity metrics, a reference-entailment NLI baseline, and seven LLM judges under controlled prompt variants as automated labelers. Our experiments reveal substantial disagreement both among automated labeling strategies and between these labels and human annotations. Many strategies also exhibit strong directional error biases, and for most judge-generator pairs, replacing a faithfulness-oriented prompt with a factual-correctness prompt improves agreement with human annotations and reduces false-positive dominance, indicating that automated hallucination labels depend strongly on how the target criterion is specified. Label-source choice should therefore be considered a fundamental part of benchmark design and made explicit, validated, and matched with the benchmark goal.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM幻觉检测评测中自动标注准则的混淆问题：参考忠实性(reference faithfulness)与事实正确性(factual correctness)被混用，导致基准标签不可靠。作者用900个人工标注的QA对评估多种自动标注策略，发现自动标注之间及与人工标注均存在显著分歧，且改用事实正确性提示能改善一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM幻觉检测方法的评测流程（生成答案→用参考答案自动标注是否幻觉）在方法论上模糊了两个不同准则：一是答案是否被参考答案完全支持（参考忠实性），二是答案是否事实无误（事实正确性）。实践中自动标注器常把前者当作后者使用，可能造成准则错配，从而影响基准结论的有效性。
AI.method: 作者构建了900个人工标注的问答对，覆盖三个常用QA数据集和三种生成模型，标注目标为答案层面的事实正确性。然后评估多类自动标注策略：词汇相似度指标、基于参考蕴含的NLI基线，以及七个LLM评判器，并在受控的提示变体（忠实性导向 vs. 事实正确性导向）下进行对比，考察其与人工标注的一致性及错误偏向。
AI.result: 实验发现：(1) 不同自动标注策略之间存在大量分歧，且与人工标注也不一致；(2) 许多策略表现出强烈的方向性错误偏差（如假阳性占主导）；(3) 对多数“评判器-生成器”组合，将忠实性导向提示替换为事实正确性提示后，与人工标注的一致度提升、假阳性主导现象减弱。说明自动幻觉标签强烈依赖目标准则的表述方式。
AI.conclusion: 自动幻觉标注的选择（标签来源）应被视为基准设计的根本组成部分，需明确说明、验证，并与基准目标相匹配，否则评测结果可能产生误导。作者呼吁在基准构建中显式区分并指定所采用的准则。

title: COMPASS: Finding Where Reasoning Lives in Language Models
summary: Explicitly eliciting reasoning substantially improves LLM performance. Existing approaches require a predefined characterization of reasoning, whether through CoT prompt design, contrastive CoT directions, or via SAE derived reasoning features. For mathematical reasoning with verifiable answers, we show that a much simpler signal suffices, which is the correctness of the model's own direct answer attempts. This signal yields a latent direction that elicits reasoning. This direction is decodable within the activations of most attention heads, but only a small subset of them can be effectively intervened. We introduce COMPASS, an inference-time steering method that identifies these heads using a logit-space attribution score and steers their activations along the correctness direction, requiring only per-head activation statistics. Across three model families and multiple math benchmarks, COMPASS outperforms the activation-steering baselines we compare against, improves GSM8K accuracy by 16 percentage points on average, and approaches CoT accuracy with 20-70\% fewer generated tokens. Interventions transfer without re-fitting to unseen benchmarks, and ablations show that both the correctness direction and the small set of heads carrying it are necessary, with the effect concentrated in remarkably few heads.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COMPASS，一种利用模型自身直接答案正确性作为信号、在注意力头上进行激活干预的推理引导方法，性能优于基线且更省token。
AI.motivation: 现有引导LLM推理的方法需要预定义推理特征（如CoT提示设计、对比CoT方向、SAE推理特征），较为复杂。作者希望证明对于有可验证答案的数学推理，一个更简单的信号——模型直接答案的正确性——就足够引导推理。
AI.method: 基于模型自身直接答案尝试的正确性构造潜方向；发现该方向在多数注意力头激活中可解码但仅少数头可有效干预；提出COMPASS，用logit空间归因分数识别这些头，并沿正确性方向引导其激活，仅需每头激活统计。
AI.result: 在三个模型家族和多个数学基准上，COMPASS优于所比较的激活引导基线；GSM8K平均提升16个百分点，接近CoT精度且生成token减少20-70%；干预可迁移到未见基准；消融显示正确性方向与携带它的少数头均必要。
AI.conclusion: 直接答案正确性是引导数学推理的充分信号，且干预效果集中在极少数注意力头上，实现高效、可迁移的推理引导。

title: Data, Numbers, and Geometry: Three Tutorials on Numerical Methods, Machine Learning, and Evaluation
comment: Combined notes from three tutorials presented at the DANGER: Data, Numbers, and Geometry workshop (BIRS, Banff, April 2026). Includes links to companion code, Jupyter notebooks, and exercises
summary: We present three practical tutorials on numerical computation and machine learning for mathematical research, developed for the DANGER: Data, Numbers, and Geometry workshop held at the Banff International Research Station in April 2026. The first develops a numerical approach to exterior calculus from pointwise evaluations of differential forms, using a flux formulation of the exterior derivative. Examples in Euclidean space and on the sphere illustrate geometric identities, topological features, and the effects of approximation and finite precision. The second examines how mathematical structure guides neural network design through examples involving elliptic curves, quivers, and a boundary value problem. It explores how architectural choices affect learning and uses interval arithmetic to bound the residual of a trained network over the full interval of the boundary value problem. The third addresses the evaluation and presentation of machine learning results, covering performance metrics, statistical uncertainty, classification thresholds, receiver operating characteristic curves, and accessible figure design. Throughout, the tutorials distinguish numerical agreement, predictive accuracy, structural guarantees, and rigorous bounds as different forms of evidence. Each contribution can be read independently, with accompanying notebooks and exercises that allow readers to reproduce the examples and adapt the methods to other problems.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍三个面向数学研究的数值计算与机器学习实践教程（源自2026年BIRS DANGER工作坊），涵盖外微积分的数值方法、数学结构引导的神经网络设计，以及机器学习结果的评估与呈现，并强调数值一致、预测精度、结构保证与严格界等不同证据形式。
AI.motivation: 为数学研究者提供数值计算与机器学习的实用教程，帮助其区分并正确运用不同形式的计算证据，并配有可复现的笔记本与练习以便推广到其他问题。
AI.method: 教程一从微分形式的逐点求值出发，采用外微分的通量表述数值求解外微积分；教程二通过椭圆曲线、箭图与边值问题探讨数学结构如何引导网络设计，并用区间算术界定训练网络在边值问题整个区间上的残差；教程三讲解性能指标、统计不确定性、分类阈值、ROC曲线及图表设计。
AI.result: 通过欧氏空间与球面示例展示几何恒等式、拓扑特征及近似与有限精度的影响；展示架构选择对学习的影响及残差的区间界定；并给出机器学习结果评估与可视化的方法。各教程可独立阅读，配有笔记本与练习。
AI.conclusion: 该工作强调数值一致、预测精度、结构保证与严格界是不同形式的证据，为数学研究中的数值计算与机器学习应用提供了可独立使用、可复现的教程资源。

title: Are Language Models Script-Aware?
summary: Language models frequently generate outputs in unintended languages or scripts, a phenomenon known as off-target generation. While existing research has focused on language selection, the dimension of script knowledge remains understudied: before any linguistic understanding can occur, users must recognize the graphic symbols in a model's response. We investigate whether Small and Large Language Models (SLMs and LLMs) possess script knowledge by testing them on multi-scriptic languages. Through two complementary experiments, we evaluate whether models (1) adapt their output script to match the input, and (2) follow explicit instructions to generate text in a specified script. The models we tested demonstrate substantial script knowledge: they all achieve a near-perfect Latin script fidelity (more than 98%) and follow script instructions with high frequency. Nevertheless, we notice differences between LLMs and SLMs, with higher scores for LLMs including for non-standard script combinations.

AI.tldr: 研究检验了SLM和LLM在多文字语言中的"文字知识"，通过两个实验评估模型是否能随输入调整输出文字、以及是否遵循指定文字的指令。
AI.motivation: 语言模型常产生非预期语言或文字的"偏离目标生成"，现有研究多关注语言选择，忽略了文字知识这一维度：用户需先识别响应中的图形符号才能进行语言理解。
AI.method: 在多文字语言上对SLM和LLM进行两个互补实验：(1)测试模型是否将输出文字适配为与输入一致；(2)测试模型是否遵循显式指令用指定文字生成文本。
AI.result: 所测模型展现出显著的文字知识：所有模型达到近乎完美的拉丁文字保真度（>98%），并高频遵循文字指令。LLM得分高于SLM，包括非标准文字组合情况。
AI.conclusion: SLM和LLM普遍具备文字知识，但LLM总体更强，尤其在非标准文字组合上表现更优。

title: PsyCIDRA: A Dual-Agent Framework for Psychiatric Interviewing and Diagnostic Reasoning
summary: Large language models show promise in clinical reasoning, but psychiatric interviewing requires guiding an evolving conversation. Their ability to carry out this interactive assessment remains less studied. We present PsyCIDRA, a dual-agent framework linking free-form psychiatric interviewing with diagnostic reasoning for expert review. Its interviewer agent uses tools to maintain working notes, load expert-written skills, and retrieve ICD-11 references to guide inquiry. Its diagnostic reasoning agent then receives the completed interview transcript and reports hypotheses alongside supporting, conflicting, and missing evidence, withholding a final hypothesis when none is sufficiently supported. Using patient profiles generated with PsyCPG, we first evaluate PsyCIDRA in simulation. Across four models on 53 evaluation cases, it achieves higher diagnostic agreement than direct prompting. On 81 held-out simulated cases, rank-1 accuracy is 60.5% versus 51.9%. In a blinded study of 101 human participants in separate arms, PsyCIDRA agrees with psychologists on whether to propose a diagnostic hypothesis in 79.6% of cases, compared with 65.4% for direct prompting. Together, these findings support the potential of LLM agents to assist psychiatric assessment through free-form dialogue. By examining diagnostic reasoning, interview quality, and safety together, this study contributes to understanding the capabilities and limitations of psychiatric interview agents.

AI.tldr: PsyCIDRA是一个双智能体框架，将自由形式的精神科访谈与诊断推理相结合，在模拟与人体研究中均优于直接提示。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在临床推理中展现潜力，但精神科访谈需要引导不断演变的对话，其交互式评估能力研究不足。
AI.method: 采用双智能体设计：访谈智能体通过工具维护工作笔记、加载专家编写技能、检索ICD-11参考来引导问诊；诊断推理智能体接收完整访谈记录，报告假设及支持、冲突与缺失证据，证据不足时不给出最终假设。使用PsyCPG生成的患者画像进行模拟评估。
AI.result: 在53个评估案例、四个模型上，诊断一致性高于直接提示；在81个留出模拟案例中，rank-1准确率60.5%对51.9%。101名人类参与者的盲法研究中，PsyCIDRA在是否提出诊断假设上与心理学家一致率79.6%，直接提示为65.4%。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体有潜力通过自由对话辅助精神科评估；通过同时考察诊断推理、访谈质量与安全性，有助于理解精神科访谈智能体的能力与局限。

title: Minimal Witness Reinforcement Learning
summary: ``What are the irreducible conditions that are sufficient to produce an outcome?'' is one of the most common questions that recur across computation and science. Its answers, the minimal sufficient witnesses, are what we mean by explanations, mechanisms and reasons. These problems usually ask for multiple minimal witnesses, yet standard RL methods may reveal only one solution or redundant ones. We formalize this problem as minimal-witness identification and introduce Minimal-Witness Reinforcement Learning (MWRL). MWRL takes the union of the sets certified by successful proposals sampled from the policy and credits each proposal for the coverage the group union would lose without that proposal. This credit assignment, derived directly from the problem definition, unifies the demands for minimality and recovery of alternatives from a single black-box verifier bit. Under this principle, we derive a value iteration planner that recovers the entire family of witnesses and a policy gradient method that can scale to large language models. Across different experimental settings, MWRL recovers most minimal witnesses, while other methods return redundant supersets or a single witness. By making witness families learnable from verifier feedback, MWRL expands the scope of reinforcement learning beyond single-solution optimization. Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/MWRL.

AI.tldr: 论文提出最小见证识别问题，并给出MWRL（最小见证强化学习）方法，通过集合覆盖信用分配，从单个验证器比特中学到完整的极小见证族。
AI.motivation: 许多计算与科学问题需要找到产生结果的不可约充分条件（即最小见证/解释/机制），通常存在多个最小见证；但标准RL方法只能找到一个解或产生冗余解。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为最小见证识别，提出MWRL：对策略采样得到的成功提案集合取并集，依据去掉某提案后组并集覆盖损失进行信用分配（直接源自问题定义），统一了最小性与替代方案恢复。据此推导出可恢复完整见证族的值迭代规划器，以及可扩展到LLM的策略梯度方法。
AI.result: 在不同实验设置下，MWRL能恢复大多数最小见证，而其他方法只返回冗余超集或单一见证。
AI.conclusion: 使见证族可从验证器反馈中学习，将强化学习扩展到超越单解优化的范围。

title: Language Carries the Expert's Impression: Instrument-Anchored LLM Judges Transfer Counseling-Quality Assessment and Beat In-Domain Training
summary: Automatic assessment of communication quality in dyadic counseling conversations is bottlenecked by data: expert-rated corpora are small and expensive to grow. We study cross-domain transfer of expert overall-impression prediction across three German corpora of simulated counseling (two general-practice medical, one school-related parent-teacher; $n=195$ expert-rated sessions, one corpus after scale equating). Training on the other domains beats training in-domain: leave-one-domain-out transfer reaches nested Spearman $ρ= 0.54$ against $\le 0.48$ within the target domain, a paired session-level gap of $+0.15$ that holds at $+0.12$ when the training-set sizes are matched, so it is not simply data volume. The decisive features are session-level construct scores from small open-weight LLMs reading the two-speaker transcript, with the constructs largely derived from the experts' rating instruments: the instrument-derived battery lifts a single judge from $0.32$ to $0.41$ over generic dialogue qualities, judges from three model families ensemble to $0.51$ language-only, and a nonverbal-dyadic block adds $+0.03$ more, not separable from noise at this sample size. We also price the recording setup: one corpus lost its per-speaker audio, 16% of its diarised segments carry the wrong speaker, and repair is worth $+0.07$ there. At practically attainable corpus sizes, the expert's overall impression is carried by what is said, and by other communication programs' data more than by one's own.

AI.tldr: 本文研究模拟咨询对话中专家整体印象评分的跨域迁移，发现用其他领域的语料训练比用目标域自身训练效果更好。
AI.motivation: 专家标注的咨询对话语料稀缺且扩充成本高昂，自动评估沟通质量受限于数据瓶颈，因此探索跨域迁移以缓解数据不足问题。
AI.method: 在三个德语模拟咨询语料（两个全科医疗、一个家长-教师，共195场专家评分会话，其中一个经量表等值化）上做留一域外的跨域迁移实验；使用小型开放式权重LLM阅读双说话人转录文本，提取源自专家评分工具的会话级构念分数，并与通用对话质量、多模型家族集成、非言语-二元特征块及录音设置修复进行对比。
AI.result: 跨域迁移的嵌套Spearman ρ达0.54，优于目标域内训练的≤0.48，配对会话级差距+0.15（训练集规模匹配后仍为+0.12）；工具衍生的构念电池将单一评判者从0.32提升到0.41，三模型家族集成达0.51（仅语言），非言语-二元特征块仅增加+0.03（本样本量下与噪声不可分）；某语料丢失逐说话人音频、16%说话人分离片段标注错误，修复后可获+0.07提升。
AI.conclusion: 在实际可达到的语料规模下，专家的整体印象主要由"说了什么"承载，且其他沟通研究项目的数据比自身领域数据更有价值。

title: In With the Old: Enhancing 'Classical' Document Automation with Generative AI
comment: 10 pages. AI for Access to Justice Workshop at ICAIL 2025
summary: Software-based legal assistance systems have leveraged many different forms of knowledge representation and reasoning. This article explores how document automation services rooted in expert system style and other symbolic approaches can usefully enhance and be enhanced by current generative AI approaches. We discuss the possible benefits and challenges, and report on preliminary experiments in using large language models to identify and fix issues in texts written by laypeople.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨基于专家系统等符号方法的法律文档自动化服务与当前生成式AI如何互补增强，并报告了使用大语言模型识别与修正外行人所写文本问题的初步实验。
AI.motivation: 软件法律辅助系统已采用多种知识表示与推理形式；作者希望厘清传统符号式（专家系统风格）文档自动化方法与当下生成式AI之间的关系，探索二者结合的潜力与挑战。
AI.method: 概念性分析结合初步实验：分析符号式文档自动化与生成式AI相互增强的可能收益与挑战；并用大语言模型识别和修正外行人所写文本中的问题。
AI.result: 报告了使用大语言模型识别并修正外行人文本问题的初步实验结果，并讨论了结合的潜在收益与挑战。
AI.conclusion: 基于专家系统的符号式文档自动化与生成式AI可以相互补充、相互增强，值得进一步研究其融合方式。

title: DirectSpeech2LLM: A Simple End-to-End Framework to Mitigate Prompt Overfitting in Speech-LLMs
summary: Speech-LLMs often exhibit prompt overfitting, where models solely trained on automatic speech recognition (ASR) instruction fail to generalize to new instructions such as speech translation and continue to behave primarily as ASR system. We propose DirectSpeech2LLM, a simple end-to-end framework that preserves the instruction-following ability of the LLM on unseen tasks when conditioned on speech. It computes distance-based CTC loss over the frozen LLM embedding matrix and uses greedy CTC labels to derive geometrically and temporally aligned speech embeddings respectively as an input to the LLM. Trained solely on 960 hours of LibriSpeech ASR data, DirectSpeech2LLM outperforms the cascaded system on ASR (seen task) and generalizes zero-shot to speech translation and emotion recognition (two unseen tasks), closely matching the cascaded system upper bound on these two new instructions despite seeing neither during training. We also find that geometric alignment strength plays a smaller role than previously assumed, as our modified CTC loss is shown to provide sufficient implicit geometric grounding without requiring an explicit regression loss. Results are consistent across two LLM families and scale with both more training data and model capacity.

AI.tldr: 提出 DirectSpeech2LLM，一种端到端框架，仅用 ASR 数据训练即可让语音-LLM 在未见指令（语音翻译、情感识别）上保持指令跟随能力，缓解 prompt overfitting。
AI.motivation: 语音-LLM 存在 prompt overfitting：仅在 ASR 指令上训练后，模型无法泛化到语音翻译等新指令，仍表现得像纯 ASR 系统。
AI.method: 端到端框架：在冻结的 LLM 嵌入矩阵上计算基于距离的 CTC 损失；用贪心 CTC 标签导出几何与时间对齐的语音嵌入，作为 LLM 输入。仅用 960 小时 LibriSpeech ASR 数据训练，无需显式回归损失。
AI.result: 在 ASR（已见任务）上优于级联系统，并零样本泛化到语音翻译和情感识别（两个未见任务），接近级联上界；跨两种 LLM 家族结果一致，且随训练数据与模型容量扩展而提升。
AI.conclusion: 改进的 CTC 损失可提供充分的隐式几何接地，几何对齐强度作用小于以往假设；该框架有效缓解 prompt overfitting，具备良好泛化性与扩展性。

title: SAGE: Semantic Anchor-Guided Evolution for Grounded Medical QA Data Synthesis
summary: Developing reliable models for clinical tasks, such as Medical Question Answering (QA), is severely constrained by the limited availability of high-quality, expert-annotated training data. This challenge is exacerbated by stringent privacy requirements and the impracticality of utilizing large open-source corpora or proprietary cloud APIs within resource-limited clinical settings. To address these obstacles, we introduce SAGE (\textit{Semantic Anchor-Guided Evolution}), a novel data synthesis framework that enables small, locally deployed models to generate high-quality medical training data. SAGE leverages lightweight, publicly available taxonomies such as MeSH as semantic anchors, imposing a structured prior to effectively guide and ground the data generation process. At its core, SAGE iteratively interleaves atomic (individual concept-based) and associative (relation-based) synthesis, bootstrapping training data from minimal seeds. This approach eliminates the need for large collections of medical documents or reliance on external APIs, providing a practical solution for on-premises data creation. Extensive experiments across multiple medical question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that models fine-tuned with SAGE-synthesized data consistently outperform those trained using self-derived or conventional document-based paradigms, highlighting tangible improvements in data efficiency and resource utilization for medical LLM development. Code is available at https://github.com/DIaacKr/SAGE.

AI.tldr: SAGE是一个数据合成框架，利用MeSH等轻量级公共分类法作为语义锚点，引导本地小模型迭代生成高质量医学问答训练数据，无需大量医学文档或外部API。
AI.motivation: 临床任务（如医学问答）缺乏高质量专家标注数据，且隐私要求严格，在资源受限的临床环境中难以使用大型开源语料库或专有云API。
AI.method: 提出SAGE（语义锚点引导进化），利用MeSH等公共轻量级分类法作为语义锚点施加结构化先验，迭代交错进行原子级（基于单个概念）与联想级（基于关系）合成，从极少种子数据引导生成训练数据。
AI.result: 在多个医学问答基准测试上，用SAGE合成数据微调的模型一致优于自生成或传统基于文档范式训练的模型，在数据效率和资源利用上有明显提升。
AI.conclusion: SAGE为本地化数据创建提供了实用方案，无需大量医学文档或外部API依赖，有助于医学LLM在资源受限场景下的开发。

title: MARS: Multi-resolution Adaptive Routing for Sequential Recommendation
summary: Long-history recommenders often compress each user's history into a compact, candidate-independent memory that is cached and reused to score large candidate pools. We show that real user histories exhibit multi-scale semantic structure, with short-lived intent, medium-term interests, and long-term preferences coexisting in one sequence, and that monolithic cached memories preserve these scales unevenly: linear probes recover recent and mid-range content far worse than long-range content. We call this failure mode \textit{temporal aliasing}. We propose \textbf{MARS}, a multi-resolution user memory that writes the full history into recurrent state tracks anchored to different half-lives, and a sparse routing reader that materializes compact seed memories by selecting the relevant temporal resolutions for each seed, preserving fixed-size candidate scoring. MARS outperforms strong baselines on three public datasets, with gains that grow with history length. Component-matched ablations with paired tests show that temporal diversity and selective routing each contribute beyond what hard-window memories or added capacity provide. The advantage of MARS over its interface-matched baseline also widens after within-user behavioral shifts, at about $1.02\times$ that baseline's warm-cache serving latency for $1{,}000$ candidates per user.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MARS，一种多分辨率用户记忆机制，解决长期历史推荐中缓存记忆的"时序混叠"问题，通过多衰减率循环状态和稀疏路由读取得以固定成本评分，显著优于基线且增益随历史增长。
AI.motivation: 现有长期历史推荐器将用户历史压缩为单一的、与候选无关的紧凑缓存记忆，但真实用户历史包含短期意图、中期兴趣和长期偏好等多尺度语义结构。单一记忆对这种多尺度结构保留不均衡，线性探针显示近期和中期内容恢复远差于长期内容，作者称此为"时序混叠"。
AI.method: MARS写入完整历史到锚定不同半衰期的多个循环状态轨道（多分辨率记忆），并用稀疏路由读取器为每个种子选择相关时间分辨率，生成紧凑种子记忆，从而保持固定规模的候选评分。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集上优于强基线，增益随历史长度增加而扩大；组件匹配的消融配对检验表明时序多样性和选择性路由各自贡献超出硬窗口记忆或单纯增加容量；在用户内部行为转变后优势进一步扩大；每用户1,000候选的暖缓存服务延迟约为基线的1.02倍。
AI.conclusion: 多分辨率、可选择性路由的用户记忆能更均衡地保留不同时间尺度的语义结构，以近乎相同的服务成本显著提升长期历史推荐效果。

title: Learning What to Distill: Bilevel Top-K Token Selection for Self-Distillation in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models have shown strong reasoning capabilities, but their high inference costs make knowledge distillation an important approach for transferring such capabilities to compact models in resource-constrained scenarios. On-policy self-distillation further reduces the reliance on external large teacher models while improving the reasoning ability of compact language models. However, existing methods typically either distill all token positions uniformly or select tokens using fixed heuristic criteria, assigning the same distillation strength to the selected positions rather than adaptively learning which tokens are most beneficial for distillation. To address these limitations, we propose BiToK-SD (Bilevel Top-K Token Selection for Self-Distillation), a bilevel-optimization-based token selection method that learns where distillation should be applied during on-policy self-distillation. Specifically, BiToK-SD is formulated as a bilevel optimization problem, where the lower-level problem models Top-K token selection as a differentiable threshold-based relaxation, allowing the selected positions to adapt as the student policy evolves, while the upper-level problem performs knowledge distillation on the selected positions. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that BiToK-SD achieves the best average performance among all compared methods while requiring only lightweight additional computation.

AI.tldr: 提出BiToK-SD，用双层优化自适应学习自蒸馏中应施加蒸馏的token位置。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy自蒸馏方法对所有token均匀蒸馏或用固定启发式选token，并对选中位置赋予相同蒸馏强度，无法自适应判断哪些token最有益。
AI.method: 将Top-K token选择建模为双层优化：下层用可微阈值松弛实现Top-K选择，使选中位置随学生策略演化而自适应；上层在选中位置上执行知识蒸馏。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上，BiToK-SD在所有对比方法中取得最佳平均性能，且仅需轻量额外计算。
AI.conclusion: BiToK-SD通过双层优化的自适应token选择有效提升紧凑模型自蒸馏推理能力，兼顾性能与效率。

title: Penalty-Framed No-Valid-Option MCQA: Analyzing LLM Abstention under Invalid Choices
comment: Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Main Conference (Short Paper)
summary: Multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) is commonly used to evaluate large language models under the assumption that one of the provided options is correct, typically using answer-selection accuracy. However, in real deployments, users or retrieval systems may provide invalid option sets in which none of the listed choices is correct, and selecting one of them may incur downstream cost. We study this setting as penalty-framed no-valid-option MCQA. Using the mathematics subset of MMLU-Pro, we remove the labeled correct option, allow models to either choose a remaining option or output ABSTAIN, and penalize invalid forced-choice responses. We further introduce correct-conditioned analysis, evaluating abstention only on instances that the model originally answered correctly. Experiments show that high MCQA accuracy does not fully guarantee abstention reliability: even under explicit no-valid-option-aware instructions and penalty-based scoring, models still produce invalid forced-choice responses for a subset of originally correct instances. These results show that penalty-framed no-valid-option MCQA reveals an aspect of model reliability not captured by standard answer-selection accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文研究"无正确选项"的多选题场景（penalty-framed no-valid-option MCQA），发现高准确率不能保证模型可靠弃权。
AI.motivation: 传统MCQA假设选项中必有正确答案，但实际部署中检索系统或用户可能提供无正确选项的选项集，此时强制选择会带来下游代价，这一可靠性维度尚未被标准准确率评估覆盖。
AI.method: 基于MMLU-Pro数学子集，移除标注的正确选项，允许模型选择剩余选项或输出ABSTAIN，并对无效强制选择进行惩罚；同时引入correct-conditioned分析，仅在模型原本答对的样本上评估弃权行为。
AI.result: 即使在明确告知无正确选项及惩罚性评分下，模型仍会对一部分原本答对的实例产生无效强制选择，高MCQA准确率不能完全保证弃权可靠性。
AI.conclusion: penalty-framed no-valid-option MCQA揭示了标准答案选择准确率无法捕捉的模型可靠性维度。

title: On Open-Ended Information Seeking for Information Elicitation Agents
summary: Information elicitation is an open-ended information-seeking problem in which an interaction can unfold in many potentially valuable directions, requiring an elicitor to continually determine which information to pursue as new information emerges. In agentic elicitation, these decisions may be delegated to a foundation model, yet how model choice shapes the resulting information-seeking behavior remains understudied. We study how judgments about information value vary across LLMs and how these differences shape sequential information seeking. We first examine these judgments across 11 LLMs spanning multiple model families and parameter scales, using a shared set of information and elicitation objectives. We then develop a controlled elicitation simulation in which different models encounter the same information space and use the same selection rule, isolating these judgments from question generation and respondent behavior. Using this setting, we characterize the breadth-depth behavior that emerges from model-specific information-seeking preferences over the course of elicitation. We further examine how interaction history changes the evaluation and subsequent selection of prospective information. We test the robustness and boundaries of these findings through sensitivity analyses and ablations over the opportunities available to the elicitor, the response labels used to operationalize information-seeking preferences, the presence of interaction history, and whether redundancy is explicitly relevant to the assessment. The project code, data, and trajectory files are available at https://github.com/infosenselab/open-elicitation.

AI.tldr: 研究不同LLM对信息价值的判断差异如何影响序贯式信息寻求行为，通过11个模型和受控模拟揭示模型特定偏好带来的广度-深度行为差异。
AI.motivation: 在代理式信息引出（agentic elicitation）中，决策常被委托给基础模型，但模型选择如何塑造信息寻求行为尚缺乏研究。
AI.method: 先跨11个LLM（多模型家族、多参数规模）在共享信息与引出目标下考察信息价值判断；再构建受控引出模拟，让不同模型面对相同信息空间并用相同选择规则，从而隔离判断本身，并分析交互历史的影响，进行敏感性分析与消融实验。
AI.result: 刻画了模型特定信息寻求偏好所涌现的广度-深度行为；并考察了交互历史如何改变对潜在信息的评估与后续选择。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择会系统性影响序贯信息寻求行为；通过敏感性分析与消融验证了结论的稳健性与边界。代码、数据与轨迹已开源。

title: Neural Fields Encode Adaptation Geometry
comment: 24 pages, 2 figures. Extended version of work accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps)
summary: Neural fields are usually evaluated by how well they reconstruct an observation. We show that this misses two useful properties of a fitted network: how easily it can adapt to new observations, and what its weights retain from earlier ones. We study these properties as adaptation geometry. For images, we meta-learn class-specific initializations, adapt each one to a new image, and measure how much the network must change to fit it. A simple local linear model closely predicts this adaptation cost, while replacing one network's tangent kernel with another's substantially worsens the prediction. Adaptation thus depends on the local geometry of the fitted network, not only on its current reconstruction. For physical fields, we repeatedly fit the same network to observations from a sequence. Its weights then retain information about that history. When two wave histories end at exactly the same observation, the final weights recover the sign of the wave velocity with 68.6% accuracy, whereas the current observation alone contains no such information and gives 50%. These two phenomena are quantitatively linked: tangent-kernel eigenvalues predict both which changes are easy to learn and how quickly they are overwritten by later fitting. Together, these results show that neural fields contain useful information beyond what they currently reconstruct: in how they can change and in how they got there.

AI.tldr: 神经场仅用重建效果来评价是不够的；其适应几何（如何变化、保留了哪些历史）蕴含额外有用信息，且两者定量相关。
AI.motivation: 传统评价神经场只看其对观测的重建质量，忽略了两个有用性质：网络适应新观测的难易程度，以及权重中保留的历史信息。
AI.method: 把这两个性质作为“适应几何”研究。图像任务上：元学习类特定的初始化，将其适配到新图像，测量网络需改变多少才能拟合；并用局部线性模型预测适应代价，通过替换切线核进行验证。物理场任务上：反复将同一网络拟合到序列观测，检验权重是否保留历史信息（区分波速符号）。
AI.result: 局部线性模型能很好预测适应代价，替换切线核会显著降低预测准确度，说明适应依赖网络的局部几何而非仅当前重建。物理场上，两个波历史最终观测完全相同时，最终权重能以68.6%准确率恢复波速符号，而仅凭当前观测只有50%。
AI.conclusion: 两个现象定量关联：切线核特征值可同时预测哪些改变易学、以及被后续拟合覆盖的速度有多快。神经场包含超越当前重建的信息——体现在它如何变化以及如何到达当前状态。

title: Making COMET Comparable Across Scripts: Diagnosis and Correction of Tokeniser-Induced Script Bias in Indic MT Evaluation
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Camera-ready version, accepted at WMT 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/John-salvin/script-bias-comet-normalisation
summary: COMET reports translation quality as a single number, and that number is routinely compared across target languages written in different scripts. Such a comparison assumes Script Invariance: the score should not depend on the writing system that carries the target. We test it on IndicMT Eval by re-encoding the target into Latin script, which changes orthographic form while holding content and human ratings fixed. Script identity then accounts for 22.9% of native-script COMET variance, and agreement with annotators falls in all five languages studied. We trace the effect to the tokeniser and measure it with three label-free diagnostics. The bias is two faults, not one. Scores from different scripts occupy incompatible ranges, and within a single script the metric orders translations less accurately. No order-preserving transform of the score can repair the second fault. The first is removed exactly by COMET-QN, which maps the score distribution of each (language, script) pair onto a shared reference. Pooled agreement with annotators rises from 0.300 to 0.399, which is what makes scores from different scripts safe to place on one axis, and every within-language ordering is provably preserved. A regressor over parity features recovers a further 17.1% of the lost sensitivity. The remainder belongs to the encoder, and no post-processing can reach it. We therefore recommend publishing the normalised score, the three diagnostics, and the identity of the tokeniser they were computed against, so that a reader can tell how much of a score reflects translation quality and how much reflects the writing system.

AI.tldr: 本文研究COMET跨文字系统评分是否可比，提出“脚本不变性”检验：在IndicMT Eval上将译文改写为拉丁字母但保持内容与人工评分不变，发现脚本身份可解释22.9%的COMET方差。作者定位到分词器，并提出三分支无标签诊断与COMET-QN归一化方法。
AI.motivation: COMET以单一分数比较不同文字系统的译文质量，隐含假设评分与书写系统无关（Script Invariance），但该假设从未被系统检验。
AI.method: 在IndicMT Eval上把目标译文重新编码为拉丁字母，保持内容与人工评分不变；追踪效应至分词器；提出三个无标签诊断；提出COMET-QN将每个（语言,脚本）对的分数分布映射到共享参考分布，并用parity特征回归器进一步提升敏感度。
AI.result: 脚本身份解释22.9%的原生脚本COMET方差，五个语言中与标注者的一致性全部下降。偏差有两类：不同脚本分数范围不兼容，单脚本内排序准确性也下降。COMET-QN精确消除第一类偏差，与标注者合并一致性从0.300升至0.399，且保持语言内排序；parity回归器再恢复17.1%的损失敏感度；剩余偏差源于编码器，后处理无法修复。
AI.conclusion: COMET存在跨脚本偏差，需发布归一化分数、三个诊断指标及对应分词器身份，使读者能判断分数中多少来自翻译质量、多少来自书写系统。

title: From Local Evidence to Safety Verdicts: Causal Tracing in Vision-Language Models
summary: A vision-language model may need to combine an image with a prompt to recognize a safety risk that neither reveals alone. Where does this joint safety judgment become accessible inside the model? We introduce SSU-Bench, a dataset of matched safe and unsafe image-text combinations constructed using single-item prompt edits or image edits with annotated intended regions. Using three vision-language models, we transfer internal states between paired inputs and measure the resulting change in the safety verdict. Across models and both types of counterfactual, interventions at the changed input positions are effective in earlier decoder layers, while interventions at the final input token become effective later. Directions estimated from other examples produce similar late-layer effects. A linear readout of the final-token state also predicts the model's own verdict, including incorrect judgments, and cross-model comparisons reveal similarities in the patterns of counterfactual change. These findings identify a recurring transition in where interventions can influence a joint safety verdict and distinguish a readable model decision from a correct safety judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SSU-Bench数据集（安全/不安全的图文组合），通过内部状态传递实验定位视觉语言模型联合安全判断的所在位置，发现干预效果在解码器层间存在从早期到后期的转变。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型需要结合图像与提示才能识别单独一方无法揭示的安全风险，但模型内部从何处形成这种联合安全判断尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建SSU-Bench：用单项提示编辑或带标注目标区域的图像编辑，配对生成安全与不安全图文组合。在三个视觉语言模型上，对配对输入进行内部状态传递，测量安全判定变化；并做线性读出与跨模型比较。
AI.result: 在两类反事实中，对变化输入位置的干预在较早解码层有效，而对最终输入token的干预在较晚层才有效；由其他样本估计的方向在晚层产生类似效果；最终token状态的线性读出可预测模型自身判定（含错误判定）；跨模型呈现相似的反事实变化模式。
AI.conclusion: 存在一个反复出现的转变：干预影响联合安全判定的有效层位置发生迁移；同时区分了“可读出的模型决策”与“正确的安全判断”。

title: Neural Algorithmic Reasoning for Graph Saddle Point Problems
