summary: Real-world reasoning rarely reduces to static question answering: agents must actively gather information from tools and sensors that are often noisy and unreliable. Yet most existing active reasoning benchmarks assume that environmental feedback is trustworthy, or introduce noise without exposing an explicit, calibrated uncertainty signal, leaving open how LLMs should reason when the evidence itself is uncertain. We introduce VisualNoiseQA, a novel benchmark for active reasoning under noisy visual feedback. A text-only LLM must solve VQA problems by iteratively querying a fixed, off-the-shelf VLM treated as a stochastic visual sensor. For each query, we draw multiple samples and expose an empirical uncertainty signal via self-consistency, enabling the reasoner to probe from different angles and decide what to ask next and when to stop. Our construction is automatic and scalable: starting from diverse VQA sources and two noisy VLMs, we retain only questions where the sensor is inconsistent yet human-solvable. We evaluate multiple LLM reasoners on 1,000 instances spanning perception, chart understanding, and knowledge-intensive reasoning. VisualNoiseQA thus provides a controlled playground to study how different LLMs exploit uncertainty signals for robust reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出 VisualNoiseQA，一个在噪声视觉反馈下进行主动推理的基准：文本 LLM 需迭代查询一个不稳定的 VLM（随机视觉传感器），利用自洽性暴露的不确定性信号来决定问什么、何时停止。
AI.motivation: 现实推理中智能体需从有噪声、不可靠的工具和传感器主动收集信息，但现有主动推理基准通常假设环境反馈可信，或引入噪声却未提供明确、校准的不确定性信号，导致 LLM 在不确信证据下如何推理仍不清楚。
AI.method: 将现成 VLM 视为随机视觉传感器：每次查询多次采样，通过自洽性给出经验不确定性信号；从多个 VQA 数据源与两种噪声 VLM 自动构建，仅保留传感器不一致但人类可解的题目。
AI.result: 构建了含 1,000 个实例的基准，覆盖感知、图表理解和知识密集型推理，并评测了多种 LLM 推理器。
AI.conclusion: VisualNoiseQA 提供了一个可控实验平台，用于研究不同 LLM 如何利用不确定性信号实现稳健推理。

title: ST-Bench: A Spatial-Temporal Benchmark for Multi-Agent System Generation on Scientific Research Tasks
summary: The rapid progress of LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) has shown that they largely outperform single agents on coding, math, and QA tasks, where executable tests provide a binary success signal. Whether this advantage transfers to real scientific data analysis remains untested. We introduce ST-Bench, a benchmark designed to answer two questions: whether MAS outperform single agents on complex scientific data analysis tasks, and if so, by how much and at what additional cost. ST-Bench contains 100 data science tasks adapted from published Earth science studies across hydrology, agriculture, and wetland methane research, expanded into 2,067 queries grounded in additional published studies and validated by domain experts. Using ST-Bench, we evaluate five recent MAS generation methods under two training protocols, against single-agent baselines on the same GPT-5 backbone. Nine of the ten MAS configurations exceed the cheapest single-agent baseline, with the strongest reaching nearly three times its composite score. This gain is primarily attributable to coverage: trained workflows produce realistic numerical metrics on a larger fraction of queries, while the quality of those metrics, conditional on producing realistic output, is comparable to that of the single-agent baseline. The strongest configuration requires approximately four times the single-agent inference time, whereas a more economical workflow captures the majority of the benefit at less than twice the cost. MAS specialization confers measurable benefit on scientific data analysis, but the benefit is conditional rather than universal.

AI.tldr: LLM多智能体系统在科学数据分析上的优势是否可迁移此前未被验证。作者提出ST-Bench（100个地球科学任务、2,067查询），发现10种MAS配置中9种超过最廉价单智能体基线，最强可达近3倍综合得分，优势主要来自覆盖率而非单点质量。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统在编码、数学、QA等有可执行测试提供二元成功信号的任务上远超单智能体，但这一优势能否迁移到真实科学数据分析（无标准答案、依赖领域判断）尚属未知。
AI.method: 构建ST-Bench：100个改编自已发表地球科学（水文、农业、湿地甲烷）的数据科学任务，扩展为2,067条查询并经领域专家验证。在相同GPT-5骨干下，用两种训练协议评估五种近年MAS生成方法，并与单智能体基线对比。
AI.result: 10种MAS配置中9种超过最廉价单智能体基线，最强配置综合得分近3倍。增益主要源于覆盖度：训练后的工作流在更大比例查询上产出合理数值指标，而条件于产出合理输出时的质量与单智能体相当。最强配置推理时间约为单智能体的4倍，更经济的配置以不到2倍成本获得大部分收益。
AI.conclusion: MAS专业化对科学数据分析带来可测量的益处，但该益处是有条件的、并非普适；收益主要来自覆盖率提升而非单点质量，且需权衡推理成本。

title: Adapting to Changes in Agent Behavior via Finite-Depth Policy Sensitivity
summary: Adapting a reinforcement learning policy to changes in another agent's behavior typically requires a large amount of new interaction data. Policy sensitivity provides a first-order prediction of how a locally optimal policy changes with a behavioral parameter, but its computation requires second-order derivatives whose effects propagate across future interactions. We develop a finite-depth framework to estimate this sensitivity by approximating the policy Hessian and mixed derivative using information from a reference environment. The method features an adjustable propagation depth which determines where derivative propagation along the trajectory is truncated. We characterize the derivative contributions omitted by finite-depth propagation and derive truncation-error bounds for the approximated derivatives and resulting policy sensitivity. The bounds are nonincreasing with propagation depth and vanish at full-horizon propagation. Using a belief-driven pursuit-evasion game as a validation scenario, the proposed method generally achieves lower derivative-estimation errors as the propagation depth increases and outperforms the baseline methods in both estimation accuracy and policy adaptation. The sensitivity-based initialization improves zero-shot return over direct transfer, and also shows advantages for the subsequent fine-tuning in the target environment.

AI.tldr: 提出有限深度框架估计策略敏感性，用参考环境的Hessian和混合导数近似，并给出截断误差界，在追逃博弈中验证。
AI.motivation: 将RL策略适应其他智能体行为变化通常需要大量新交互数据；策略敏感性可一阶预测局部最优策略随行为参数的变化，但计算需二阶导数且影响沿未来交互传播。
AI.method: 利用参考环境信息近似策略Hessian与混合导数；引入可调传播深度，在轨迹上截断导数传播，并刻画被省略的导数贡献。
AI.result: 推导出近似导数与策略敏感性的截断误差界，界随深度非增且全时域传播时消失；在信念驱动追逃博弈中，深度增加一般降低估计误差，估计精度与策略适应均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 敏感性初始化相比直接迁移提升零样本回报，并在目标环境后续微调中也有优势。

title: OTel: Open Telco AI Datasets, Benchmarks, and Models
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, ED Track, Spotlight
summary: We present Open Telco (OTel), an open telecom AI resource that releases derived telecom datasets for retrieval, reranking, instruction tuning, and safety/abstention, together with 30 full-parameter post-trained baselines spanning 10 embedding models, 3 rerankers, and 17 language models. The community has already engaged substantially with the resource: as of May 3, 2026, the released models have been downloaded over 16 million times and the project has received 157+ pieces of media coverage worldwide. Building on prior open telecom datasets and benchmarks, OTel provides documented telecom data sources, held-out evaluation partitions, trained embedding models, rerankers, context-grounded LLMs, and safety/abstention data in one unified resource. Each baseline starts from an open-weight model and is post-trained on OTel-derived data using an open training recipe, then evaluated on held-out OTel evaluation partitions. OTel post-training improves performance across all three model families: embedding retrieval reaches 93.1% NDCG@10, reranking reaches 0.947 MRR@10, and language-model correctness reaches 87.8%. We release OTel as a reproducible starting point and invite the community to expand the data, improve embedding and reranking models, and build stronger context-grounded telecom LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Open Telco (OTel)，一个开放的电信AI资源，发布衍生电信数据集（检索、重排序、指令微调、安全/弃权）及30个全参数后训练基线（10个嵌入模型、3个重排序器、17个语言模型），并提供统一的可复现训练配方与评估划分。
AI.motivation: 电信领域缺乏统一、开放、可复现的AI资源，现有数据集与基准分散，难以支撑嵌入、重排序与上下文接地大模型的系统训练与评测。
AI.method: 基于开放权重模型，使用OTel衍生数据和公开训练配方进行全参数后训练，覆盖嵌入、重排序、语言模型三类；提供文档化的数据来源、留出评估划分及安全/弃权数据。
AI.result: 社区反响显著：截至2026年5月3日模型下载超1600万次、媒体覆盖157+；后训练在三个模型家族上均提升性能——嵌入检索NDCG@10达93.1%，重排序MRR@10达0.947，语言模型正确率达87.8%。
AI.conclusion: OTel作为可复现的起点开放发布，邀请社区扩展数据、改进嵌入与重排序模型，并构建更强的上下文接地电信大模型。

title: SpecBraM: What Should an EEG Foundation Model Predict? Masked Band-Power Prediction versus Waveform Reconstruction
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables; includes an appendix
summary: Self-supervised EEG models often reconstruct masked waveforms or predict discrete codes. We study a task-aligned alternative: masked band-power prediction (MBP), which predicts fixed narrow-band log spectral energy for masked channel-time patches. This target retains rhythm power relevant to sleep staging while avoiding phase-sensitive waveform reconstruction and a learned codebook. Across three pretraining seeds, we compare band-power and waveform targets with matched backbones, pretraining data (2,388 hours), and training steps, including a 2x2 tokenizer-by-target design. On ISRUC and HMC sleep staging, MBP exceeds raw- and band-waveform reconstruction by 1.6-2.8 balanced-accuracy points with all labels and 4.7-7.3 points with 1% of labels under a strict linear probe; the target effect exceeds the tokenizer effect. Its frozen features reach 0.7916/0.7425 balanced accuracy, versus 0.7636/0.7227 for a matched rich handcrafted spectral baseline, although the gap is about one point with 1% of labels. Full fine-tuning reaches 0.8107/0.7669. The gains do not extend to every task with spectral cues, including motor imagery, depression screening, and vigilance regression. These results support choosing pretraining targets to match the physical quantities and spatial and temporal scales relevant to downstream labels.

AI.tldr: 论文提出掩码带功率预测（MBP）自监督任务：预测被掩码通道-时间块的窄带对数谱能量，在睡眠分期上优于波形重建，且目标选择比分词器影响更大。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG自监督模型多重建掩码波形或预测离散码，前者对相位敏感、后者依赖学习码本，均未与下游任务（如睡眠分期依赖节律功率）对齐。
AI.method: 在匹配骨干、预训练数据（2388小时）和步数下，跨3个预训练种子比较带功率与波形目标，并设计2x2分词器×目标实验，评估严格线性探针与全量微调。
AI.result: ISRUC和HMC睡眠分期上，MBP比原始/带通波形重建高1.6-2.8点（全标签）、4.7-7.3点（1%标签）；目标效应大于分词器效应；冻结特征0.7916/0.7425优于手工谱基线0.7636/0.7227，全微调0.8107/0.7669；但增益不泛化到运动想象、抑郁筛查、警觉度回归。
AI.conclusion: 预训练目标应匹配下游标签相关的物理量及时空尺度，任务对齐的带功率预测在节律相关任务中有效，但不普适于所有含谱线索的任务。

title: Quantization Effects on Tool-Failure Recovery Vary Across Prompts and Evaluation Designs
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Small Language Models for Agentic Systems (SLM-Agents). 7 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, plus appendix
summary: Post-training quantization reduces the cost of deploying language-model agents, but its effect on recovery from temporary tool failures can depend on how recovery is evaluated. We compare 8-bit and 4-bit variants of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on twenty deterministic tool-use tasks and five prompts. The 8-bit-4-bit recovery comparison changes direction across prompts and evaluation targets. On tasks that both variants complete without faults under the same prompt, the difference ranges from 0 to +20.2 percentage points for Llama and from -50.0 to +35.0 points for Qwen. Full-pipeline point estimates favor 8-bit Llama under all five prompts, whereas the Qwen comparison changes direction across prompts. The evaluation target can also reverse the result. For Llama under one prompt, scoring each variant only on its own clean-passing tasks favors 4-bit by 17.5 points; scoring the same tasks for both variants gives no difference, while scoring the full pipeline favors 8-bit by 28.3 points. Executor leniency is a third such choice. Rescoring the same logs with strict output parsing, which 8-bit Llama violates far more often than 4-bit Llama under that prompt, turns that +28.3 into -15.0 while leaving Qwen essentially unchanged. These findings show that one prompt, one screened task set, and one scoring policy do not establish a stable conclusion about quantized-agent robustness. Evaluations should compare variants on matched tasks, report full-pipeline success for deployment decisions, state the scoring policy, and quantify uncertainty across tasks rather than injected fault sites.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究后训练量化（8-bit vs 4-bit）对语言模型智能体从工具故障中恢复能力的影响，发现结论高度依赖于评估方式（提示、评估目标、评分策略），强调需要更严谨的评估协议。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化可降低语言模型智能体部署成本，但其对临时工具故障恢复能力的影响可能取决于评估方式。作者希望揭示单一评估设置无法给出稳定结论的问题。
AI.method: 在二十个确定性工具使用任务和五种提示（prompts）下，比较 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的 8-bit 与 4-bit 变体，并系统变化评估目标（自清洁通过任务 vs 全流程）、评分策略（严格输出解析 vs 宽松）等选择。
AI.result: 8-bit 与 4-bit 的恢复比较结论随提示和评估目标而反转：Llama 差异 0 至 +20.2 个百分点，Qwen 为 -50.0 至 +35.0 点。全流程估计下 8-bit Llama 在五种提示均占优，而 Qwen 随提示变化。评分策略也能反转结果：某提示下严格解析使 Llama 的 +28.3 变为 -15.0，Qwen 基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 单一提示、单一筛选任务集和单一评分策略无法确立关于量化智能体鲁棒性的稳定结论。评估应在匹配任务上比较变体、报告全流程成功率、说明评分策略，并量化跨任务而非跨注入故障点的不确定性。

title: Robust Importance Sampling for Rare Events via Constrained Gaussian Mixtures
summary: We study estimating rare-event probabilities $I = \mathbb{P}(g(\mathbf{X}) > γ)$ with $\mathbf{X} \sim \mathcal{N}(\boldsymbolμ, \boldsymbolΣ)$ and general $g : \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}$. We address this problem through importance sampling, and propose a framework that substantially improves efficiency and robustness over baselines such as crude Monte Carlo, adaptive cross-entropy, variational-inference-based methods (including reverse- and forward-KL approaches), as well as Safe-ICE, Subset Simulation, and Sequential Monte Carlo, drawing on ideas from both rare-event estimation and cross-entropy optimization. The key contribution has two parts: first, we separate the problem into coverage, to overcome the cold-start barrier, and fitting, to refine proposals once a meaningful signal is available; second, we constrain the final GMM proposal so that it has finite importance-sampling variance (since coverage alone is not sufficient -- without safeguards, importance sampling may still suffer from infinite variance). Together, these ingredients yield expressive proposals; finite variance does not by itself guarantee practical stability at a fixed sampling budget. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial variance reduction, strong robustness across diverse benchmarks, and favorable cost--efficiency trade-offs, with the proposed approach often outperforming these baselines, particularly in high-dimensional and multimodal settings where competing methods frequently become unstable or fail. Our code is available at https://github.com/lorek/robust-cfi-is.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于重要性采样的稀有事件概率估计框架，通过"覆盖+拟合"两阶段与有限方差GMM约束，显著提升效率与鲁棒性，优于多种基线方法。
AI.motivation: 稀有事件概率I=P(g(X)>γ)在高维、多模态情形下估计困难。现有方法（粗略蒙特卡洛、自适应交叉熵、变分推断、Safe-ICE、子集模拟、SMC等）常面临冷启动障碍、不稳定或采样方差无穷等问题，亟需兼顾效率与鲁棒性的统一框架。
AI.method: 将问题分解为两部分：一是"覆盖"(coverage)，用于克服冷启动、寻找有意义信号；二是"拟合"(fitting)，在获得信号后精化提议分布。最终对GMM提议分布施加约束，保证重要性采样方差有限，融合稀有事件估计与交叉熵优化思想。
AI.result: 在多个基准上实现显著方差缩减与强鲁棒性，成本-效率权衡良好；在高维与多模态场景中常优于基线，竞争方法常出现不稳定或失败。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖与拟合分离、加有限方差GMM约束的组合可产生表达力强的提议分布，但仍需注意固定采样预算下的实际稳定性，整体框架在效率与鲁棒性上优于现有方法。

title: Persistent Memory in Multi-Agent LLM Inference: What It Costs, What It Buys, and When You Can Tell
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a poster at the Machine Learning for Systems Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Decomposing long-context inference across cooperating agents bounds the active KV cache per call rather than total evidence, which matters when KV-cache memory binds. Many such systems add a persistent tier storing and recalling reasoning traces, usually validated by an ablation reporting an accuracy gain. We measure both on one three-tier agent architecture. Decomposition delivers: peak KV working set of 14.3 MiB per query against 35.5 and 35.3 MiB for single-pass and retrieval-augmented baselines. The persistent tier does not: across eight controlled dataset pairs at n=100 per arm it costs +0.368 MiB [+0.167, +0.590] of peak cache and produces no detectable accuracy change (+0.015, 95% CI [-0.011, +0.046]). We argue the null is structural: single-question benchmarks supply each item with its own evidence and score it independently, and correctness requires resetting stored traces between conditions, so recall has nothing informative to retrieve. Reaching it took four measurement corrections -- three inflating the apparent benefit, the fourth making an effect that size look resolvable -- none visible in the results table. We give the conditions an agent-memory ablation must satisfy and detection procedures that need no knowledge of the specific defect.

AI.tldr: 该论文在三层智能体架构上实测：跨智能体分解能限制单次调用的KV缓存峰值（14.3 MiB vs 单次35.5/检索35.3 MiB），但持久记忆层无收益——增加0.368 MiB缓存却无精度提升，且该零效应是结构性的。
AI.motivation: KV缓存在长上下文推理中可能成为内存瓶颈；许多协作智能体系统声称通过持久记忆层存储回忆推理轨迹来提升精度，但这类结论通常仅依赖消融得到的精度增益，缺乏对缓存代价与真实效应的严格测量。
AI.method: 在同一三层智能体架构上做受控测量：对比分解式、单次通过、检索增强三种基线的KV峰值工作集；在8组受控数据集配对、每组n=100下评估持久记忆层，并记录4次测量修正（3次夸大收益、1次使该效应看似可分辨）。
AI.result: 分解式峰值KV工作集为14.3 MiB/查询，单次与检索基线为35.5和35.3 MiB。持久记忆层峰值缓存增加+0.368 MiB [+0.167, +0.590]，精度变化+0.015、95% CI [-0.011, +0.046]，无可检测效应。
AI.conclusion: 持久记忆层的零效应是结构性的：单题基准自带证据并独立打分，且需在不同条件间重置存储轨迹，导致回忆无可检索信息。论文给出智能体记忆消融应满足的条件，以及无需预知具体缺陷的检测流程。

title: Who Bears the Burden? Learning Responsibility for Shared Constraints in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Project page with code: https://lira-marl.github.io
summary: When multiple agents share a cost budget, a common Lagrange multiplier can enforce the aggregate constraint but does not determine how its penalty should be allocated across agents. Uniform penalties ignore heterogeneity in the rewards agents sacrifice, while agent-specific multipliers may still rely on the same aggregate cost signal. We introduce Lagrangian Responsibility Allocation (LiRA), which learns each agent's share of a common multiplier by optimizing social welfare over a finite training horizon. The multiplier enforces the aggregate budget, while responsibility shares redistribute its influence without modifying the original rewards or constraints. For convex games under standard regularity conditions, varying these shares induces a smooth family of normalized generalized Nash equilibria in which active constraints remain at their budgets while welfare varies. To optimize responsibility before convergence, we derive a welfare gradient that accounts for both learning updates and the induced change in data distribution. Across CityLearn, MABIM, Harvest, and MetaDrive, spanning 3 to 400 agents, LiRA improves average social welfare by up to 29% over uniform and agent-specific multiplier baselines. Grid and driving costs remain within budget, inventory violations decrease, and Harvest makes more effective use of available budget.

AI.tldr: 提出 LiRA 方法，通过学习各智能体对共享拉格朗日乘子的"责任份额"来重分配惩罚影响，在有限训练期内优化社会福利。
AI.motivation: 多智能体共享成本预算时，单一拉格朗日乘子只能保证总约束却无法决定惩罚如何在各智能体间分摊；统一惩罚忽视奖励牺牲的异质性，而智能体专属乘子仍依赖相同的聚合成本信号。
AI.method: LiRA 让每个智能体学习其在一个共同乘子中的份额，通过在社会福利目标上优化实现；乘子负责约束聚合预算，责任份额只重分配其影响而不改变原奖励或约束。针对非收敛情形，推导了兼顾学习更新与数据分布变化的福利梯度。对凸博弈，在标准正则条件下，调整份额可诱导出一族光滑的规范化广义纳什均衡。
AI.result: 在 CityLearn、MABIM、Harvest、MetaDrive（3 到 400 个智能体）上，LiRA 相比统一乘子和智能体专属乘子基线平均社会福利提升高达 29%；电网和驾驶成本保持在预算内，库存违规减少，Harvest 更有效利用可用预算。
AI.conclusion: 责任份额分配为多智能体预算约束下的社会福利优化提供了有效且理论可解释的机制，可在不违反预算的前提下显著提升整体表现。

title: Attacca: Goal-Directed Control under State Continuity for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents
summary: A central capability of embodied agents is to accomplish complex objectives through sequences of interdependent tasks. Yet existing visual goal-conditioned policies underlying these agents are typically evaluated on isolated interactions where the target is already visible, and thus do not capture the conditions that arise during continuous long-horizon task execution. In such settings, each task begins from the state left by the previous one: the agent may end at a different position and orientation, the world may have been modified, and the next interaction target may lie outside the current field of view. As a result, agents relying on such policies may struggle to proceed to the next task when they cannot ground their target in the current observation. To address this challenge, we propose Attacca, a new approach that trains visual goal-conditioned policies on complete search-to-interact trajectories using goal images decoupled from the execution environment. Attacca uses context-decoupled goal sampling to pair each demonstration with a class-compatible masked goal image from another world, removing direct scene and pose correspondence. It learns dense current-view grounding through a target-mask prediction head, providing auxiliary supervision beyond action imitation. We further introduce behavioral-phase conditioning that teaches the policy to distinguish Search, Approach, and Interact stages and adapt its control as execution progresses. We evaluate Attacca on multiple short- and long-horizon embodied tasks in Minecraft. Our method achieves 39.0-47.5% clean success, improving over the strongest baseline by 1.7-2.4x. On long-horizon tasks, it attains 54%, 30%, and 28% completion, yielding up to a 7x improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出Attacca，通过脱耦目标的采样和搜索-交互轨迹训练，提升长时程具身任务中视觉目标条件策略的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉目标条件策略多在目标已可见的孤立交互场景下评估，未覆盖长时程连续任务中目标不可见、环境被修改、位姿改变等真实情况，导致智能体无法定位下一目标而难以推进任务。
AI.method: Attacca在完整的"搜索-交互"轨迹上训练视觉目标条件策略：(1)上下文脱耦目标采样，将示范与来自其他世界的同类掩码目标图像配对，去除场景与位姿的强对应；(2)通过目标掩码预测头实现密集的当前视角目标定位，作为动作模仿之外的辅助监督；(3)行为阶段条件化，使策略区分搜索、接近、交互阶段并动态调整控制。
AI.result: 在Minecraft的多个短/长时程具身任务中，Attacca实现39.0-47.5%的干净成功率，比最强基线提升1.7-2.4倍；长时程任务完成率达54%、30%、28%，最高提升7倍。
AI.conclusion: 解耦目标图像与执行环境并引入阶段感知监督，能有效缓解长时程具身任务中目标定位难题，显著提升策略的连续任务执行能力。

title: Source-Learned Reliance for Selective Test-Time Adaptation of Multimodal Time Series
summary: Multimodal wearable systems must remain reliable when sensor streams become noisy or unavailable. Existing multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) methods often assess reliability online, but cross-modal agreement can be misleading when sensors measure different physical processes, and evaluating alternative modality configurations adds inference cost. We propose CARAT, which decouples model reliance from runtime corruption detection to guide omission or attenuation, amortizing reliance estimation through source training. An asymmetric modality-dropout curriculum prepares a missingness-resilient backbone for omission and derives a frozen, backbone-specific reliance proxy from windowed input-projection gradient norms. At deployment, a lightweight one-class detector flags suspect streams, and the proxy guides a joint choice between replacing the suspect set with the backbone's trained missingness symbol and attenuating its representations before fusion, without candidate-subset evaluation. Across four wearable datasets, five corruption types, three backbones, and eight TTA baselines, CARAT achieves the highest overall macro-F1 and best mean rank (2.42), exceeding EATA, the strongest baseline, by 1.58 F1 points across 12 equally weighted dataset-backbone settings. Across five profiled configurations, CARAT uses 9.49% fewer GFLOPs and updates 47.82% fewer parameters than EATA. A pattern also emerges across sensing regimes: multimodal TTA methods such as PTA are competitive on IMU-dominated homogeneous datasets, whereas unimodal TTA methods like TENT and EATA match or exceed it on heterogeneous datasets. These results position CARAT as a practical default to wearable TTA, offering competitive robustness with modest computational requirements and benefits that vary across backbones and dataset regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出CARAT方法，将模型依赖度估计与运行时损坏检测解耦，用于可穿戴多模态系统的测试时自适应，在多种数据集和基线中取得最优性能并降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态TTA方法在线评估可靠性时，跨模态一致性在传感器测量不同物理过程时会产生误导，且评估替代模态配置会增加推理成本。可穿戴系统需在传感器流噪声或不可用时保持可靠。
AI.method: CARAT将模型依赖度与运行时损坏检测解耦：通过非对称模态丢弃课程训练缺失韧性骨干网络，并从窗口化输入投影梯度范数导出冻结的骨干特定依赖代理。部署时用轻量单类检测器标记可疑流，依赖代理指导在替换为骨干训练的缺失符号与衰减表示之间联合选择，无需候选子集评估。
AI.result: 在四个可穿戴数据集、五种损坏类型、三种骨干和八个TTA基线上，CARAT取得最高总体宏F1和最佳平均排名(2.42)，超过最强基线EATA 1.58个F1点；相比EATA减少9.49% GFLOPs和47.82%参数更新。发现IMU主导的同质数据集上多模态TTA(如PTA)有优势，异质数据集上单模态TTA(TENT、EATA)更优。
AI.conclusion: CARAT可作为可穿戴TTA的实用默认方法，在适度计算需求下提供有竞争力的鲁棒性，其收益因骨干和数据集类型而异。

title: OOPMAS: Object-Oriented Multi-Agent Systems for Query-Level Workflow Generation
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) powered by large language models have shown strong performance across code generation, mathematical reasoning, and question answering. However, existing methods for automating MAS design mostly operate at the task level, producing a single fixed workflow per benchmark that is applied uniformly to all queries. This assumption fails under realistic conditions. Query difficulty varies widely within a task, and real-world workloads mix heterogeneous task types. We introduce OOPMAS, a training-free framework that generates both the agent set and the coordination workflow at the granularity of individual queries. Agents are represented as object-oriented class definitions with dedicated roles, tools, and persistent state, and workflows are expressed as executable main functions over these agent objects. A dynamic skill library accumulates structured lessons from execution feedback across optimization rounds, enabling in-context improvement without any gradient updates or fine-tuning. On a mixed-task benchmark of queries spanning code, math, and QA, OOPMAS achieves 89.6% accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline by 18.1 percentage points. A model-swap study across four LLM backbones shows consistent scaling, reaching 92.4% with the strongest model.

AI.tldr: 提出 OOPMAS，一个免训练框架，以查询为粒度生成多智能体系统的智能体集合与协作工作流。
AI.motivation: 现有 MAS 自动化设计多为任务级，对整个基准生成固定工作流并统一应用，忽视了查询难度差异与真实场景中异构任务混合的问题。
AI.method: 智能体表示为面向对象的类定义（专属角色、工具、持久状态），工作流为基于这些对象的主函数；动态技能库从多轮执行的反馈中积累结构化经验，实现无需梯度更新的上下文内改进。
AI.result: 在跨代码、数学、QA 的混合任务基准上达 89.6% 准确率，超最强基线 18.1 个百分点；四种 LLM 骨干的模型替换实验显示一致的可扩展性，最强模型达 92.4%。
AI.conclusion: 查询粒度、面向对象化的 MAS 自动设计配合免训练技能积累，能有效应对异构混合任务，并随骨干模型能力提升而稳定增益。

title: Harmful SFT Leaves a Continuous Trace in LLM Checkpoint Updates
summary: Safety auditing of post-trained large language models typically relies on model behavior, requiring model execution and depending on the coverage of available evaluations. This work asks a different question: Do the target behaviors optimized during supervised fine-tuning (SFT) leave readable evidence directly in checkpoint updates? We find that harmful-compliance SFT induces a continuous, objective-dependent ordering in checkpoint-update space. Using a reference geometry defined by pure harmful-compliance, safety-targeted, and benign-utility SFT, we find that a checkpoint-level coordinate s_H tracks controlled harmful-objective composition with Spearman correlations of 0.986-0.992 across four 7-8B backbones, with the same ordering persisting at larger model scales. Matched compliance-versus-refusal controls show that this checkpoint trace reflects the SFT objective rather than harmful-input exposure, while additional controls rule out simple explanations based on harmful-example count or generic training intensity. Building on this structure, we introduce TRACE, a weights-only auditing method that localizes an unknown checkpoint update relative to frozen harmful and non-harmful reference prototypes and converts this geometry into a continuous harmful-objective score. TRACE requires neither model queries nor access to the unknown SFT data, and can be evaluated directly from checkpoint updates. Across distribution shifts, unseen data, different SFT configurations, partial checkpoint access, and LoRA/full-parameter fine-tuning, the trace remains stable and is positively associated with independently measured attack success rates. TRACE remains informative even at low harmful-objective proportions, providing a complementary auditing signal when behavioral evaluation is unavailable or incomplete. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Code4TRACE-54D3.

AI.tldr: 有害合规SFT在检查点更新空间留下可读痕迹，据此提出仅需权重、无需查询的审计方法TRACE。
AI.motivation: 现有安全审计依赖模型行为，需要执行模型且受评测覆盖范围限制；本文探索SFT目标是否在检查点更新中留下可直接读取的证据。
AI.method: 利用纯有害合规、安全目标和良性效用SFT定义的参考几何，发现检查点级坐标s_H可追踪有害目标组成；提出TRACE，将未知检查点更新相对于冻结的有害/非有害参考原型进行定位，转换为连续有害目标分数。
AI.result: s_H与受控有害目标组成的Spearman相关性达0.986–0.992（四个7-8B骨干），并在更大规模持续；匹配对照表明痕迹源于SFT目标而非有害输入暴露，排除示例数量或训练强度解释；TRACE在分布偏移、未见数据、不同SFT配置、部分访问及LoRA/全参数下稳定，且与独立测量的攻击成功率正相关，低比例下仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 检查点更新空间存在可读的有害目标痕迹，TRACE提供了无需模型查询和数据访问的互补审计信号，适用于行为评测不可用或不完整时。

title: Illusory Pattern Perception Drives Spurious Inference in Large Language Models
summary: Illusory pattern perception is a well-documented human cognitive tendency to infer meaningful relationships in data that is actually random. Such a tendency, often described as "connecting the dots" where none exist, can result in systematic reasoning errors. This paper investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit such perceptual tendencies, which can lead to systematic errors in downstream applications. To our knowledge, this work presents the first systematic study of illusory pattern perception in LLMs, adapting classic psychological paradigms to three tasks with direct empirical comparison to human behaviors. We find that LLMs frequently exhibit stronger illusory pattern perception than humans. In particular, models tend to over-associate frequent positive attributes with majority groups or large organizations, and show increased tendencies to construct causal narratives from ambiguous events. To uncover the mechanism behind these behaviors, we develop a feature interpretability framework based on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to analyze internal representations. Our results reveal that holistic frequency perception and analytic cognitive orientation are linked to the emergence of illusory perceptions. These findings highlight a previously underexplored cognitive-like illusion that may affect the reliability of LLM reasoning. Code available at https://github.com/NusIoraPrivacy/illusory.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究LLM的错觉模式感知，发现模型比人类更易在随机数据中构建虚假关联与因果叙事，并用SAE揭示其内部机制。
AI.motivation: 错觉模式感知是人类在随机数据中推断虚假关联的认知倾向，会导致系统性推理错误。作者关注LLM是否也有此倾向，从而影响下游应用可靠性。
AI.method: 将经典心理学范式改编为三项任务，与人类行为直接对比；并构建基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的特征可解释性框架分析内部表征。
AI.result: LLM普遍比人类表现出更强的错觉模式感知：倾向将正面属性过度关联于多数群体或大型组织，并从模糊事件中构建因果叙事。SAE分析显示整体频率感知与解析型认知取向与错觉感知的出现相关。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了LLM中一种此前未被充分探索的类认知错觉，可能影响其推理可靠性。

title: Activation Denoising: A Robustness View on Parallel vs Sequential LLM Quantization
summary: Post-training quantization is a powerful tool for compressing large language models. The most scalable methods quantize every layer in parallel, but quantization errors then compound through the residual stream, as no layer corrects for the errors of the layers before it. Sequential quantization accounts for this error compounding by re-calibrating each layer on the already-quantized outputs of its predecessors, yielding stronger results but at the cost of a serial schedule that becomes a bottleneck at scale. As a solution, we propose parallel quantization with activation denoising, which recovers much of the sequential benefit while keeping quantization fully parallel. Rather than re-calibrating layer-by-layer, we take a robustness perspective and model the upstream error as noise, regularizing to be robust to it through a preprocessing step followed by metric-weighted rounding. Applied at every layer, this regularization forms a depth-compounding smoothness penalty that dampens how strongly quantization errors amplify through the model. Unlike orthogonal rotations commonly used in quantization, which must preserve the model's function, we multiply the weights by a more general linear transformation. We find that the two are complementary and their effects compound. Empirically, our robustness regularization recovers a significant part of sequential quantization's benefit in a single parallel pass, at a fraction of its time. Overall, by treating compounding quantization errors as a robustness problem, we offer a principled foundation for more efficient and accurate LLM quantization at scale.

AI.tldr: 提出"并行量化+激活去噪"方法，把上游量化误差建模为噪声并施加鲁棒性正则化，在保持全并行效率的同时逼近串行量化的精度。
AI.motivation: 现有可扩展的后训练量化方法逐层并行处理，但量化误差会沿残差流复合放大，无层纠正前层误差；串行量化虽能重新校准缓解该问题，却因串行调度在大规模下成为瓶颈。
AI.method: 从鲁棒性视角将上游误差视为噪声，通过预处理步骤+度量加权舍入进行正则化，使每层对上游误差鲁棒；该正则化在深度上复合，形成平滑惩罚，抑制误差放大。同时用更一般的线性变换乘权重（而非须保函数的正交旋转），并发现两者互补、效果可叠加。
AI.result: 该鲁棒性正则化在单次并行过程中恢复了串行量化相当大一部分收益，耗时仅为后者的一小部分。
AI.conclusion: 将复合量化误差视为鲁棒性问题，为大规模LLM的高效、高精度量化提供了有原则的基础。

title: Thin Evidence, Thick Priors: How Language Models Substitute Identity for Missing Financial Facts
comment: 49 pages, 17 figures, 12 tables; Submitted & Accepted to ICAIF'2026
summary: People increasingly ask large language models what to do with their money, yet seldom describe their finances in full. This paper asks what a model does with the gap. Holding finances fixed and changing only who the investor is said to be, we grade the financial evidence in the prompt from eight facts to none and measure how far the recommended equity allocation moves. Across 96,600 prompts to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, built from 100 financial profiles, 138 personas and seven disclosure conditions, the average gap between two personas with identical finances rises from 4.78 percentage points at full disclosure to 10.34 points with no financial facts. A two-way cluster bootstrap counting duplicated prompts once places the ratio at 2.16 (95% interval 1.69 to 2.79), and the rise is already 1.69-fold with a single fact left. Identity explains 5% of within-profile variation in advice at full disclosure and 96% with no disclosure. Household size is the only attribute whose influence grows reliably as evidence is withdrawn. Once standard errors are clustered on the persona, the unit to which identity was assigned, most attribute-specific interactions reported in the conference version lose significance, and gender instead appears as a small standing gap that full disclosure does not close. Stating risk appetite alone brings the swing into the range seen with two to seven generic facts. With no facts, the model's one-line rationale cites incomes, debts and savings it was never told, and these invented finances turn adverse more often for larger households. Inside the network, gender is linearly decodable at every layer, and ablating the gender direction at five layers leaves the aggregate identity swing unchanged. Advisory systems built on such models should be audited at the disclosure levels users actually reach, and judged across the whole identity space rather than one attribute at a time.

AI.tldr: 论文研究当用户财务信息不完整时，大模型的投资建议会多大程度受"投资者身份"影响。通过变动的信息披露程度与人格设定，发现财务事实越少，身份造成的建议差异越大（从4.78个百分点升至10.34点）。
AI.motivation: 人们常向大模型咨询理财，却很少完整描述自身财务状况。论文关注模型如何填补这一信息缺口，以及身份标签在缺乏财务事实时对建议的扭曲程度。
AI.method: 固定财务信息、仅改变投资者身份，将提示中的财务证据从8条事实递减至0条；对Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct进行96,600次提示测试（100个财务档案×138个人格×7种披露条件），测量推荐股票配置的变化，并用双向聚类bootstrap及性别方向消融等分析。
AI.result: 相同财务下不同人格的平均建议差距从全披露的4.78个百分点升至无披露的10.34点（比值2.16，95%区间1.69–2.79）；仅剩1条事实时已达1.69倍。身份在全披露解释5%组内差异，无披露时达96%。聚类后多数属性交互失去显著性，性别呈现全披露也未能消除的小幅持续差距。无事实时模型凭空虚构收入、债务和储蓄，且对大家庭更常编造不利财务。
AI.conclusion: 基于此类模型的理财系统应在用户实际达到的披露水平上审计，并在整个身份空间而非单一属性上评估；仅说明风险偏好即可带来相当于2–7条通用事实的波动。网络内部性别在各层线性可解码，但在五层消融性别方向后总体身份波动不变。

title: Targeted search shows that random-device testing underestimates worst-case error in a simulated wave-based neural operator
comment: 50 pages (19 main text and references, 31 Supplementary Information), 5 figures, 1 table
summary: Wave-based processors promise fast, energy-efficient Fourier layers for neural operators. They are usually validated on randomly sampled devices, but using them requires knowing how large their error can become under fabrication and alignment variation. In a stylised numerical case study, a hybrid Fourier neural operator runs its four spectral layers on simulated coherent 4f processors with 32 toleranced knobs, whose half-widths are representative rather than calibrated. For 120 models (four tasks, six training methods, five seeds), we compared the worst of N random in-spec devices with a searched one. On a deterministic simulator with one frozen draw of the random static errors, the searched device's held-out error was 1.08-3.10 times the maximum over 200 Monte Carlo devices and 1.06-2.71 times that over 1000. With 20 fresh static draws, it still exceeded the maximum over 200 random devices in 116 of 120 models. Under uniform sampling, the probability of drawing such a device is at most 0.37% per model (two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson), which says nothing about how large its error is. The gap persisted with uniform or Sobol' sampling at the search's budget, shared knobs, a second crosstalk model, box scales of 0.25-2 and a pixel-level device model. Models trained only with random static errors reached 3.7-39.9 times their nominal error on searched devices, and fine-tuning on random and gradient-searched devices gave the lowest searched error of the six in all 20 task-seed pairs. For two heat-exchanger quantities, a search targeted at each exceeded the worst of 1000 random devices in all 39 models, and hence the Wilks 95/95 limit (worst of 59). For the mean pressure of 11 models, no random device exceeded a 1% error threshold, but the searched device did. Random testing estimates how often errors exceed a threshold; worst-device search gives a lower bound on how large they can be.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数值案例研究表明，针对波基处理器（相干4f处理器）进行“最差设备搜索”所找到的器件误差，远高于随机采样设备的最大误差，说明随机测试仅能估计超阈频率，而最差设备搜索可给出误差上界的下界。
AI.motivation: 波基处理器有望为神经算子提供快速、节能的傅里叶层，但其误差在制造与对准变异下的上界未知。现有验证多基于随机采样器件，无法回答“误差最大能有多大”，因此需要系统性考察最差情况。
AI.method: 构建混合傅里叶神经算子，将四个谱层运行在模拟相干4f处理器上，含32个带容忍度的旋钮（半宽为代表值）。对120个模型（4任务×6训练方法×5种子），比较N个随机在规格内器件的最差误差与搜索得到的器件误差；采用确定性模拟器、20次独立静态误差抽样、均匀与Sobol'采样、共享旋钮、第二种串扰模型、0.25–2的盒尺度及像素级器件模型等设置进行验证。
AI.result: 冻结一次随机静态误差时，搜索器件的留出误差是200个蒙特卡洛器件最大值的1.08–3.10倍、1000个的1.06–2.71倍；20次新抽样中仍有116/120个模型超过200随机器件最大值。均匀采样下抽到该器件的概率每模型至多0.37%（95% Clopper-Pearson）。仅用随机静态误差训练的模型在搜索器件上误差达标称的3.7–39.9倍；在随机与梯度搜索器件上微调在全部20个任务-种子对中取得六种方法中最低误差。对两个换热器量，针对性搜索在全部39个模型中超过1000随机器件的最差值（即超过Wilks 95/95限）。
AI.conclusion: 随机测试只能估计误差超过某阈值的频率，而最差设备搜索能给出误差可能达到多大的一种下界。因此，波基处理器的鲁棒性验证应纳入最差设备搜索，而非仅依赖随机采样。

title: ThinkFuse: Trajectory-Aware Test-Time Fusion for Small Reasoning Models
summary: Small reasoning models (SRMs) have shown strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by generating extended chain-of-thought trajectories, but they often fail to recover once their reasoning enters an erroneous path. Existing test-time fusion methods rely on local fusion signals to determine when to trigger fusion, which can be misled by transient uncertainty fluctuations and may reinforce unstable reasoning trajectories. We propose ThinkFuse, a training-free test-time fusion framework that selectively intervenes in unreliable reasoning segments. ThinkFuse compares segment-level uncertainty shifts with trajectory-level uncertainty trends to identify unstable reasoning points and fuse auxiliary reasoning paths into the primary model's trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ThinkFuse outperforms baselines on mathematical and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks, with consistent gains across model-family combinations, and remains robust with a smaller primary model. Our analysis shows that ThinkFuse requires fewer fusion triggers and generates fewer tokens, highlighting the efficiency of selective triggering. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ThinkFuse.

AI.tldr: ThinkFuse是一个免训练测试时融合框架，通过比较片段级与轨迹级不确定性来识别不可靠推理点并选择性融合辅助推理路径，提升小型推理模型的复杂推理能力且更高效。
AI.motivation: 小型推理模型在长链思维推理中一旦进入错误路径便难以恢复。现有测试时融合方法依赖局部融合信号触发融合，易被瞬时不确定性波动误导，反而强化不稳定推理轨迹。
AI.method: 提出ThinkFuse：免训练的测试时融合框架，选择性干预不可靠推理片段。它对比“片段级不确定性变化”与“轨迹级不确定性趋势”，据此识别不稳定推理点，并将辅助推理路径融合进主模型轨迹。
AI.result: 在数学与知识密集型推理基准上优于基线，在多种模型家族组合下均有稳定增益，且在更小的主模型下仍保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 分析表明ThinkFuse所需融合触发更少、生成token更少，体现了选择性触发的高效性。代码已开源。

title: Do I Need the Cloud? Uncertainty-Aware Step-Level Handoff for Small Language Model Agents
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: SLMs for Agentic Systems, Paris, France, 2026
summary: Small language models (SLMs) are attractive as local agent controllers because they reduce remote inference, latency, and deployment footprint, yet structured tool errors can cause an agent step to fail. Existing routers typically select a model once per query. However, agents expose sequential decision points whose difficulty dynamically changes based on intermediate observations. We propose STEPGATE, an uncertainty-aware handoff framework that scores each local SLM action and selectively escalates challenging steps to a stronger model. On a 52-task held-out single-step BFCL-derived test split, the Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B pair attains 82.7% task success with 30.8% escalation, versus 67.3% local-only and 75.4% random escalation (which uses 33.8% escalation). In a separate multi-turn evaluation, STEPGATE achieves 69.0% trajectory success and 84.0% action success using only 30.0% cloud actions, compared with 48.0%/70.5% local-only, 60.0%/78.2% random escalation, and 57.0%/77.1% query-level routing (strong-only achieves 82.0% trajectory success at 100% cloud actions). These results suggest that step-level escalation recovers a large share of the performance gap to the stronger Qwen2.5-7B backend at a matched cloud-action rate while transmitting fewer tokens remotely. However, our evaluation is limited to one model family, a single stronger backend, and scripted tasks. Furthermore, the test sets are small, multi-turn comparisons rely on paired intervals and statistical tests, and our risk tiers serve as research annotations rather than formal safety guarantees.

AI.tldr: 提出STEPGATE，一种不确定性感知的步骤级升级框架，让本地小模型处理简单步骤、仅在不确定时将困难步骤升级到强模型，在匹配云端调用率下显著缩小与强模型的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型作为本地智能体控制器可降低推理延迟和部署开销，但结构化工具错误会导致步骤失败。现有路由通常一次查询只选一次模型，而智能体的序列决策点难度会随中间观测动态变化，因此需要步骤级的动态路由。
AI.method: STEPGATE对本地SLM的每个动作打分，量化不确定性，并选择性地将高难度步骤升级至更强模型，实现不确定性感知的步骤级handoff。实验采用Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B模型对，在BFCL衍生的52任务单步测试集及单独的多轮评测中，与local-only、随机升级、查询级路由等基线对比。
AI.result: 单步测试：82.7%任务成功、30.8%升级率，优于local-only（67.3%）和随机升级（75.4%，升级率33.8%）。多轮评测：轨迹成功69.0%、动作成功84.0%，仅用30.0%云端动作，优于local-only（48.0%/70.5%）、随机升级（60.0%/78.2%）和查询级路由（57.0%/77.1%）；强模型单独使用则需100%云端动作才达82.0%轨迹成功。同时远程传输的token更少。
AI.conclusion: 步骤级升级能在匹配云端动作率下恢复大部分与Qwen2.5-7B的性能差距，并减少远程token传输。但评估仅限单一模型族、单一强后端和脚本化任务，测试集较小，多轮比较依赖配对区间与统计检验，风险分层仅为研究性标注而非正式安全保证。

title: Foundation Model-Aided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Wireless Random Access Network Optimization
comment: This paper has been accepted in ACM International Symposium on Theory, Algorithmic Foundations, and Protocol Design for Mobile Networks and Mobile Computing (MobiHoc) 2026
summary: Random access (RA) is one of the most foundational medium access control (MAC) layer scheduling schemes for handling unpredictable data traffic from multiple terminals. While multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has been explored to optimize RA-based wireless networks, its reliance on experience-driven, distributed policy learning incurs significant training overhead for each optimization task, limiting its feasibility in real-world applications. In this work, we propose to leverage a foundation model (FM) to improve MARL efficiency across diverse RA network optimization tasks. Specifically, we design an FM-aided actor-critic algorithm within a consensus-based decentralized MARL architecture and provide its convergence analysis under local reward exchanges and nonlinear value function approximations to show that our algorithm achieves the same convergence order as the conventional MARL with critic model exchanges and linear approximations. Our numerical results show that our FM-based approach significantly enhances MARL speed for RA network optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用基础模型（FM）提升多智能体强化学习在多任务随机接入网络优化中的效率，设计了FM辅助的actor-critic算法并给出收敛性分析。
AI.motivation: 随机接入（RA）是处理多终端不可预测数据流量的基础MAC调度方案，但基于MARL的RA网络优化依赖经验驱动的分布式策略学习，每个优化任务训练开销巨大，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 在基于共识的去中心化MARL架构中设计FM辅助的actor-critic算法，并在局部奖励交换与非线性值函数近似条件下进行收敛性分析。
AI.result: 理论证明该算法达到与采用critic模型交换和线性近似的传统MARL相同的收敛阶；数值结果验证FM方法显著提升RA网络优化的MARL速度。
AI.conclusion: 利用基础模型可有效提升MARL在多样化RA网络优化任务中的效率，兼具理论收敛保证与实验加速效果。

title: Agentic Semantic Sensing for Resource-Adaptive AI-RAN
summary: Semantic sensing (SemS) acquires task-relevant information rather than reconstructing complete physical information. Existing SemS formulations typically operate open loop: sensing configurations and observation schedules are fixed before inference and cannot respond to evolving task-level evidence. We propose Agentic SemS, a closed-loop framework for AI-enabled radio access networks (AI-RANs) that controls sensing within a communication-feasible profile set. A profile-conditioned causal Transformer updates the semantic belief from streaming observations, while key-value caching enables efficient state updates across profile changes without repeatedly processing the complete history. A semantic utility network estimates the task-level benefit of acquiring the next observation block under each feasible profile after accounting for sensing cost. The resulting continuation utilities jointly support next-profile selection and semantic early exit, adapting sensing configuration and duration to evolving evidence. The expected semantic gain is further related to conditional mutual information, providing a value-of-information interpretation of continued online sensing. Experiments on Widar3.0 with six emulated sensing profiles show that, in comparison with full-sequence High, the resource-efficient Agentic setting reduces normalized cumulative sensing cost by 25.33% while achieving 85.79% Macro-F1. At the same utility checkpoint, semantic early exit provides a further 12.35% cost reduction over adaptive sensing without early exit, with a 0.97-percentage-point Macro-F1 decrease.

AI.tldr: 提出 Agentic SemS 闭环感知框架，在 AI-RAN 中动态选择感知配置与时长，用因果 Transformer 与语义效用网络实现成本与任务性能的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有语义感知（SemS）多为开环：感知配置与观测调度在推理前固定，无法根据任务级证据的演化进行调整，导致资源浪费。
AI.method: 构建闭环框架，在通信可行配置集内控制感知；用 profile-conditioned 因果 Transformer 从流式观测更新语义信念，KV 缓存实现跨配置切换的高效状态更新；语义效用网络估计下一观测块的任务级收益（扣除感知成本），由此联合完成下一配置选择与语义提前退出；并将期望语义增益与条件互信息关联，给出在线感知的信息价值解释。
AI.result: 在 Widar3.0 六种仿真感知配置上，资源高效的 Agentic 设置相比全序列 High 降低 25.33% 归一化累计感知成本，同时达到 85.79% Macro-F1；相同效用点下，语义提前退出比无提前退出的自适应感知再降 12.35% 成本，Macro-F1 仅降 0.97 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Agentic SemS 通过闭环、证据驱动的配置选择与提前退出，显著降低感知成本并保持较高任务性能，为 AI-RAN 中的语义感知提供了信息价值视角与有效方案。

title: Which and When to Admit: Gradient Admission for Data-Centric Small Language Model Finetuning
summary: LoRA fine-tuning adapts small language models (SLMs) to heterogeneous instruction data within a low-rank update subspace, making it vulnerable to three structural problems: conflicting gradients that cancel, static data selection that cannot track evolving learning dynamics, and subspace saturation that causes later updates to overwrite useful directions. We argue that effective adaptation therefore requires controlling which data-induced gradients enter the LoRA subspace and when. We propose GRADE (GRadient-Aligned Data-centric rEcipe), a data-centric framework combining two mechanisms: a state-aware selector that continually admits samples aligned with the evolving multi-task gradient field, and a self-calibrating step-level gate that rejects updates likely to cause destructive overwrite near saturation. Across three current-generation backbones and a heterogeneous seven-dataset instruction pool, GRADE outperforms strong data-selection and PEFT-stabilization baselines in accuracy and robustness. It is the only method to improve consistently over standard LoRA on every architecture, while producing more coherent gradient trajectories and less destructive overwrite. These results show that successful SLM adaptation depends not only on which data are selected, but also on which gradients are allowed to enter and persist in the constrained update subspace.

AI.tldr: 提出GRADE框架，通过状态感知数据选择与梯度门控，提升LoRA微调在异构指令数据下的适应效果。
AI.motivation: LoRA微调在小语言模型上存在三个结构性问题：梯度冲突相互抵消、静态数据选择无法跟踪学习动态、子空间饱和导致后续更新覆盖有用方向。
AI.method: GRADE（梯度对齐的数据中心配方），包含两个机制：状态感知选择器（持续纳入与演进多任务梯度场对齐的样本）和自校准步级门控（拒绝接近饱和时可能造成破坏性覆盖的更新）。
AI.result: 在三个当代骨干模型和七个异构指令数据集上，GRADE在准确率和鲁棒性上超越强数据选择和PEFT稳定化基线，是唯一在每个架构上都稳定优于标准LoRA的方法，并产生更连贯的梯度轨迹和更少的破坏性覆盖。
AI.conclusion: SLM适应成功不仅取决于选择哪些数据，还取决于哪些梯度被允许进入并保留在受限更新子空间中。

title: DHCG: Dynamic Construction of Hierarchical Collaboration Graphs for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have demonstrated strong capabilities in solving complex problems across diverse domains. Recently, the dynamic orchestration of agent systems has become an important research direction. However, existing methods suffer from limited composition, misaligned dependencies, and inflexible scale, restricting their ability to adapt to reasoning requirements during execution. To address these limitations, we reframe MAS design as a partially observable Markov decision process, in which both the composition and scale of the MAS are dynamically determined. We propose DHCG, a novel framework that coordinates three modules (Planner, Worker, and Generator) to progressively construct a dynamic hierarchical collaboration graph from scratch based on the query and evolving execution feedback. At each step, guided by feedback, the Planner generates a set of distinct and complementary roles tailored to the current reasoning needs and selectively routes relevant information to each role. It can also finalize the hierarchical collaboration graph early or progressively expand it when additional reasoning is required. We further introduce action-aware preference optimization to train the Planner to make more effective decisions when constructing hierarchical collaboration graphs. We systematically evaluate DHCG across code generation, mathematical reasoning, and domain-specific reasoning benchmarks. DHCG achieves state-of-the-art average performance among the compared methods, improving over the single-agent baseline by 13.06 points and outperforming both static and dynamic MAS baselines by 2.77-8.02 points. Additional experiments further demonstrate its generalization across different Planner backbones and unseen Worker models.

AI.tldr: 提出 DHCG 框架，将多智能体系统设计重构为 POMDP，动态构建分层协作图，实现 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统方法存在组合受限、依赖错位、规模不灵活等问题，难以在推理过程中自适应调整。
AI.method: 将 MAS 设计建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，用 Planner、Worker、Generator 三模块从零渐进构建动态分层协作图；Planner 按反馈生成互补角色并路由信息，可提前终止或扩展；引入动作感知偏好优化训练 Planner。
AI.result: 在代码生成、数学推理及领域推理基准上取得 SOTA 平均性能，较单智能体基线提升 13.06 分，优于静态与动态 MAS 基线 2.77-8.02 分；并验证了跨 Planner 骨干与未见 Worker 模型的泛化性。
AI.conclusion: DHCG 通过动态分层协作图与反馈驱动编排，有效提升多智能体系统对复杂推理任务的自适应能力。

title: Global Transport Couplings for Classifier-Free Guided Flows
summary: Optimal-transport couplings have been shown to reduce training variance in unconditional flow models, but their role in conditional generation remains unclear. A natural approach constructs separate couplings for each condition, but this is impractical for large or continuous conditioning spaces found in modern image foundation models. We introduce Global Transport (GT), a global class-agnostic optimal-transport coupling, computed without class labels. GT can associate different conditions with different regions of the source noise, and consequently worsens performance without guidance. However, when combined with classifier-free guidance (CFG), GT consistently improves generation across domains, model scales, and sampling budgets. This reversal suggests that couplings for conditional flows should be evaluated both empirically and theoretically under the guided flow used at inference, rather than on unguided generation. We evaluate GT over both discrete class and continuous text conditioned image generation across model scales, and investigate how coupling choice alters guided trajectories. These results identify coupling design in the guided flow setting as a simple training time axis to improve performance without modifying existing architectures, samplers, or guidance mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Global Transport (GT)，一种无需类别标签的全局类别无关最优传输耦合。GT在无引导条件下会损害条件生成，但与无分类器引导(CFG)结合时能持续提升跨域、跨模型尺度和采样预算的生成质量，表明条件流模型的耦合设计应在引导流下评估。
AI.motivation: 最优传输耦合能降低无条件流模型的训练方差，但其在条件生成中的作用尚不明确。为每个条件构建独立耦合在大规模或连续条件空间中不可行，因此需要一种实用的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出Global Transport (GT)，一种全局类别无关的最优传输耦合，无需类别标签计算。GT可将不同条件关联到源噪声的不同区域。研究其单独使用以及结合CFG时的效果，并在离散类别和连续文本条件图像生成任务上评估。
AI.result: GT单独使用时性能下降，但与CFG结合时在各领域、模型尺度和采样预算下均一致提升生成质量。研究还揭示了耦合选择如何改变引导轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 条件流的耦合设计应在推理时使用的引导流下进行评估。耦合设计为引导流设置下的一个简单训练时间轴，可在不修改现有架构、采样器或引导机制的情况下提升性能。

title: RA-MoWE: Workflow-Affinity Embeddings for Query Clustering and Agentic Workflow Generation
summary: Agentic workflows enable large language models (LLMs) to solve complex tasks by coordinating reasoning, tool use, and verification. However, a workflow optimized for an entire task collection can overlook differences in the reasoning strategies that individual queries need, while searching for a new workflow for every query repeats costly optimization. To address this tradeoff, we introduce RA-MoWE, a framework that uses workflow-affinity embeddings to cluster queries and guide the generation of reusable expert workflows. Each embedding records how well a fixed set of reference workflows solves a query, revealing similarities in which reasoning strategies are effective. RA-MoWE uses each cluster's queries and average embedding to initialize and refine a specialized workflow through execution feedback. An embedding encoder predicts these embeddings from query text, allowing new queries to select a generated expert without first executing the reference workflows. On a 300-query test set drawn from four benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and programming, RA-MoWE improves average task score by 4.04 percentage points over selecting among the reference workflows, while using 27.7% fewer language-model calls at inference.

AI.tldr: 提出RA-MoWE框架，利用workflow-affinity embedding对查询聚类，生成可复用的专家工作流，在数学、科学、编程四基准上平均任务分提升4.04个百分点且推理时LLM调用减少27.7%。
AI.motivation: 针对整个任务集合优化的工作流忽视了个体查询所需推理策略的差异，而为每个查询单独搜索新工作流又会重复昂贵的优化过程。
AI.method: 用固定参考工作流集合对查询的求解表现构建workflow-affinity embedding，据此聚类查询；用每个簇的查询及平均embedding初始化并通过执行反馈精炼专用工作流；训练embedding encoder从查询文本预测embedding，使新查询无需预先执行参考工作流即可选择专家。
AI.result: 在覆盖数学、科学、编程四个基准的300条查询测试集上，相比在参考工作流中选择，平均任务分提升4.04个百分点，推理时语言模型调用减少27.7%。
AI.conclusion: RA-MoWE在查询特化与优化成本之间取得平衡，通过聚类和embedding预测实现可复用专家工作流的生成与高效选择。

title: TAFFY: A Task-Adaptive Tabular Foundation Model with In-Context Diversity
summary: Recent progress in tabular foundation models suggests that training on synthetic tasks can substantially improve in-context learning capabilities, with overall performance largely depending on how well models can infer task-specific predictive relationships from the available context during inference. In this paper, we introduce TAFFY, a tabular foundation model with an In-Context Diversity Prior and a Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer that strengthen this ability. Specifically, to construct each synthetic pretraining context, the In-Context Diversity Prior samples from multiple related environments derived via controlled interventions and distribution shifts on a shared causal process. This in-context diversity encourages the model to learn a more comprehensive and task-specific representation. Moreover, the Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer iteratively and selectively applies a shared group of Transformer blocks to refine contextual representations, with a task-conditioned gate modulating the final hidden-state update. This enables task-adaptive iterative refinement. Together, these components encourage the model to identify predictive relationships from contextual contrasts during pretraining and dynamically modulate context integration for each task. Across six classification and five regression benchmark datasets, TAFFY attains the lowest average rank.

AI.tldr: TAFFY：结合上下文多样性先验与任务条件循环Transformer的表格基础模型，提升in-context学习能力，在多项基准上取得最低平均排名。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型通过合成任务预训练可提升in-context学习能力，其性能主要取决于模型能否从推理时上下文中推断出任务特定的预测关系。
AI.method: 1）In-Context Diversity Prior：对共享因果过程施加受控干预与分布偏移，从多个相关环境采样构建合成预训练上下文，鼓励学习更全面、任务特定的表征；2）Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer：迭代且选择性地对共享Transformer块组进行复用，以任务条件门控调节最终隐状态更新，实现任务自适应迭代精炼。
AI.result: 在6个分类和5个回归基准数据集上，TAFFY取得最低的平均排名。
AI.conclusion: 两项组件使模型在预训练中通过上下文对比识别预测关系，并动态调节上下文整合，从而提升表格任务的in-context学习表现。

title: WorkflowOps: Learning Agent Collaboration Priors for Multi-Agent Workflow Orchestration
summary: Multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed for complex knowledge work, yet their orchestration layers remain largely memoryless: each new task is decomposed, assigned, and executed from scratch with no benefit from prior successful executions. We present WorkflowOps, a multi-agent workflow orchestration framework that learns agent collaboration priors from historical workflows and expands its agent pool on demand to cover new capability requirements. Our approach introduces three coupled mechanisms. First, a transition probability matrix captures pairwise agent collaboration frequencies from past workflows and applies them as soft guidance during DAG workflow construction through intra-layer ordering optimization, probability-thresholded edge suggestion, and transitive reduction for parallelism maximization. Second, a sufficiency-driven agent creation loop detects capability gaps via semantic matching scores, generates specialized agents through an LLM, and simultaneously injects them into the collaboration matrix, so that newly created agents are immediately usable with predicted collaboration priors. Third, a layered semantic matching strategy uses pre-trained sentence embeddings for fast, deterministic capability matching as a first pass, invoking LLM verification only for low-confidence cases, thereby reducing LLM routing calls by over 80\% compared to pure-LLM approaches. Experiments on mixed code, math, and question-answering suites show that WorkflowOps improves end-to-end pass rates over recent workflow-construction baselines, with the largest gains on structured, decomposable tasks where past agent handoff patterns transfer.

AI.tldr: WorkflowOps 是一个多智能体工作流编排框架，通过从历史工作流学习智能体协作先验并按需扩展智能体池，提升复杂知识工作的任务通过率。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体编排层大多"无记忆"，每个新任务都从零开始分解、分配和执行，无法利用以往成功执行的经验，导致重复低效且难以覆盖新能力需求。
AI.method: 三项耦合机制：(1) 转移概率矩阵从历史工作流捕获成对智能体协作频率，通过层内排序优化、概率阈值边建议与传递约简最大化并行度，为 DAG 工作流构建提供软引导；(2) 充分性驱动的智能体创建循环，用语义匹配分数检测能力缺口，经 LLM 生成专用智能体并同步注入协作矩阵，使其立即具备预测协作先验；(3) 分层语义匹配策略，先用预训练句嵌入做快速确定性能力匹配，仅对低置信度案例调用 LLM 验证。
AI.result: 相较纯 LLM 方法，LLM 路由调用减少 80% 以上；在代码、数学和问答混合测试集上，端到端通过率优于近期工作流构建基线，在结构化、可分解且过去智能体交接模式可迁移的任务上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 利用历史协作先验与按需智能体扩展，可显著提升多智能体工作流编排的效率与效果，尤其适合结构化可分解任务。

title: Stateless Language Agents: Scaling Long-Horizon Automated Research
summary: Automated research systems increasingly run LLM agents over long horizons, but more inference does not by itself produce more progress: agents replay growing histories, duplicate one another's work, or stop experimenting while token consumption continues. Yet most evaluations use short budgets or benchmarks that saturate early, leaving these failure modes untested. We trace these failures to two choices: where research state lives and who decides what to try next. We introduce Stateless Language Agents (SLAs), built on the principle of stateful search with stateless agents: no agent carries its conversation across invocations; instead, the harness owns the research state (candidate solutions and measured outcomes) and reconstructs a fresh and role-specific context for every invocation. What each agent sees becomes an explicit design choice rather than a history that grows with the run. We implement this principle in the SLA framework, where a stateless Advisor reads harness-summarized evidence across search directions and assigns concrete experiments to parallel Workers. We evaluate SLA against three recent frameworks on software engineering, kernel optimization, and algorithm design at budgets of up to one billion tokens. SLA achieves the best final result on every task and reaches the strongest kernel baseline's final performance with over 84% fewer tokens. Ablations from shared checkpoints show that focused contexts and explicit assignments each contribute to SLA's progress, with effects that can compound over full runs, while the Advisor consumes less than 0.6% of tokens. These results argue for SLAs, which keep durable research state out of agent conversations, and show that short evaluation horizons can misjudge research systems and their components.

AI.tldr: 论文提出无状态语言智能体（SLA），通过"有状态搜索、无状态智能体"原则，将研究状态交由harness管理，为每次调用重建精简的角色专属上下文，从而提升长时程自主研究系统的效率与进展。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化研究系统让LLM智能体长时间运行，但更多推理并不带来更多进展：智能体反复重放增长的历史、重复他人工作、或停止实验却持续消耗token。多数评测使用短预算或早期饱和的基准，无法暴露这些失效模式。
AI.method: 将失败根源归结为两点：研究状态存放位置与谁决定下一步尝试。提出SLA框架，遵循"有状态搜索、无状态智能体"：智能体不在调用间携带对话，由harness持有研究状态（候选解与测量结果），每次调用重建全新的角色专属上下文。实现中，无状态Advisor读取harness汇总的多方向证据并分配具体实验给并行Worker。
AI.result: 在软件工程、内核优化和算法设计任务上，对三个近期框架评测，预算高达十亿token。SLA在所有任务上取得最佳最终结果，并在内核任务上以少84%以上的token达到最强基线的最终性能。共享检查点消融表明，聚焦上下文与显式分配各自有贡献且效果可累积，Advisor消耗不足0.6% token。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持SLA：将持久研究状态置于智能体对话之外；并表明短评估时程可能误判研究系统及其组件。

title: Self-Referenced Social Preferences: Cooperation without Observing Others Rewards
summary: Social preferences can promote cooperation in multi-agent reinforcement learning, but existing approaches often require agents to observe the rewards of their peers. In many real-world interactions, however, an agent can, as humans do, observe others' behavior and outcomes without access to their private reward signals. We introduce self-referenced social preferences, in which each agent learns a model of its own reward, applies it to other agents' observed transitions to assess their outcomes from its own perspective, and feeds these self-referenced assessments into standard social preferences. We study two ways to incorporate these assessments: modifying the learning reward, or using them to weight policy updates. We evaluate the approach on three sequential social dilemmas, Escape Room, Clean Up, and Commons Harvest, which require volunteering, public-good contribution, and resource restraint, respectively. Across all three environments, agents learn cooperative behavior without observing others' rewards, including in settings where independent learners fail to cooperate, and frequently achieve more equitable divisions of jointly produced returns than agents with access to true rewards. The effective integration point depends on the social preference: inequity aversion works best in the reward together with a value look-ahead, whereas a purely benevolent preference benefits from policy-update weighting. Under partial observability, the policy-update approach continues to support cooperation. These results show that explicit access to other agents' reward signals is not necessary for learning cooperative behavior: social preferences can instead be grounded in self-referenced assessments of others' outcomes derived from their observed behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出"自参照社会偏好"，让智能体无需观察他人私有奖励，通过学习自身奖励模型来评估他人行为结果，并在三个社会困境环境中实现合作。
AI.motivation: 现有社会偏好方法通常要求智能体观察同伴的奖励信号，但现实中智能体往往只能观察他人行为与结果，无法获取其私有奖励。
AI.method: 每个智能体学习自身奖励模型，将其应用于其他智能体的观测转移以从自身视角评估其收益，并将该自参照评估输入标准社会偏好；两种整合方式：修改学习奖励，或用于加权策略更新。
AI.result: 在Escape Room、Clean Up、Commons Harvest三个社会困境中，智能体均在不观察他人奖励的情况下学会合作，甚至优于独立学习者，且常比能获取真实奖励的智能体实现更公平的收益分配。整合方式取决于社会偏好：不平等厌恶适合奖励端配合价值前瞻，纯粹利他偏好适合策略更新加权。部分可观测下策略更新法仍支持合作。
AI.conclusion: 显式获取他人奖励信号并非学习合作行为的必要条件；社会偏好可基于从他人行为推断的自参照结果评估来建立。

title: Complementary Feature Domains: Information Preservation Does Not Imply Predictive-Contribution Preservation
summary: Complementary Feature Domains (CFD) theory characterizes predictive value as a context-indexed contribution system induced jointly by representations and their realization family. We show that Shannon-information preservation does not imply preservation of this contribution system: an invertible representation transformation can leave target information unchanged while altering predictive contribution under a restricted decision family. We formalize the resulting transition through a CFD contribution defect that measures how contextual contributions change under controlled recoding. For bounded Lipschitz utility, we show that each coalition utility shift is bounded by the behavioral distance between the attainable action sets before and after recoding; consequently, every contextual contribution defect is bounded by the sum of the corresponding coalition incompatibilities. Exact behavioral closure yields invariance, while increasingly accurate compensation yields restoration. A controlled ECG experiment illustrates the mechanism: a nonlinear bijective recoding preserves the information in a frozen time-frequency representation but changes accuracy under a fixed affine learner; applying the exact inverse restores all tested coalition accuracies. The result separates information preservation from realization-dependent contribution and provides a quantitative transition law for multi-representation prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出"互补特征域(CFD)"理论：预测价值是由表示及其实现族共同诱导、以上下文索引的贡献系统；Shannon信息保持不等于该贡献系统保持，并给出贡献缺陷的定量转移律。
AI.motivation: 信息论意义上的信息保持(可逆变换不改变目标信息)常被视为表示优劣的充分标准，但实际预测贡献还依赖于受限决策族与实现方式，二者可能不一致，需要理论刻画这种分离。
AI.method: 形式化CFD贡献缺陷，度量受控重编码下上下文贡献的变化；在有界Lipschitz效用下，证明每个联盟效用变化被重编码前后可达动作集的行为距离所界，因而每个上下文贡献缺陷被相应联盟不兼容度之和所界；定义精确行为闭包(不变性)与逐步精确补偿(恢复)。并以受控ECG实验验证。
AI.result: 理论上给出效用偏移与贡献缺陷的界及不变/恢复条件；实验中，非线性双射重编码在冻结时频表示下保持信息不变，却改变固定仿射学习器的准确率，施加精确逆变换即恢复所有测试联盟的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 将信息保持与实现相关的预测贡献相分离，为多表示预测提供定量转移律，说明可逆性不足以保障决策族下的贡献稳定。

title: ShanLiangRen: A Nutrition Agent for Personalized Daily Meal Planning
summary: Dietary nutrition planning plays an important role in chronic disease management and maintaining a healthy body. In applications, it must simultaneously satisfy personalized constraints and reasonable multidimensional nutritional goals. These two aspects often conflict, and user constraints evolve with feedback, resulting in a substantial gap between generic guidelines and executable plans. To bridge this gap, we first propose the personalized fully quantified multiobjective dietary planning problem (MDP). To tackle MDP, we develop a nutrition agent, ShanLiangRen. The system first transforms dietary specifications, nutrient data, user attributes and natural language requirements into an individualized constrained planning instance. It then employs an exact retrieval-augmented generation method to shrink the feasible candidate set from a large scale ingredient and recipe space. Finally, it adopts a refinement guided by Pareto principles, where an LLM iteratively revises candidate plans under deterministic nutrition computation and feedback from constraint verification. The system outputs fully quantified meal plans with explicit ingredients and portion sizes, together with reports on nutrition compliance that show constraint satisfaction and nutrient interval attainment. We have released the system online as a WeChat Program, ShanLiangRen. A demo video is available at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=652OtY5VlGA.

AI.tldr: 提出个性化全量化多目标膳食规划问题(MDP)，并开发营养智能体"膳良人"，通过约束规划建模、精确检索增强生成和帕累托引导的LLM迭代优化，输出含具体食材与份量的膳食方案。
AI.motivation: 膳食营养规划需同时满足个性化约束与多维营养目标，二者常冲突且约束随反馈演变，导致通用指南与实际可执行方案间存在较大差距。
AI.method: 先建模为个性化全量化多目标膳食规划问题(MDP)；系统将膳食规范、营养数据、用户属性与自然语言需求转为个体化约束规划实例；用精确检索增强生成从大规模食材菜谱空间缩减候选集；再以帕累托原则引导LLM在确定性营养计算与约束验证反馈下迭代优化方案。
AI.result: 系统输出全量化膳食方案（明确食材与份量）及营养合规报告，展示约束满足情况与营养区间达成度；已上线微信小程序"膳良人"，并附演示视频。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥合了通用营养指南与可执行个性化膳食方案之间的差距，验证了LLM结合约束规划与检索增强在真实膳食规划场景中的可行性与落地能力。

title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Atmospheric Rivers in GraphCast
summary: While AI weather models now rival operational forecasts, how they represent the atmosphere internally remains an open question: feature attribution reveals which input patterns matter, not what the model computes or how it combines information internally. We train sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on GraphCast to uncover its learned concepts, using atmospheric rivers as our phenomenon of focus. Both standard and Matryoshka SAEs show GraphCast computes atmospheric river intensity, measured by integrated vapor transport (IVT), as a stable internal variable, despite IVT being neither an input nor a target. In contrast to the unstructured concept retrieval of the standard SAE, the Matryoshka SAE orders concepts by importance and exposes their relations. Atmospheric river concepts persist across depth and direct interventions confirm causality. This method offers a way to find internal variables and determine which of them the model actually relies on, which is a prerequisite for asking whether those variables remain meaningful as the phenomenon changes under a warming climate.

AI.tldr: 该论文用稀疏自编码器(SAE)分析GraphCast内部表征，发现模型自发计算了大气河流强度(IVT)这一稳定内部变量，并通过干预验证其因果性。
AI.motivation: AI天气模型预测能力已接近业务预报，但其内部如何表征大气仍是未解问题。特征归因只能揭示哪些输入重要，无法说明模型计算了什么、如何组合信息。
AI.method: 在GraphCast上训练标准与Matryoshka稀疏自编码器(SAE)以发掘其学习到的概念，以大气河流为研究对象，进行深层概念追踪与因果干预实验。
AI.result: 两种SAE均显示GraphCast将大气河流强度(以IVT度量)作为稳定的内部变量计算，尽管IVT既非输入也非目标。Matryoshka SAE按重要性排序概念并揭示其关系，优于标准SAE的无结构检索；大气河流概念跨深度持续存在，干预实验证实其因果作用。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能发现模型的内部变量并判定模型真正依赖哪些变量，是进一步研究这些变量在变暖气候下现象变化时是否仍有意义的前提。

title: Improving Synthetic Data Generation for Argument Mining via Adversarial Reinforcement Learning
summary: Argument Mining (AM) is fundamentally constrained by the scarcity of high-quality structure-annotated datasets. While LLMs have shown promise in synthetic data generation, producing synthetic AM data that is both structurally accurate and sufficiently diverse remains a challenging problem. To address this problem, we revisit synthetic data generation for AM from a new perspective and propose a novel adversarial reinforcement learning framework for data synthesis. The proposed framework jointly optimizes the generator and the discriminator in an adversarial loop, in which the generator produces structured AM instances, and the discriminator provides learning signals by distinguishing real data from synthetic candidates. This enables the generator to progressively improve both the structural accuracy of generated argument data while maintaining diversity through adversarial feedback. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently improves AM performance on three benchmark datasets in both full-data and low-resource settings, validating its effectiveness and scalability.

AI.tldr: 提出对抗强化学习框架合成Argument Mining数据，联合优化生成器与判别器，在三个基准数据集上提升AM性能。
AI.motivation: Argument Mining受限于高质量结构化标注数据的稀缺。虽然LLM在合成数据生成上展现潜力，但生成结构准确且足够多样的AM合成数据仍是难题。
AI.method: 从新视角重新审视AM合成数据生成，提出新颖的对抗强化学习框架。该框架在对抗循环中联合优化生成器与判别器：生成器产生结构化AM实例，判别器通过区分真实数据和合成候选提供学习信号，使生成器在保持多样性的同时渐进提升结构准确性。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上，无论全数据还是低资源设置，均持续提升AM性能，验证了方法的有效性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 对抗强化学习框架可有效提升AM合成数据的结构准确性与多样性，具备良好的有效性和可扩展性。

title: Textual Environmental Context and Spatial Graphs for LLM-Based Regional SST Forecasting
summary: Sea surface temperature (SST) forecasting depends on local temporal persistence, regional spatial dependence, and environmental conditions that evolve with the forecast date. We study how these heterogeneous conditions can be presented to a large language model (LLM) for regional multi-step forecasting without serializing the full SST grid as text. We formulate forecasting as conditional numerical generation: historical SST and anomaly sequences, date-aligned environmental records, and static ocean knowledge form a textual context, while regional spatial state is supplied through continuous graph-derived prefixes. A static graph encodes persistent geographic--climatological relations, and a dynamic graph encodes recent SST correlations and localized tropical-cyclone influence. Two graph neural networks produce a target-node representation that is mapped by a spatial-prefix fusion and injected into the LLM input. On SST forecasting in the South China Sea, the complete configuration achieves the best MAE and $\Rtwo$ among the compared methods over ten forecast steps. Alongside the numerical forecast, a rule-based module matches predicted trends and environmental-factor directions with knowledge entries to return source-linked, post-hoc contextual explanations.

AI.tldr: 提出将海表温度（SST）预测建模为条件数值生成任务，通过图神经网络生成连续空间前缀注入大语言模型（LLM），避免将完整SST网格序列化为文本。
AI.motivation: SST预测依赖局部时间持续性、区域空间依赖以及与预测日期共同演变的环境条件，这些异质条件难以统一呈现给LLM；同时直接序列化完整SST网格为文本代价高且不实用。
AI.method: 将预测建模为条件数值生成：历史SST与异常序列、日期对齐的环境记录、静态海洋知识构成文本上下文；区域空间状态通过图导出的连续前缀提供。使用静态图编码持久地理-气候关系，动态图编码近期SST相关性与局地热带气旋影响；两个GNN生成目标节点表示，经空间前缀融合后注入LLM输入。
AI.result: 在南海SST预测任务上，完整配置在10个预测步内取得对比方法中最佳MAE和R²。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效结合图结构与LLM进行区域多步SST预测；同时通过基于规则的模块将预测趋势与环境因子方向匹配知识条目，返回带来源链接的事后上下文解释。

title: Hub for Outliers, Spokes for Inliers: Uniform Latent Space Construction for Dual-Mismatched Semi-Supervised Learning
comment: Equal contribution by Li Yuan and Yaxin Hou. Corresponding author: Yuheng Jia. Emails: {yuan-li,yaxin,230259148,yhjia}@seu.edu.cn, gaoyb@qlu.edu.cn. 18 pages
summary: Semi-supervised learning typically assumes that labeled and unlabeled data share an identical class distribution and label space. However, this setting is often violated: unlabeled data may be imbalanced and contain unknown class samples, causing mismatches in both class distribution and label space. Such dual mismatch leads to majority classes dominating the latent space and unknown class samples being overconfidently misclassified, degrading feature discriminability and pseudo-label quality. To address this, we propose a hub-spoke latent geometry, where known classes are uniformly distributed around a central hub and each class forms compact clusters around its prototype, while the hub provides an anchor for a low-evidence region specifically designed for high-uncertainty unknown class samples. Integrated with an evidence-based classifier, this geometry ultimately enhances feature discriminability and uncertainty separation by mitigating majority-class domination through structured feature organization and guiding high-uncertainty unknown class samples toward the hub. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with a maximum improvement of 3.25% across various settings.

AI.tldr: 论文针对半监督学习中标签与无标签数据存在类别分布和标签空间双重不匹配的问题，提出轮辐式（hub-spoke）潜在几何结构与证据分类器结合的方法，提升特征判别性与不确定性分离。
AI.motivation: 半监督学习通常假设有标签与无标签数据类别分布与标签空间一致，但实际中无标签数据常类别不平衡且含未知类样本，造成双重不匹配，导致多数类主导潜在空间、未知类样本被过度自信误分类，降低特征判别性和伪标签质量。
AI.method: 提出 hub-spoke 潜在几何：已知类均匀分布于中心 hub 周围，各类围绕其原型形成紧凑簇；hub 作为低证据区域锚点，专门容纳高不确定性的未知类样本。结合基于证据的分类器，通过结构化特征组织缓解多数类主导，并引导高不确定性未知类样本向 hub 聚集。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法优于现有最先进方法，在多种设置下最大提升达 3.25%。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化潜在几何与证据分类器的结合，可有效应对类别分布与标签空间的双重不匹配，增强特征判别性与不确定性分离。

title: TRACE: Rollout-Guided Quantization-Aware Training for FP4 Reinforcement Learning of MoE Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for post-training large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial computation and memory overhead during rollout generation, which motivates low-precision rollout for efficient RL training. However, existing FP4 RL methods suffer from a key limitation: they primarily optimize quantization accuracy on the training and rollout paths independently rather than directly reducing the discrepancy between the two quantized execution paths. In this work, we propose TRACE (Train-Rollout Quantization Alignment via Compact GuidancE), an FP4 quantization framework for RL training of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models that addresses the limitation of existing FP4 RL methods. TRACE incorporates rollout-guided quantization-aware training that uses rollout-side quantization outcomes to guide training-side FP4 rounding decisions, directly reducing train-rollout discrepancy. Moreover, TRACE adopts an efficient quantization-information caching scheme that selectively retains mantissa and scale information from deeper layers to reduce the storage and communication overhead introduced by rollout guidance. We evaluate TRACE on four large-scale MoE language models across reasoning, coding, and long-horizon RL tasks. Our results demonstrate that TRACE enables joint FP4 weight/activation and FP4 KV-cache rollout with RL performance comparable to BF16 rollout, while achieving up to 5.4xrollout speedup and strong final FP4 performance compared with post-hoc FP4 quantization of BF16-trained policies.

AI.tldr: TRACE是一个针对MoE大模型RL训练的FP4量化框架，通过训练-推演量化对齐与信息缓存，显著降低训练-推演路径差异，实现高效低精度训练。
AI.motivation: RL后训练大模型在rollout生成阶段计算与内存开销巨大，促使采用低精度rollout。然而现有FP4 RL方法仅独立优化训练与推演路径的量化精度，未直接减少两条量化执行路径间的差异，导致性能受限。
AI.method: 提出TRACE框架：1) rollout引导的量化感知训练，用推演侧量化结果指导训练侧FP4舍入决策，直接缩小训练-推演差异；2) 高效的量化信息缓存机制，选择性保留深层尾数与scale信息，降低引导带来的存储与通信开销。
AI.result: 在四个大规模MoE语言模型及推理、编程、长时程RL任务上评估：TRACE支持FP4权重/激活与FP4 KV-cache联合rollout，RL性能与BF16相当，rollout加速最高5.4倍，且最终FP4性能显著优于对BF16训练策略的事后FP4量化。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过直接对齐训练与推演量化路径，有效解决现有FP4 RL方法的局限，在保持RL性能的同时实现大幅加速，为MoE大模型高效RL训练提供了可行方案。

title: Isotropic Yet Undecodable: The Sequential Content-Sufficiency Gap in Latent-Predictive Text Representations
summary: We study sequential content sufficiency by investigating whether a representation retains the ordered target information available in its input. An information-theoretic decomposition separates input ambiguity, representation loss, and readout mismatch. We construct recoverable views where perfect agreement and joint isotropic Gaussianity coexist with zero target information, and establish limits imposed by deterministic canonical anchors. Token log-loss provides a one-sided information-loss bound; a fixed-penalty ridge analysis shows why rank alone cannot determine prediction risk. These results motivate CANOPE, a nonautoregressive framework with ordered latent canvases, canonical-token supervision, and geometric regularization. On 40,000 validation sequences, latent-agreement (PL0) and token-grounded (PL2) have nearly identical pooled ranks but reach 13.5% and 98.8% positional Recall@1, respectively, under strong natural corruption when the correct target length is provided. On 3,930 LJSpeech validation utterances, frozen PL2 with a trained MatchaTTS readout yields 21.54% word error rate (WER) on corrupted text, versus 99.22% for frozen PL0, while end-to-end MatchaTTS reaches 10.93%. These results show that geometric regularity alone does not guarantee recoverable sequential content or effective downstream access in the text settings studied here.

AI.tldr: 论文研究序列内容充分性，提出信息论分解与可恢复视图，揭示几何一致性不等于可恢复信息，并据此提出CANOPE框架。
AI.motivation: 探究表示是否保留输入中的有序目标信息，区分模糊性、表示损失与读出失配，说明仅靠几何规律无法保证可恢复的序列内容。
AI.method: 用信息论分解分离输入模糊、表示损失与读出失配；构造完美一致且联合各向同性高斯但目标信息为零的可恢复视图；分析确定性规范锚限制与固定惩罚岭回归；提出CANOPE非自回归框架（有序潜在画布、规范token监督、几何正则）。
AI.result: 4万验证序列中，PL0与PL2池化排名相近，但位置Recall@1分别为13.5%与98.8%；LJSpeech 3930句上，冻结PL2+MatchaTTS读出WER 21.54%，PL0为99.22%，端到端MatchaTTS为10.93%。
AI.conclusion: 几何规律本身不能保证可恢复的序列内容或有效的下游访问，序列充分性需要token落地的监督与结构设计。

title: AFA-BANDIT: Provably Near-Optimal Online Multi-Feature Classification Under Budget Constraints
summary: Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) is a classification problem in which an agent decides which costly features to acquire before predicting each sample's label. Unlike batch AFA, which trains a fixed policy and classifier offline on fully observed data, online AFA updates its predictor from revealed labels as samples arrive. Existing online methods either use deep reinforcement learning (RL) without performance guarantees or maximize cost-adjusted reward rather than enforce a global budget. We formulate online AFA as a combinatorial Bandits with Knapsacks (BwK) problem that couples acquisition and prediction. Unlike prior bandit-based AFA and classical BwK, our setting has combinatorial complexity, evolving rewards, a global budget, and structured side information. We obtain an improved regret upper bound over standard BwK bounds in this framework, leveraging a cardinality-aware confidence bound and the subset update structure. To avoid an exponentially large action space, we propose \emph{LP-Chain}, a variant that searches a cost-aware chain of feature subsets with a size that grows linearly with the number of features. While the regret upper bound is specific to the combinatorial framework, \emph{LP-Chain} empirically achieves comparable predictive performance. On synthetic data, \emph{LP-Chain} outperforms HEDGE-based BwK and deep RL-based online AFA baselines and scales favorably to more features.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将在线 Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) 建模为组合式 Bandits with Knapsacks (BwK) 问题，提出 LP-Chain 以线性规模搜索特征子集链，获得改进的 regret 上界并取得优于基线的实验表现。
