AI.motivation: 在线 AFA 需从逐步揭示的标签中在线更新预测器。现有方法要么用深度强化学习但无性能保证，要么优化成本调整后的奖励而非强制全局预算约束。需在全局预算、组合动作空间、动态奖励与结构化边信息下给出有理论保证的在线 AFA 框架。
AI.method: 将在线 AFA 形式化为组合 BwK，联合刻画特征获取与标签预测。利用基数感知置信界与子集更新结构推导 regret 上界。为规避指数级动作空间，提出 LP-Chain：在随特征数线性增长的规模内搜索成本感知的特征子集链。
AI.result: 在该组合框架下得到优于标准 BwK 的 regret 上界；LP-Chain 的 regret 上界针对组合框架给出，实证上实现可比的预测性能。在合成数据上优于 HEDGE-based BwK 与深度 RL 在线 AFA 基线，且随特征数增加扩展性良好。
AI.conclusion: 该工作搭起在线 AFA 与带背包约束组合赌博机之间的桥梁，兼顾理论保证与计算可行性，LP-Chain 在预算受限下实现有效且可扩展的在线特征获取。

title: Continuous Memory Machines
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Personalized, Aligned, Long-Term Memory for AI Systems (PALM)
summary: Recurrent neural networks typically compress information into a single vector-valued recurrent state, forcing short-term computation and long-term retention to share the same representation. Past extensions alleviate this bottleneck by increasing the memory capacity or separating timescales, but lack the combination of rapid neuron-level processing and longer-term retention found in biology. To that end, we introduce the Continuous Memory Machine (CMM), a recurrent architecture with matrix-valued short- and long-term memory states serving distinct functional roles. Building on the Continuous Thought Machine (CTM), the CMM's short-term memory tracks recent neural activity, with uniquely parameterized neuron-level models learning to use these activity patterns for computation. A persistent long-term memory stores information for later use, with a Transformer jointly updating both memory stores, providing an expressive bidirectional read--write mechanism such that each store can reorganize its own contents and both read from and write to the other. Across algorithmic, in-context learning, and recurrent reasoning tasks, the CMM outperforms a broad suite of baselines, exhibiting stronger generalization than prior memory-augmented networks while preserving the CTM's interpretable attention patterns. Code is available at https://github.com/SakanaAI/continuous-memory-machines.

AI.tldr: 提出连续记忆机器(CMM)，用矩阵值短期与长期记忆状态分离计算与留存功能，通过Transformer双向读写机制更新两个记忆，在算法、上下文学习和循环推理任务上超越多种基线。
AI.motivation: 传统RNN将信息压缩为单一向量状态，迫使短期计算与长期保留共享同一表示。已有方法通过增大容量或分离时间尺度缓解瓶颈，但缺乏生物学中"神经元级快速处理+长期留存"的结合。
AI.method: 基于Continuous Thought Machine (CTM)，引入矩阵值的短期和长期记忆状态：短期记忆跟踪近期神经活动，配有独特参数化的神经元级模型学习利用这些活动模式进行计算；长期记忆持久存储信息；由Transformer联合更新两个记忆，实现富有表达力的双向读写机制，使每个记忆可重组自身内容并互相读写。
AI.result: 在算法、上下文学习和循环推理任务上，CMM超越广泛的基线套件，比先前记忆增强网络具有更强的泛化能力，同时保留了CTM的可解释注意力模式。
AI.conclusion: CMM通过分离短期与长期记忆并结合双向读写机制，实现了快速神经元级处理与长期留存的有效结合，为记忆增强循环架构提供了更优方案。

title: SIGMA: Self-Improving Alignment Generalization from a Model Spec
summary: LLM agents are increasingly capable of executing complex tasks and of recursively improving themselves on easy-to-verify objectives such as software engineering and mathematics. Since alignment is much harder to verify, this creates a growing risk of capabilities increasing without appropriate safety alignment, especially as capabilities expand to auto-research and cybersecurity. Existing approaches focus on capability self-improvement using verifiable feedback or on alignment training with supervision from stronger models or curated data, creating an external supervision bottleneck for alignment. We ask whether current models can improve their own safety alignment, and propose SIGMA, a data generation and training pipeline enabling alignment self-improvement that generalizes to out-of-distribution settings. Given only a "Model Spec" stating the model's desired behavior, SIGMA leverages a model's reasoning capabilities to strengthen its own safety reasoning. SIGMA first performs spec-guided task synthesis, using the candidate model as a task designer agent to generate diverse alignment dilemma scenarios and convert them into training tasks that stress-test its understanding of the Model Spec. Next, SIGMA conducts self-judged alignment training through supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning with the model itself as the reward model. Despite training only on single-turn chat data, SIGMA improves safety alignment in multi-turn agentic environments (AgentHarm harmfulness decreases from 22.6 to 14.8; Agentic Misalignment decreases from 79.1 to 3.8), outperforms Deliberative Alignment and Constitutional AI baselines, and retains general capability. Analyses show that a Model Spec balancing harmlessness and helpfulness, test-time reasoning for safety deliberation, and high-quality rubrics from SIGMA's task designer agent are crucial for effective self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出SIGMA，一种让模型仅凭"Model Spec"自行生成数据并训练，从而实现安全对齐自我提升的管道，可泛化到多轮智能体场景。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体可递归提升自身能力（软件工程、数学等易验证目标），但对齐难以验证，导致能力增长超出安全对齐，尤其向自动研究和网络安全扩展时风险加剧。现有方法依赖外部监督或更强模型反馈，形成对齐瓶颈。核心问题：模型能否自我提升其安全对齐？
AI.method: SIGMA利用模型自身推理能力强化安全推理，仅需描述期望行为的"Model Spec"。两步：(1) spec引导的任务合成——用候选模型作为任务设计智能体，生成多样化对齐困境场景并转化为训练任务，压力测试其对Model Spec的理解；(2) 自评判对齐训练——以模型自身作为奖励模型，进行监督微调和基于rubric的强化学习。
AI.result: 仅用单轮聊天数据训练，即在多轮智能体环境中提升安全对齐：AgentHarm有害性从22.6降至14.8，Agentic Misalignment从79.1降至3.8；优于Deliberative Alignment和Constitutional AI基线，且保持通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 平衡无害性与有用性的Model Spec、测试时安全审议推理、以及来自任务设计智能体的高质量rubric，是有效自我提升的关键。

title: Complementary Supervised and Self-Supervised Representations for Out-of-Distribution Graph Learning
summary:
Out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization remains challenging for graph neural networks (GNNs), as graph distributions can vary substantially across time and domains. Supervised and self-supervised graph representation learning are guided by distinct objectives and offer different perspectives on graph representations. In this work, we study whether self-supervised representations (SSL) can provide complementary signals to improve supervised OOD node classification. We develop two backbone-agnostic frameworks that exploit such information at different stages of learning and prediction. Co-Train jointly learns supervised and SSL representations and adaptively integrates them during training, while Dual-Space Retrieval performs non-parametric prediction in the two representation spaces and combines their predictions through confidence-aware fusion at inference time. The supervised and SSL encoders are separately parameterized and need not share the same GNN architecture.
  We evaluate multiple GNN backbones and two distinct SSL objectives, DGI and GRACE, on four graph benchmarks spanning temporal and cross-domain distribution shifts. Extensive experiments show that Co-Train consistently outperforms strong supervised OOD baselines, while Dual-Space Retrieval achieves competitive performance as a flexible non-parametric alternative. Results across different backbones and SSL objectives, together with representation analyses and ablations, demonstrate that SSL representations provide complementary information to supervised representations and can improve OOD node classification across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自监督表示(SSL)能否为监督式OOD节点分类提供互补信号，提出Co-Train与Dual-Space Retrieval两种框架，在多个基准上验证SSL表示的互补性可提升OOD性能。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络在分布外(OOD)泛化上面临挑战，因为图分布随时间与领域变化显著。监督学习与自监督学习的表示目标不同，可能提供互补视角，但二者结合以提升OOD节点分类的潜力尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 提出两种与骨干网络无关的框架：Co-Train在训练阶段联合学习监督与SSL表示并自适应融合；Dual-Space Retrieval在推理阶段于两个表示空间中进行非参数预测，并通过置信度感知融合。监督与SSL编码器分别参数化，无需共享同一GNN架构。
AI.result: 在四个跨时序与跨领域分布偏移的图基准上，采用多种GNN骨干与DGI、GRACE两种SSL目标进行评估。Co-Train持续优于强监督OOD基线，Dual-Space Retrieval作为灵活的非参数方案取得有竞争力的表现。
AI.conclusion: 跨骨干与SSL目标的实验结果、表示分析及消融研究表明，SSL表示为监督表示提供了互补信息，可在多种设置下提升OOD节点分类性能。

title: Confidence Reasoning Graphs: Structured Confidence Estimation for LLM Agents
summary: When using an LLM agent in a consequential domain, making an informed decision about whether to trust its output or intervene requires calibrated confidence in the agent's success. Confidence estimation for agents is difficult because evidence about success is distributed across heterogeneous, interdependent steps of an agent's trajectory. Practical agentic deployments introduce further challenges: frontier LLMs often provide limited access to internal signals, agent roll-outs are costly, and training data may be unavailable or quickly become outdated. To address these challenges, we introduce Confidence Reasoning Graphs (CRGs), an inference-time framework that estimates the probability an agent accomplished its task from a single trajectory, without privileged model access or training data. Rather than compressing an execution into a single holistic judgment, a CRG begins with the claim that the agent accomplished its task, decomposes it into contextualized sub-claims grounded in trajectory evidence, estimates confidence for each terminal claim, and finally aggregates these into an overall confidence estimate. Across three agentic benchmarks, three backbone models, and three agent frameworks, CRGs yield better-calibrated confidence and stronger risk-aware decision making than verbalized, sampling-based, and white-box surrogate baselines. We further find that calibration error alone can be misleading: a white-box surrogate baseline appears well calibrated while providing near-chance discrimination. Ablations attribute CRG's improvements to claim-level confidence estimation and aggregation rather than graph construction alone. Finally, a CRG exposes the claims and trajectory evidence underlying each confidence estimate, enabling it to be audited at decision time.

AI.tldr: 提出Confidence Reasoning Graphs（CRG），一种无需特权模型访问或训练数据的推理时框架，通过将单条轨迹分解为基于证据的子断言并聚合，估计智能体任务成功率，实现更好校准的置信度与风险决策。
AI.motivation: 在关键领域使用LLM智能体时，判断是否信任其输出需要校准的置信度。但成功证据分散在异构、相互依赖的轨迹步骤中；实际部署中前沿模型内部信号受限、roll-out成本高、训练数据可能缺失或过时，现有方法难以应对。
AI.method: CRG从"智能体完成任务"这一顶层断言出发，将其分解为基于轨迹证据的情境化子断言，估计每个终端断言的置信度，最后聚合为整体置信度估计。整个过程仅依赖单条轨迹，不需要特权模型访问或训练数据。
AI.result: 在三个智能体基准、三个主干模型和三个智能体框架上，CRG比口头化、采样和白盒代理基线获得更好校准的置信度和更强的风险感知决策。发现仅看校准误差可能误导：某白盒代理基线看似校准良好但判别力接近随机。消融表明改进来自断言级置信度估计与聚合而非图构建本身。
AI.conclusion: CRG能给出校准良好的置信度估计，并可展示支撑每个置信度的断言与轨迹证据，使其在决策时可被审计，适用于缺乏内部信号、训练数据或数据易过时的实际智能体部署场景。

title: Does On-Policy Distillation for Safety Pose Backdoor Risks?
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has attracted growing attention as an effective way to transfer capabilities from teacher models to student models. Recent studies further explore OPD as a tool for improving large language model safety with promising results. However, these approaches typically assume that the teacher and training data are trustworthy. In this paper, we uncover an overlooked threat to OPD for safety: a safety-aligned but backdoored teacher can propagate its hidden malicious behavior to an initially clean student. Under our threat model, a poisoning rate as low as 3% results in an attack success rate (ASR) of up to 70% on the distilled student. We further identify two training choices that can amplify this risk. First, increasing the number of training epochs can lead to high ASR even at low poisoning rates. With only 10 poisoned samples, ASR reaches 67% after 16 epochs. Second, the commonly used top-k KL can accelerate backdoor transfer, causing trigger-conditioned harmful behavior to emerge earlier than sampled-token KL in most settings. Alongside these findings, we explore a simple mitigation, Lazy Defense, which clips KL rewards to make student updates less aggressive, limiting aggressive updates and slowing backdoor learning. Experiments show that Lazy Defense delays backdoor transfer in low poisoning rate settings. Together, our findings reveal that OPD can propagate backdoors, highlighting the need to address the safety risks of OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示on-policy distillation (OPD)安全隐患：安全对齐但含后门的教师模型可将隐藏恶意行为传给原本干净的学生模型，低至3%投毒率即可达70%攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 近期OPD被用于提升大模型安全性，但这些方法通常假设教师模型与训练数据可信。作者指出这一假设存在被忽视的威胁：后门教师可能在蒸馏过程中传播恶意行为。
AI.method: 在威胁模型下研究后门传播，并分析两类放大风险的因素：(1) 增加训练轮数（epoch）。(2) 常用的top-k KL与采样token KL的对比。同时提出简单缓解方法Lazy Defense（裁剪KL奖励）。
AI.result: 3%投毒率达70% ASR；仅10个毒样本训练16轮后ASR达67%；top-k KL比采样token KL更快促成后门迁移；Lazy Defense在低投毒率下可延迟后门迁移。
AI.conclusion: OPD能够传播后门，其安全风险亟需重视与解决。

title: $α$Transfer: Coefficient Transfer for Efficient Model Merging
summary: Model merging offers a promising solution for combining multiple fine-tuned checkpoints into a single model through parameter arithmetic. However, finding optimal merging coefficients requires an extensive search that becomes prohibitively expensive as models scale in both size and number, due to high memory requirements and combinatorial growth in the search space. We show that, within the same model family, models exhibit highly congruent performance distributions over merging coefficients across different model sizes. This distributional similarity enables a practical paradigm we call \textit{$α$Transfer}: searching for optimal coefficients on a small proxy model, then directly transfer them to larger target models. We verify $α$Transfer across multiple merging methods, model families, and tasks. Experimental results demonstrate a 6$\times$ speedup and 70\% memory reduction on vision transformers, and a 20$\times$ speedup and 85\% memory reduction on large language models, while maintaining comparable performance. Our findings establish $α$Transfer as an efficient and generalizable approach to scaling model merging.

AI.tldr: 提出αTransfer范式：在小代理模型上搜索最优合并系数，直接迁移到大模型，显著降低开销。
AI.motivation: 模型合并需搜索最优合并系数，但随模型规模和数量增长，内存需求高且搜索空间组合爆炸，代价过高。
AI.method: 发现同一模型族内不同规模模型在合并系数上表现分布高度一致，据此在小代理模型上搜索最优系数，再迁移到大规模目标模型。
AI.result: 在多种合并方法、模型族和任务上验证：视觉Transformer实现6倍加速、70%内存降低；大语言模型实现20倍加速、85%内存降低，性能相当。
AI.conclusion: αTransfer是一种高效、可泛化的模型合并扩展方法。

title: Can Agents Work for Everyone? Cross-User Reliability for Mobile GUI Agents in Personalized User Interfaces
summary: Mobile GUI agents increasingly operate on interfaces influenced by users' histories and preferences, but their reliability across different users remains underexplored. We introduce PAIR (Personalized Application-state Instantiation and Rendering), a pipeline for constructing user-conditioned application states that enables controlled evaluation of the same task across different users. We further introduce RePAIR (Reinforcement learning with Personalization-Aware Interaction Rewards), a training approach that learns from cross-user differences in subgoal outcomes to improve reliability across user-conditioned mobile environments. Across six agents, we find substantial variation in task success across users and consistently lower subgoal achievement in user-conditioned UI contexts (6.98 to 15.4 pp). This gap further increases for personal targets drawn from each user's own content (8.77 to 22.0 pp). Failures in these contexts frequently involve selecting another item instead of the intended target, particularly before target exposure. Finally, RePAIR improves user-conditioned SAR (+5.87 pp), all-success (+7.50 pp), and overall Task SR (+9.42 pp) over its supervised fine-tuning parent on unseen users, providing initial evidence that explicitly learning from cross-user variation can improve GUI-agent reliability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PAIR流水线构建个性化应用状态以评估GUI智能体的跨用户可靠性，并引入RePAIR训练方法从跨用户子目标差异中学习，实验表明个性化环境显著降低任务成功率，RePAIR能有效提升未见用户上的表现。
AI.motivation: 移动GUI智能体越来越多地在受用户历史与偏好影响的界面上运行，但其跨不同用户的可靠性尚缺乏研究。现有评估难以在控制条件下比较同一任务在不同用户上的表现，也缺少利用用户间差异来提升鲁棒性的方法。
AI.method: 提出PAIR（Personalized Application-state Instantiation and Rendering）流水线，用于构建以用户为条件的应用状态，从而支持同一任务在不同用户间的受控评估；进一步提出RePAIR（带个性化感知交互奖励的强化学习），通过从跨用户子目标结果差异中学习来提升跨用户移动环境下的可靠性。
AI.result: 对六个智能体的评估显示，任务成功率在不同用户间差异显著；用户条件化UI上下文中的子目标达成率持续降低（6.98至15.4个百分点），当目标来自用户自身内容时差距进一步扩大（8.77至22.0个百分点）。失败常表现为选择了错误项而非目标项，尤其在目标暴露之前。RePAIR在未见用户上相比其监督微调基线提升了用户条件化SAR（+5.87 pp）、all-success（+7.50 pp）和整体Task SR（+9.42 pp）。
AI.conclusion: 个性化会显著影响GUI智能体的可靠性，且失败模式具有规律性。显式地从跨用户差异中学习（如RePAIR）能提升GUI智能体在未见用户上的可靠性，为构建个性化鲁棒的GUI智能体提供了初步证据。

title: MS-ECG-FM: Towards a More Universal Electrocardiogram Foundation Model for Health Monitoring using Multi-source Contrastive Learning
comment: Andrew C. Miller, Joseph Futoma: equal contribution. 52 pages, 4 figures, 20 tables, including supplementary information
summary: Electrocardiography (ECG) records the electrical activity of the heart, aiding diagnosis by detecting abnormalities in cardiac function. ECG foundation models have demonstrated promising results, but are limited by a reliance on ECG interpretation reports as their sole supervision. Because interpretation reports only capture the subset of waveform information routinely recognized by clinicians, this constrains representation learning to overlook the broader diagnostic signals present in ECG. We introduce a new ECG foundation model --- MS-ECG-FM --- that is trained through contrastive alignment to multiple distinct clinical note types, including ECG, echocardiography, radiology, and discharge reports. We evaluate MS-ECG-FM on an extended set of ECG detection benchmarks, showing that it comprehensively outperforms existing methods on the full span of conditions that ECG can detect, including in reduced-lead configurations. Different reports improve representations for different diagnostic domains, while multi-source alignment captures their complementary information and produces consistently strong representations across clinically diverse tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 MS-ECG-FM，通过对比对齐多种临床报告类型来训练心电图基础模型，在 ECG 检测基准上全面超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 ECG 基础模型仅依赖 ECG 解读报告作为监督，而解读报告只涵盖临床医生常规识别的部分波形信息，导致表征学习忽略 ECG 中更广泛的诊断信号。
AI.method: MS-ECG-FM 通过对比学习对齐多种不同的临床报告类型，包括 ECG、超声心动图、放射学与出院报告，进行多源对齐训练。
AI.result: 在扩展的 ECG 检测基准上，MS-ECG-FM 在 ECG 可检测的全部病症范围内全面优于现有方法，包括在减少导联配置下。不同报告改善不同诊断领域的表征，多源对齐整合互补信息。
AI.conclusion: 多源临床报告对齐可学习到跨临床多样任务一致强大的表征，扩展了 ECG 基础模型的诊断覆盖范围与泛化能力。

title: Lost in the bf16 Cast: Exporting Ternary Language Models Can Revert Most Low-Learning-Rate Code Changes
summary: Ternary language models such as BitNet b1.58, Falcon-E and BitCPM are fine-tuned with higher-precision latent weights and deployed as ternary codes produced by an export step that, in the labs' documented pipelines, first casts the latents to bf16. We audit those pipelines across three labs. In released checkpoints, fp32 quantization of the shipped latents disagrees with the deployed codes on 0.83-1.77% of codes in Falcon-E and BitCPM and on 1.530% in BitNet 2B-4T; for Falcon-E and BitCPM most disagreements are products that bf16 rounding lands exactly on the threshold, which ties-to-even maps to zero, and the unmodified onebitllms exporter reproduces all four Falcon-E releases byte for byte. At fine-tuned endpoints, with learning rates selected to match a nominal learning-rate-to-bf16-ULP ratio, the documented export lowers greedy GSM8K strict accuracy from 58.79% to 0.78% for Falcon-E-1B-Base and from 36.13% to 0.39% for BitCPM-CANN-0.5B, and a bf16 save and reload lowers BitNet 2B-4T's strict accuracy by 27.54 points while its last-number accuracy rises. Two compatibility remedies, writing the training quantizer's codes directly or adjusting the bf16 inputs until the unchanged tools emit them, each met a 4-point strict-accuracy non-inferiority criterion against online evaluation in all three models. In two model families, randomized interventions on the initial distance from the threshold support distance-dependent selection of the codes that fine-tuning changes.

AI.tldr: 审计三个实验室的ternary语言模型导出流程发现:将隐权重转为bf16再量化的文档化流程会破坏部署代码,与fp32量化在0.83-1.77%的代码上不一致,并使微调后模型的GSM8K严格准确率大幅下降(如Falcon-E-1B-Base从58.79%降至0.78%)。两种兼容方案均可满足非劣性标准。
AI.motivation: Ternary语言模型以高精度隐权重微调,但部署时依赖导出步骤将其转为ternary代码。实验室文档流程中该步骤先将隐权重转为bf16,作者怀疑此bf16转换会影响最终部署代码的正确性与模型性能,因此跨三个实验室审计这些流程。
AI.method: 审计三实验室的导出流程;对比已发布checkpoint中fp32量化与部署代码的差异;用未修改的onebitllms导出器复现Falcon-E发布;在微调端点(选取匹配名义学习率与bf16-ULP比的学习率)测试文档化导出对GSM8K严格准确率的影响;评估两种兼容补救措施(直接写入训练量化器代码,或调整bf16输入使原工具输出正确代码);并用随机干预检验代码选择对初始阈值距离的依赖性。
AI.result: 已发布checkpoint中,fp32量化与部署代码在Falcon-E和BitCPM上有0.83-1.77%不一致,在BitNet 2B-4T上为1.530%;Falcon-E与BitCPM的大多数不一致源于bf16舍入恰好落在阈值上,ties-to-even映射为零;onebitllms导出器逐字节复现全部四个Falcon-E发布。微调端点上,文档化导出使Falcon-E-1B-Base严格准确率从58.79%降至0.78%,BitCPM-CANN-0.5B从36.13%降至0.39%;bf16保存重载使BitNet 2B-4T严格准确率下降27.54点,但末位数字准确率上升。两种兼容方案在三个模型上均满足4点严格准确率非劣性标准。两个模型家族中,对初始阈值距离的随机干预支持微调所改变代码的距离依赖选择。
AI.conclusion: 文档化的bf16导出流程会显著损害ternary语言模型的部署正确性与推理能力,尤其对微调后模型影响严重。直接写入训练量化器代码或调整bf16输入可有效修复兼容性问题并满足非劣性标准,证明该缺陷可通过不大改工具的方案缓解。

title: Learning from Revision Consequences: Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation for Self-Improving Agents
summary: As agents continuously improve by generating and revising Skills, the process that discovers and refines those Skills becomes a learnable object in its own right. Task-Skills directly act on task execution, whereas Meta-Skills govern how agents discover and improve future Skills; their value therefore emerges through the subsequent search processes they induce. Existing approaches improve Meta-Skills from observed raw Skill-search trajectories and branch outcomes. However, branch performance entangles the effects of the initial discovery state and the Meta-Skill revision that generated the search process, making it difficult to characterize what a particular revision actually changed, and pushing updates toward revisions that benefit from favorable states rather than those that improve the process. We introduce HMED (Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation), a mechanism for constructing Meta-Experience for self-improving agents. HMED revisits the completed event from which a revision originates and re-executes the incumbent and revised Meta-Skills from the same restored discovery state, so that the changes associated with the revision can be observed under a shared condition. Each comparison is distilled into a Meta-Experience, a structured record that can be reused by future updates, so that even revisions that are not ultimately retained still contribute a learning signal. Across three interactive agent benchmarks and both open-source and closed-source models, HMED consistently improves Skill discovery performance over strong baselines, shifting Meta-Skill learning beyond branch outcomes toward the consequences of changing the improvement process.

AI.tldr: 提出 HMED 机制，通过在同一初始发现状态下重执行新旧 Meta-Skill，消除分支结果混杂，蒸馏出可复用的 Meta-Experience 以提升自改进智能体的 Skill 发现能力。
AI.motivation: 现有从原始 Skill 搜索轨迹和分支结果中改进 Meta-Skill 的方法存在问题：分支表现同时纠缠了初始发现状态和 Meta-Skill 修订的效果，难以刻画某次修订真正改变了什么，导致更新偏向于依赖有利状态的修订，而非真正改进过程的修订。
AI.method: HMED（Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation）：回溯产生修订的已完成事件，从同一恢复的发现状态出发，分别重执行现有 Meta-Skill 与修订后的 Meta-Skill，在共享条件下观察修订带来的变化；将每次比较蒸馏为结构化记录的 Meta-Experience，供未来更新复用，使未被保留的修订也能提供学习信号。
AI.result: 在三个交互式智能体基准上，针对开源和闭源模型，HMED 在 Skill 发现性能上均稳定优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: HMED 将 Meta-Skill 学习从依赖分支结果转向关注改进过程本身带来的后果，为自改进智能体提供了更可靠的 Meta-Skill 优化路径。

title: Exact-Solution Volume and Length Generalization in Transformers
summary: Research on transformer expressivity shows whether a transformer is capable of solving a given task, but gives little indication of whether the solution, if learned, is generalizable to longer input lengths. We study this question through normalized exact-solution volume (NESV): the fraction of a bounded parameter region that achieves an exact solution on every input of length $n$. For fixed-width, single-layer transformers with $\log n$-scaled attention, we establish asymptotic bounds on NESV for four tasks: FIRST ($Θ(1)$), MAJORITY ($Θ(1/(n\log n))$), INDEX ($Θ(1/n^3)$), and PARITY ($0$). These results are consistent with previous empirical results: the faster the exact-solution volume decays with input length, the harder it is to length-generalize on that task. Looking deeper into INDEX, our volume analysis reveals two error sources that grow with $n$. Consequently, we study a transformer model that would structurally eliminate one of the terms, theoretically improving the NESV bound to $Θ(n^{-1})$, and empirically achieving 85% accuracy when tested at $10\times$ the training length, compared with the 60% accuracy of the original model. We conclude that volume analysis may be a useful approach to identify concrete sources of length sensitivity and thus provide insights into task-specific model refinements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出归一化解体积(NESV)度量,分析单层定宽Transformer在长输入上的长度泛化能力,给出四类任务的渐近界,并据此改进INDEX任务模型。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer表达能力研究只能说明某任务是否可解,却无法预测所学的解能否泛化到更长的输入长度,因此需要新度量刻画长度泛化难度。
AI.method: 定义NESV:在有界参数区域内,能在所有长度n输入上精确求解的参数比例。对定宽单层、注意力以logn缩放的Transformer,推导FIRST、MAJORITY、INDEX、PARITY的NESV渐近界;并针对INDEX做误差源分析,设计消除其中一项误差的结构性改进模型。
AI.result: NESV界为FIRST Θ(1)、MAJORITY Θ(1/(nlogn))、INDEX Θ(1/n^3)、PARITY为0,与经验结果一致:体积衰减越快越难长度泛化。改进模型将INDEX的NESV界提升至Θ(n^{-1}),在10倍训练长度上准确率达85%,优于原模型的60%。
AI.conclusion: 体积分析可识别长度敏感性的具体来源,为任务相关的模型改进提供指导。

title: Learning in Dreams, Winning in Reality: A Continuous Dyna Loop for a Ten-Hero MOBA
comment: 15 pages, 11 figures. Code, policies, evaluation and videos: https://github.com/JordyKieto/puffermoba-dyna
summary: World models are usually judged from the inside: by prediction loss, by the return a policy earns in imagination, or by how convincing their frames look. We judge one from the outside. We learn a structured, multi-agent world model of a complete ten-hero MOBA (206 units, every hero acting every tick, games of up to 6,000 ticks), train a policy only inside it with 1,400-tick free-running imagined episodes, and measure that policy in the real game against the opponent the game ships with. The real game never provides a gradient; it provides the policy's own games as training data for the world model, and an online evaluation that selects and anchors the policy. Run as a continuous asynchronous Dyna loop, the policy wins 70.2% of real games as radiant (421 of 600; 95% CI 66.4-73.7) on seeds never used for any decision, up from 0% for dream training alone and 33.7% before the loop. It wins none as dire, and neither does the shipped opponent when it plays itself. Four findings explain the result. Model exploitation is invisible from inside the dream: every unanchored run collapsed within a few updates while no in-dream metric tracked the collapse. A world model that is accurate on its training corpus is badly wrong on the policy's own games, and Dyna repairs it there, which is worth +9.2 points of real win rate with the policy recipe held fixed. Finally, the policy inherits its world model's fidelity profile mechanic by mechanic: the model represents the macro game but not crowd control, cast timing or lethality, and the policy wins by map-wide pressure with almost no coordinated fighting. We release the world model, the dream-PPO harness, a world-model debugger, the evaluation protocol, and every policy and log.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出从"外部"（真实游戏表现）而非内部指标来评估世界模型，构建了完整十英雄MOBA（206单位，每tick全部英雄行动，单局最长6000 tick）的结构化多智能体世界模型，仅在想象中训练策略（1400 tick自由演化），在真实游戏中评估。异步Dyna循环下，作为radiant在未用于任何决策的种子上赢得70.2%真实对局（600局中421胜，95% CI 66.4-73.7），而仅靠梦境训练为0%，循环前为33.7%。关键发现：梦境内部无法察觉模型被利用；世界模型在策略自身对局上严重出错，Dyna可在该处修复（+9.2个百分点）；策略按机制继承世界模型的保真度画像。
AI.motivation: 世界模型通常从内部评估（预测损失、想象回报、画面逼真度），这些指标无法反映模型在真实下游任务中的可用性，甚至可能完全掩盖模型被策略利用导致的崩溃。作者希望从外部——即真实游戏中的胜率——来评判世界模型，验证"仅在想象中训练、在真实中获胜"这一路径是否可行。
AI.method: 构建完整十英雄MOBA的结构化多智能体世界模型（206单位、每tick所有英雄行动、对局最长6000 tick）；仅在模型内用1400 tick自由演化想象回合训练策略（dream-PPO）；真实游戏不提供梯度，只提供策略自身对局数据用于更新世界模型，并通过在线评估选择与锚定策略；以连续异步Dyna循环运行。
AI.result: 作为radiant在未用于任何决策的种子上赢得70.2%真实对局（421/600，95% CI 66.4-73.7）；仅梦境训练为0%，循环前为33.7%。作为dire一局未赢，内置对手自我对弈时同样一局未赢。四项发现：无锚定的运行在几次更新内崩溃且内部指标毫无察觉；世界模型在策略自身对局上误差大，Dyna在此修复带来+9.2个百分点真实胜率；策略按机制继承世界模型的保真度画像（会宏观运营但不擅长控制、施法时机与击杀）。
AI.conclusion: 应从外部真实表现评估世界模型：仅在想象的MOBA世界模型中训练的策略可在真实游戏中以70.2%胜率击败内置对手，关键在于Dyna循环用真实对局修复模型在策略自身分布上的偏差，并用在线评估锚定策略防止模型被利用。策略的强弱几乎逐机制继承世界模型的保真度，说明提升世界模型在特定机制上的精度是提升策略能力的关键。作者开源世界模型、dream-PPO框架、世界模型调试器、评估协议及全部策略与日志。

title: Adaptive Model Inversion Attacks Generalize a Privacy-Robustness Tradeoff
summary:
In this paper, we show that standard evaluations of high-resolution Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs) significantly underestimate training-data privacy leakage. State-of-the-art privacy defenses, standard training techniques such as MixUp and Adversarial Training, and undefended models all leak training images at rates 1.16 to 6.59 times higher on FaceScrub under simple adaptive changes to the attack, with the largest increases among defenses reporting the strongest privacy. We further show that measured leakage depends on the feature basis of the external classifier used to evaluate reconstructions: for the same reconstructed images, an adversarially trained Inception evaluator identifies the targeted identity at different rates than the standard Inception evaluator. Our results suggest that standard MIA evaluation can mistake optimization and measurement failures for privacy.
  These underestimated leakage rates also concealed a broader relationship between privacy and adversarial robustness. Once we adapt the attack and vary the evaluator, reconstruction leakage closely tracks adversarial robustness across recent defenses and standard training regimes, suggesting that robustness provides an attack-agnostic proxy for reconstruction vulnerability that applies far more broadly than previously theorized. This raises an open question: can a practical defense reduce training-data reconstruction without paying a corresponding cost in adversarial robustness?

AI.tldr: 标准的高分辨率模型逆向攻击(MIA)评估严重低估了训练数据隐私泄漏；修正攻击与评估器后，泄漏率大幅上升，并揭示隐私泄漏与对抗鲁棒性强相关。
AI.motivation: 现有MIA评估可能把优化失败和测量失败误判为隐私保护良好，导致对隐私泄漏程度的低估。
AI.method: 对最先进隐私防御、MixUp、对抗训练及无防御模型，在FaceScrub上进行简单的自适应攻击改动，并变化外部分类器的特征基（标准Inception vs 对抗训练Inception）来评估重建。
AI.result: 泄漏率提高1.16至6.59倍，声称隐私最强的防御增幅最大；同一重建图像在不同评估器下识别率不同。
AI.conclusion: 修正评估后，重建泄漏与对抗鲁棒性紧密相关，鲁棒性可作为重构脆弱性的攻击无关代理；提出开放问题：能否在不牺牲对抗鲁棒性的前提下降低训练数据重构泄漏。

title: Same Feedback, Different Answer: Measuring Run-to-Run Instability in Frontier-Model Customer Feedback Analysis
summary: AI agents are increasingly being programmed to automate knowledge work over large collections of unstructured data. Such automation requires repeatability: when the underlying evidence is unchanged, the agent's categories, priorities, and counts should not shift materially between runs, even if each individual answer appears plausible. We introduce a repeat-run evaluation framework that aligns semantically equivalent categories and focuses on two operating metrics: theme churn, the normalized change in the returned category set, and volume disagreement, the change in counts for categories that persist. We evaluate three recurring customer-feedback tasks across eight frontier models, corpus sizes from 100 to 5,000 records, multiple prompts, and three execution designs: raw generation, taxonomy-free hierarchical decomposition, and a taxonomy-grounded agent (TGA) using persistent themes, subthemes, and record-level predictions. With Claude Opus 4.8 and the 1,000-record corpus fixed, TGA reduces theme churn by 86--88% relative to both raw generation and hierarchical decomposition, while matched-theme volumes have zero disagreement. The taxonomy-grounded agent is more stable than every raw model in the screen, remains more stable at each corpus size, and keeps this advantage when theme matching is made stricter or looser. Although evaluated on customer feedback, the framework targets repeated synthesis of unstructured corpora more broadly, including financial reports, legal documents, incident records, and scientific literature. Overall, these results show that taxonomy grounding produces more consistent and repeatable outputs for recurring knowledge work.

AI.tldr: 论文提出重复运行评估框架，通过主题流失率和体量分歧两个指标衡量AI代理在处理非结构化数据时的可重复性，并证明分类学锚定代理（TGA）显著提升稳定性。
AI.motivation: AI代理被广泛用于自动化知识工作，处理大规模非结构化数据。这类自动化需要可重复性：在底层证据不变时，代理返回的类别、优先级和计数不应在多次运行间发生实质变化，即使单次答案看起来合理。然而现有评估往往忽视这种运行间的稳定性问题。
AI.method: 提出重复运行评估框架，对齐语义等价的类别，并聚焦两个操作指标：主题流失率（返回类别集的归一化变化）和体量分歧（持续存在类别的计数变化）。评估三类客户反馈任务，涵盖八个前沿模型、100至5000条记录的语料规模、多种提示词，以及三种执行设计：原始生成、无分类学的层次分解、以及使用持久主题/子主题和记录级预测的分类学锚定代理（TGA）。
AI.result: 在Claude Opus 4.8和固定1000条记录语料下，TGA相较原始生成和层次分解将主题流失率降低86-88%，匹配主题的体量分歧为零。TGA比所有原始模型中任何一个都更稳定，在各语料规模下均保持更稳定，且在主题匹配更严格或更宽松时仍保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 尽管在客户反馈上评估，该框架面向更广泛的非结构化语料重复综合任务，包括财务报告、法律文件、事件记录和科学文献。结果表明分类学锚定能为重复性知识工作产生更一致、更可重复的输出。

title: A Broader Look at Model Merging: Rethinking Implicit Regularization Induced by Task Arithmetic
summary: Model merging aims to build a multi-task model cheaply by combining the weights of individual task-specific models. To perform well across multiple tasks, most existing merging methods use an additional dataset to find the coefficients for the best linear combination of task-specific weight updates. However, we identify an implicit regularization in this standard practice: searching over coefficients restricts the candidate models to a subspace spanned by task-specific weight updates. In this work, we investigate whether this regularization is actually useful. Surprisingly, empirical results show that optimizing merged-model weights without this regularization significantly boosts the performance of common merging methods across multiple architectures, domains, and even in an extremely data-limited scenario where only one instance is available per class. Moreover, directly optimizing the pretrained model weights even outperforms some existing merging methods. Analysis shows that better multi-task weights exist outside the subspace and can be found using multiple methods. We study different strategies for using the additional dataset, discussing their practical use and implications for model merging. Overall, this work calls for revisiting the existing model-merging pipeline, motivating a broader exploration of the weight space and a reconsideration of the implicit regularization induced by task arithmetic.

AI.tldr: 模型合并通常通过任务特定权重更新的线性组合系数搜索来找最优合并模型，但这隐式地将候选限制在子空间内。本文发现去除该正则化（直接优化合并权重）能显著提升性能，甚至优于现有合并方法，呼吁重新审视模型合并流程。
AI.motivation: 现有模型合并方法用额外数据集搜索任务特定权重更新的线性组合系数，但这隐式施加了正则化，将候选模型限制在任务权重更新张成的子空间内。作者质疑这种正则化是否真的有用。
AI.method: 通过去除系数搜索的正则化，直接优化合并模型权重（乃至直接优化预训练模型权重），并在多架构、多领域以及每类仅一个样本的极端数据受限场景下进行实验对比。
AI.result: 去正则化优化显著提升常见合并方法性能；直接优化预训练模型权重甚至超过部分现有合并方法；分析表明子空间之外存在更优的多任务权重，并可用多种方法找到。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁重新审视现有模型合并流程，鼓励更广泛地探索权重空间，并重新考虑任务算术带来的隐式正则化。

title: DAEDALUS: Bootstrapping Agent Memory from Self-Generated Tasks
comment: 9 pages (31 including Appendix), 8 figures (11 including Appendix). We release the code and artifacts, including generation and inference traces, at https://github.com/illuin-tech/daedalus
summary: LLM agents often lack the operational knowledge to act reliably in new environments, as they must discover specific tool behaviors or environment conventions on their own. Without memory of past attempts, they repeat the same mistakes across tasks, leading to more task failures and longer trajectories. To address this, agentic systems typically rely on human-written guidelines or on procedural memory built from training tasks and an oracle verifier, both of which require prior knowledge of the environment. We present DAEDALUS, a method for bootstrapping reusable agent memory from self-generated practice without existing tasks or oracle verifiers. DAEDALUS pairs two agents: an explorer that interacts with the environment to generate challenging yet solvable tasks, and a solver that attempts them. A heuristic is derived from each solver failure and accepted only after the solver repeatedly succeeds with that heuristic in context. These outcomes also provide feedback for the explorer to refine the difficulty of future tasks. Accepted heuristics are then consolidated into a memory bank for test-time use. Across AppWorld, $τ^2$-bench, and AutomationBench, DAEDALUS improves mean success rates by up to 15.9 points and pass^5 by up to 2.2x over a no-memory baseline, and is competitive with methods using training tasks, at a lower inference cost than most. We show that performance gains already emerge with a small exploration budget, and that its heuristics also benefit agents from other model families. Our ablations further reveal that solver traces provide the key information needed to derive effective heuristics, while factorizing early discoveries makes exploration more cost-efficient. Beyond memory construction, we find that the tasks generated by DAEDALUS can serve as a proxy for benchmark tasks when ranking models by performance. Code and artifacts: www.github.com/illuin-tech/daedalus.

AI.tldr: 提出DAEDALUS，无需已有任务或oracle验证器，通过自生成练习引导可复用智能体记忆。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在新环境中缺乏操作知识，需自行摸索工具行为与环境约定。因无过往记忆，会在不同任务间重复犯错，导致失败更多、轨迹更长。现有方案依赖人工规则或基于训练任务与oracle验证器的程序性记忆，均需环境先验知识。
AI.method: DAEDALUS配对两个智能体：探索者与环境交互生成有挑战但可解的任务，求解者尝试解决。每次失败后提炼启发式，仅当求解者在上下文中反复成功使用该启发式后才被接受；结果同时反馈给探索者调整后续任务难度。被接受的启发式整合为记忆库供测试时使用。
AI.result: 在AppWorld、τ²-bench和AutomationBench上，相较无记忆基线平均成功率提升至多15.9个百分点，pass^5提升至多2.2倍；与使用训练任务的方法相当，推理成本更低。小探索预算即有增益，其启发式也惠及其他模型家族。消融显示求解者轨迹是提炼有效启发式的关键，早期发现因子化使探索更具成本效率。生成任务可作为基准任务的代理用于模型排序。
AI.conclusion: DAEDALUS无需先验环境知识即可自举可复用记忆，在多种基准上显著优于无记忆基线并具成本优势，生成任务还能作为模型性能排序的代理。

title: WASD: Wasserstein-based Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models
summary: Autoregressive large language models (LLMs) have rapidly advanced in capability, but their increasing scale comes with substantial computational and memory costs at inference time. Knowledge distillation (KD) offers a practical solution by transferring knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student model via alignment of discrete probability distributions. However, existing KD methods for LLMs primarily rely on divergences that evaluate discrepancies through probability values at each vocabulary index, without explicitly leveraging token-level semantic information. We propose Wasserstein-based knowledge distillation (WASD) for LLMs, which incorporates token-level semantic information via the Wasserstein-based distance with a cost matrix derived from token embeddings. To ensure computational tractability, we adopt the Sinkhorn divergence and derive a gradient-equivalent objective that can be efficiently optimized without introducing additional networks. Experiments across multiple LLM families and scales show that WASD consistently improves distillation performance on diverse tasks, including instruction following, mathematical reasoning, and code generation. Our results highlight the importance of semantic information encoded in the token space for effective distribution alignment in LLM distillation. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/aailab-kaist/WASD .

AI.tldr: 提出WASD，利用基于token嵌入的Wasserstein距离进行LLM知识蒸馏，引入token级语义信息，实验验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM知识蒸馏方法主要依赖在词表各索引处通过概率值评估差异的散度，未显式利用token级语义信息。
AI.method: 提出Wasserstein-based知识蒸馏(WASD)，使用基于token嵌入构建代价矩阵的Wasserstein距离引入token级语义信息；为保证计算可行性，采用Sinkhorn散度并推导梯度等价目标，无需额外网络即可高效优化。
AI.result: 在多种LLM系列和规模上实验，WASD在指令遵循、数学推理、代码生成等任务上一致提升蒸馏性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显token空间中编码的语义信息对LLM蒸馏中有效分布对齐的重要性。

title: SpeedrunBench: Challenging LLM Agents with Video Game Speedrunning
summary: Frontier LLM agents have been shown to be capable of solving increasingly complex tasks for which humans have measurable solutions. This begs the pertinent question of whether LLM agents can go beyond what humans have already solved. The ability to develop sophisticated strategies to tackle consequential problems becomes paramount as well-trodden, human-developed solutions become insufficient for problems for which we lack context or enough training data. We study agents' capability of such strategy formation through the communal practice of video game speedrunning. In speedrunning, practitioners compete to find the fastest way to complete a video game under certain conditions, and in so doing uncovering interesting unorthodox play styles that require a thorough understanding and mastery of the underlying game mechanics. We introduce SPEEDRUNBENCH, a benchmark that evaluates frontier LLM agents across 9 different games. To perform well in this benchmark, agents must repeatedly improve their strategy, reflect on their performance, exploit their gained knowledge, and reason across a long-horizon of actions to improve on an increasingly difficult problem: being faster than themselves and everyone else. Our experiments show that while frontier agents approach human world records in simple platformer games, they remain behind human performance on longer, more complex games under practical budgets. These results suggest that SPEEDRUNBENCH is a useful testbed for studying agents' strategy formation capabilities as well as being a saturation-resistant evaluation measure, as there is almost always a faster completion time waiting to be discovered.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SPEEDRUNBENCH，通过电子游戏速通任务评估前沿 LLM 智能体的策略形成能力，覆盖 9 款游戏。
AI.motivation: 人类已解决的方案在缺乏上下文或训练数据的问题上不再够用，需探究 LLM 智能体能否超越人类已有解法、自主发展复杂策略。
AI.method: 以速通为社区实践场景，要求智能体反复改进策略、反思表现、利用已获知识并在长时程动作中推理，从而不断突破自身与他人速度极限。
AI.result: 在简单平台游戏中，前沿智能体接近人类世界纪录；但在更长、更复杂的游戏及实际预算下，仍落后于人类表现。
AI.conclusion: SPEEDRUNBENCH 可作为研究智能体策略形成能力的测试平台，也是一种抗饱和评估指标，因为总存在更快的完成时间待发现。

title: Neuromotor Hierarchy Network: Physiological Inductive Biases for Robust Generalization in sEMG Decoding
summary: Surface electromyography (sEMG) provides a wearable, noninvasive interface to neuromuscular activity for movement decoding and human-computer interaction. Population-scale decoding remains difficult because the relationship between sEMG and neuromuscular activity varies across users and sessions, while task-relevant dynamics span channels and multiple timescales. Learning waveform-to-output mappings from task labels leaves the distinction between recording variability and coordinated motor activity implicit. We introduce the Neuromotor Hierarchy Network (NHN), which learns a compact latent neuromotor state from task supervision to represent task-relevant neuromuscular coordination. NHN constructs this latent state through a hierarchy inspired by neuromotor organization.It adapts recording statistics while preserving relative intensity.Its spatiotemporal encoder uses parameter-efficient channel interactions and modulates features with multi-timescale history. The resulting features yield candidate activations of learned motor primitives, which are temporally integrated and continuously weighted to form the state. Theoretical analysis characterizes the efficiency, temporal behavior, and optimization of NHN's core mechanisms. We evaluate the architecture for both continuous hand-pose estimation on emg2pose and touch-typing recognition on emg2qwerty. On emg2pose, NHN reduces user-averaged angular error by 0.52% to 2.84% across all three generalization splits in both Regression and Tracking relative to Hadidi et al.'s best task-specific variants, using 48.42% to 48.51% fewer parameters. On emg2qwerty, NHN reduces beam-search character error rate by 19.40% zero-shot and 30.42% after fine-tuning relative to SplashNet-Upscale, using 65.86% fewer parameters. Physiology-guided inference of a latent neuromotor state supports parameter-efficient sEMG decoding.

AI.tldr: NHN通过生理启发的层级结构，从任务监督中学习紧凑的潜在神经运动状态，实现参数高效、跨用户/跨会话的sEMG解码。
AI.motivation: sEMG是可穿戴非侵入接口，但sEMG与神经肌肉活动关系随用户和会话变化，且任务相关动态跨通道、跨时间尺度，导致群体规模解码困难。从任务标签学习波形到输出映射无法显式区分记录变异与协调运动活动。
AI.method: 提出Neuromotor Hierarchy Network (NHN)：构建受神经运动组织启发的层级，学习潜在神经运动状态；适应记录统计并保留相对强度；时空编码器使用参数高效通道交互，并用多时间尺度历史调制特征；生成学习到的运动基元候选激活，经时间整合和连续加权形成状态。同时给出核心机制在效率、时间行为和优化方面的理论分析。
AI.result: 在emg2pose连续手部姿态估计上，NHN相比Hadidi等人最佳任务专用变体，在三种泛化划分的Regression和Tracking中均降低用户平均角度误差0.52%–2.84%，参数少48.42%–48.51%。在emg2qwerty触屏打字识别上，相比SplashNet-Upscale，零样本beam-search字符错误率降低19.40%，微调后降低30.42%，参数少65.86%。
AI.conclusion: 生理引导推断潜在神经运动状态可支持参数高效的sEMG解码。

title: Self-Retrospection Distillation: Turning Post-hoc Experiences into Prior Foresight
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) turns agent experience into learning signals primarily through scalar outcome rewards after interaction. For group-relative objectives, however, this signal vanishes when all rollouts receive the same reward, even though their trajectories may reveal useful information about what the task requires and how the agent fails. We ask a complementary question: can hindsight teach an agent what it could have anticipated before acting? We introduce prospective learning, which uses post-hoc experience to supervise foresight predictions from the pre-interaction view, and instantiate it with Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD). Intuitively, a completed trajectory reveals knowledge that would have been useful and pitfalls that should be avoided; SRD distills this privileged hindsight into trajectory-blind foresight of the same policy. Foresight serves only as a training target and need not be explicitly generated at inference time. Across 10 tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks, SRD complements RLVR and self-distillation baselines with gains of up to $24.2$ pp. Its advantage is especially pronounced when reward contrast is scarce: when $37$--$98\%$ of rollout groups are reward-uniform across model scales, yet SRD can still exploit learning signal from sampled trajectories. In the 2B setting, where $98\%$ of groups are all-failure, the RLVR training ends up at $0.0\%$ success, while adding SRD reaches $60.6\%$ under the same rollout budget. Our results suggest that post-hoc agent experience is useful not only for evaluating or improving behavior, but also for shaping predictive representations before available interaction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"前瞻性学习"(prospective learning)及自回溯蒸馏(SRD),利用事后经验监督交互前的预见性预测,解决RLVR在奖励同质时信号消失的问题。
AI.motivation: RLVR通过标量结果奖励学习,但在组相对目标中,当所有rollout奖励相同时信号消失(如37%-98%组奖励均一,2B设置98%全失败),浪费了轨迹中蕴含的信息。
AI.method: 前瞻性学习用事后经验监督交互前视角的预见预测;实例化为SRD:完整轨迹揭示有用知识与应避开的陷阱,SRD将这种特权事后信息蒸馏为同一策略的trajectory-blind预见。预见仅作训练目标,推理时无需生成。
AI.result: 在10个工具集成推理与长时程智能体任务上,SRD互补RLVR与自蒸馏基线,提升最高达24.2 pp;奖励对比稀缺时优势尤为明显。2B设置下98%组全失败,RLVR为0.0%,加SRD达60.6%。
AI.conclusion: 事后智能体经验不仅用于评估或改进行为,还可塑造交互前的预测性表征。

title: Cite What You Explore: Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning over Medical KGs with Verifiable Evidence
summary: Post-discharge risk prediction from electronic health records (EHRs) is difficult because many dependencies that link discharge-time observations to downstream complications, such as comorbidity cascades and drug-disease interactions, are absent from the record. External medical knowledge graphs (KGs) can supply these missing dependencies, but tracing them demands three properties: KG exploration must remain cost-bounded, retrieved evidence must be differentiated by source quality, and the resulting rationale must be citable for retrospective review. Large language models (LLMs) can plan and verify over structured evidence, making them natural candidates for KG reasoning, but existing LLM-based methods do not satisfy these three properties jointly. In this paper, we propose BAR, a Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning framework over medical KGs with three contributions. First, BAR refines the raw KG into disease-specific evidence graphs whose edges carry support scores and provenance records, turning the KG into a quality-annotated reasoning space rather than a static feature source. Second, an LLM then reasons over this graph through a plan-navigate-verify loop that decomposes the question into steps, retrieves evidence under a patient-specific budget, and revises when verification fails. Third, a reasoning policy is trained with a reward that compares predictions with and without acquired evidence, combined with acquisition cost and citation-integrity terms. Across 8 diseases and 3 prediction horizons on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, BAR improves AUPRC by 3.4 points over the strongest baseline, raises citation precision from 59.8% to 77.9%, and consumes only 62-65% of the budget cap.

AI.tldr: 提出BAR框架，基于医学知识图谱进行预算感知的LLM推理，用于出院后风险预测，兼顾成本约束、证据质量区分与可引用性。
AI.motivation: EHR中缺失许多连接出院观察与下游并发症的依赖关系（如共病级联、药物-疾病相互作用）。外部医学知识图谱可补充这些依赖，但需要满足三个属性：KG探索成本有界、检索证据按来源质量区分、推理依据可引用以供回顾审查。现有LLM方法无法同时满足这三点。
AI.method: BAR将原始KG精炼为疾病特定证据图，边带支持分数与来源记录，形成质量标注的推理空间；LLM通过"规划-导航-验证"循环在图上推理，分解问题、在患者特定预算下检索证据、验证失败时修正；用奖励训练推理策略，奖励对比有无获取证据的预测，并结合获取成本与引用完整性项。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上，覆盖8种疾病和3个预测时域，AUPRC比最强基线提升3.4个点，引用精确率从59.8%提升至77.9%，且仅消耗62-65%的预算上限。
AI.conclusion: BAR通过预算感知的LLM推理与质量标注的医学KG结合，有效提升了出院后风险预测性能，同时实现成本控制、证据质量区分与可引用推理。

title: POLAR: Ontology-Guided Risk Prevention for Tool-Calling LLM Agents
summary: LLM tool-use agents operate in dynamic environments where many actions carry operational risk. However, most safety mechanisms react only after errors manifest. Existing pre-emptive approaches either fine-tune the agent on chain-of-thought deliberation or compile natural-language guardrails into runtime checks, but they do so without exposing a structural, auditable verdict. We propose POLAR, a guardrail framework for small tool-calling agents that assesses reversibility through a structured two-layer ontology. POLAR assigns each action a graded reversibility score by deriving a candidate inverse sequence; calls failing a threshold are pruned before execution. Evaluated on $τ^2$-bench across six agent models, POLAR improves mean task reward by 0.11 to 0.18 points on airline for four of six agents, but only eight of eighteen model--domain cells improve overall; retail and stronger agents often regress. POLAR provides an auditable structural check and characterizes its task-utility trade-offs. Reward is not a direct measure of prevented harm.

AI.tldr: POLAR：一种面向小型工具调用智能体的护栏框架，通过结构化两层本体评估动作可逆性并提前剪枝，提升部分任务奖励但整体收益有限。
AI.motivation: LLM工具智能体在动态环境中执行动作常带操作风险，但现有安全机制多为事后反应；已有的预防性方法（微调思维链或编译自然语言护栏）缺乏结构化、可审计的判定结果。
AI.method: POLAR通过结构化两层本体评估动作可逆性，为每个动作生成候选逆向序列并赋予分级可逆性分数，对低于阈值的调用在执行前进行剪枝。
AI.result: 在τ²-bench上对六个智能体模型评估：航空领域四个模型的平均任务奖励提升0.11–0.18分；但18个模型-领域单元中仅8个整体改善，零售领域及较强智能体常出现退步。
AI.conclusion: POLAR提供了可审计的结构化检查并刻画了其任务效用权衡；奖励并非防止危害的直接度量。

title: Natural Language Questions as an Interface for Knowledge Graphs: QRAKEN Graph Distillation and Semantic Self-Healing
summary: Natural-language access to RDF knowledge graphs is a core Semantic Web ambition. Large language models (LLMs) have advanced Text-to-SPARQL, yet on unfamiliar graphs they often generate valid queries that misrepresent the populated data model. QRAKEN is a training-free, ontology-agnostic neurosymbolic pipeline grounding generation in empirical graph evidence rather than schema expectations. An offline distiller produces TTQL, a compact description of populated multi-hop patterns, conditional frequencies and path-conditioned literal examples, plus a class-property co-occurrence matrix. Online, TTQL guides the LLM, while deterministic syntax, vocabulary and data-model checks provide diagnostics for iterative refinement. On CK25 (First International Text2SPARQL Challenge), under matched-condition recomputation on a QLever snapshot, QRAKEN achieves strict F1 of 0.643 $\pm$ 0.026 with GPT-4.1 mini and 0.652 $\pm$ 0.012 with GPT-5.4: relative gains of 30% and 32% over the strongest recomputed participant, outperforming systems using the same base model family. Ablations identify TTQL patterns as the dominant driver (+0.31 strict F1 over a shape-only baseline); the refinement loop provides a cheap safety net, rejecting triple patterns unsupported by the co-occurrence matrix. Compared with auto-derived SHACL, TTQL yields 64% higher strict F1, supporting the value of empirical patterns beyond schema exposure. With two local 35B 4-bit open-weight models at zero marginal cost, the same pipeline matches the strongest recomputed participant, and TTQL advantages over shape-only and SHACL baselines persist. Results on a single, relatively small benchmark provide an initial empirical signal; monolithic TTQL injection on very open cross-domain graphs remains the main limitation.

AI.tldr: QRAKEN 是一种免训练、本体无关的神经符号管线，用离线蒸馏的 TTQL 将 RDF 图经验证据注入 LLM，以提升 Text-to-SPARQL 的严格 F1。
AI.motivation: LLM 在陌生图上生成的 SPARQL 查询虽语法有效，却常误解实际填充的数据模型，根源在于依赖 schema 预期而非图经验证据。
AI.method: 离线蒸馏器生成 TTQL，编码多跳模式、条件频率、路径条件字面量示例及类-属性共现矩阵；在线由 TTQL 引导 LLM，并通过确定性语法、词汇与数据模型检查迭代精炼。
AI.result: 在 CK25 上严格 F1 达 0.643±0.026（GPT-4.1 mini）和 0.652±0.012（GPT-5.4），相对最强重算参赛者提升 30%/32%；TTQL 相对 shape-only 基线 +0.31，比自动 SHACL 高 64%；两个本地 35B 4-bit 模型零边际成本即匹敌最强参赛者。
AI.conclusion: 经验模式优于单纯 schema 暴露，精炼循环提供低成本安全网；但结果基于单一较小基准，跨域开放图上的单体 TTQL 注入仍是主要局限。

title: Symphony for Text Generation: Benchmarking Clinical Note Generation
summary: Ambient documentation systems are rapidly gaining adoption, yet their impact on clinical note quality remains poorly characterized. We introduce MedConv, a multilingual dataset of 300 clinical encounters in English, Danish, and German, and use it alongside the Ambient Clinical Intelligence benchmark (ACI-BENCH) to compare Corti, a clinical AI platform, with two leading, accessible ambient scribe software applications built on general-purpose AI. We present a controlled clinical evaluation framework that combines entailment metrics with LLM-judged pairwise comparisons across eight dimensions adopted from PDSQI-9. Results show that Corti's API-based text-generation infrastructure is on par with or outperforms leading commercial scribes. We further show that Corti's configurable API provides the flexibility necessary to fine-tune quality dimensions for specific documentation use cases. We present the evaluation methodology and release a dataset to support future reproducible comparison of ambient documentation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多语言数据集MedConv与临床评估框架，对比Corti与两款主流通用AI环境记录软件，发现Corti在笔记质量上达到或超越领先商业产品。
AI.motivation: 环境文档系统快速普及，但其对临床笔记质量的影响尚缺乏充分表征，亟需可复现的评估方法。
AI.method: 构建MedConv多语言数据集（300例英/丹/德临床就诊），结合ACI-BENCH基准，提出融合蕴含度量与LLM评判的成对比较框架，覆盖PDSQI-9的八个维度。
AI.result: Corti基于API的文本生成基础设施与领先商业记录软件持平或更优，且其可配置API能针对特定文档用例微调质量维度。
AI.conclusion: 提供评估方法并发布数据集，支持未来对环境文档系统的可复现比较。

title: Beyond Corrected Memory: Execution Consistency in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Shared memory coordinates agents' actions, but correct records do not establish that those actions satisfy task requirements. Memory governance and failure diagnosis regulate or inspect recorded information; they do not by themselves establish whether it is sufficient to judge task duties. We define execution consistency through duties governing state use, information handoffs, and final-state agreement, with explicit evidence conditions for judging fulfillment. Our core claim is that identical retained records can correspond to compliant and violating executions under the same task rule. Controlled removal of evidence such as receipt, action dependence, or response validity leaves 82.4% of opposite-label pairs indistinguishable; restoration separates 97.9% of the merged pairs. Natural-log annotations identify the defined violations in actual executions. However, existing logs do not always explicitly represent the execution relationships needed for these judgments. To assess the definition's practical value, we use CAVERT, a framework for consistency diagnosis and recovery, to extract supported relationships from logs and apply these criteria. It consistently outperforms contract-prompted LLM and rule-based baselines in diagnosis across all 12 benchmark-executor settings. Under the same gate and executor limits, it also outperforms rule-guided recovery in all four evaluated environments. These findings identify execution evidence that agent-memory and execution interfaces should preserve for reliable judgment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"执行一致性"概念，通过职责（状态使用、信息交接、最终状态一致）及证据条件判断任务履行，指出相同记录可能对应合规与违规执行，并用CAVERT框架从日志提取关系进行诊断与恢复。
AI.motivation: 共享内存能协调智能体动作，但正确记录并不等于动作满足任务要求；现有记忆治理与失败诊断只监管/检查记录信息，无法单凭记录判断其是否足以评判任务职责。
AI.method: 定义执行一致性：由支配状态使用、信息交接和最终状态一致的职责构成，并给出判定履行的显式证据条件；通过受控移除证据（收据、动作依赖、响应有效性）与恢复实验验证；使用CAVERT框架从日志中提取支持关系并应用该判据。
AI.result: 受控移除证据使82.4%的相反标签对不可区分，恢复后97.9%的合并对可区分；自然日志标注可识别实际执行中的违规；CAVERT在全部12个基准-执行器设置中诊断优于合同提示LLM与规则基线，并在四个环境中恢复均优于规则引导恢复。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出智能体记忆与执行接口应保留的执行证据，以支持可靠的任务履行判断。

title: Towards One-for-All Foundation Model for Attributed Graph Clustering
summary: Attributed graph clustering aims to discover node groups by jointly exploiting node attributes and graph topology, yet its unsupervised nature makes model selection and adaptation inherently difficult. Existing methods typically train and tune a separate model for each input graph, leading to costly and fragile pipelines that often fail to transfer across graphs with different feature spaces, structural patterns, and attribute-structure correlations. In this paper, we study a one-for-all alternative: can a single model be trained once and directly applied to diverse attributed graphs without graph-specific training, fine-tuning, or hyperparameter search? We propose OFAG, a foundation model for attributed graph clustering. Building upon Prior-data Fitted Networks, OFAG learns a reusable clustering inference strategy from synthetic attributed graphs generated under broad priors over latent clusters, node attributes, and graph structures. To handle incompatible feature spaces across graphs, OFAG adopts a dimension-agnostic signal-wise graph encoder that treats each feature channel as a graph signal and models its response to shared graph filters. The model is trained with a hyperspherical clustering objective, producing clustering-friendly node representations in a single forward pass at inference time. On ten datasets, one frozen OFAG model achieves the best mean performance and average rank across NMI, ACC, ARI, and F1, while completing all ten datasets in 12.43 minutes total---over 6* faster than the second-fastest baseline and nearly 28* faster than the second-best on clustering quality. Our code and pretrained checkpoint are available at https://github.com/Cloudy1225/OFAG, allowing practitioners to directly apply OFAG to their own attributed graph datasets without additional training or tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出OFAG，一个用于属性图聚类的"一模型通用"基础模型，训练一次即可直接应用于多样属性图，无需针对特定图训练、微调或调参。
AI.motivation: 现有属性图聚类方法通常为每张图单独训练和调参，流程昂贵脆弱，且难以在不同特征空间、结构模式和属性-结构相关性的图之间迁移；无监督特性也使模型选择与适配困难。
AI.method: 基于Prior-data Fitted Networks，从潜聚类、节点属性和图结构的广泛先验下生成的合成属性图中学习可复用的聚类推理策略；采用维度无关的信号级图编码器，将每个特征通道视为图信号并建模其对共享图滤波器的响应；用超球聚类目标训练，推理时单次前向传播即得聚类友好的节点表示。
AI.result: 在十个数据集上，单个冻结的OFAG模型在NMI、ACC、ARI、F1上取得最佳平均性能和平均排名；全部十个数据集总耗时12.43分钟，比第二快基线快6倍以上，在聚类质量上比第二好方法快近28倍。
AI.conclusion: OFAG可作为一个冻结的基础模型直接应用于任意属性图数据集，无需额外训练或调参，兼顾精度与效率；代码与预训练检查点已开源。

title: Align, Then Correct: Training-Free Two-Stage Low-Rank Compensation for Extremely Quantized Large Language Models
summary: Low-rank quantization error compensation (LQEC) recovers the accuracy lost under aggressive weight quantization by attaching a closed-form rank-$r$ adapter beside each frozen quantized weight, without any training. We show that existing compensators are limited by two shared simplifications. They calibrate symmetrically, evaluating the full-precision and compensated weights on the same activation, which yields a compensation target that is inherently high-rank -- so a fixed rank budget captures only a small fraction of it. And they minimize only the second-order term of the loss, although the compensated model is not stationary: a first-order descent direction larger than the applied compensation itself remains in every layer, and no reconstruction objective can absorb it. We propose a two-stage closed-form framework that removes both simplifications. Stage 1 aligns each layer's output with the full-precision model under a Fisher-weighted asymmetric objective, concentrating the rank budget on a rank-compressible target. Stage 2 re-measures statistics on the compensated model and applies a rank-constrained natural-gradient step that absorbs the remaining first-order signal. Every adapter is the result of a single truncated SVD; backward passes serve only to collect statistics. At 2 bits under QuIP#, our method reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 12.43 to 10.26 on Qwen3-8B and from 21.11 to 13.22 on Qwen3-4B. On the held-out C4 corpus, it recovers 51% and 84% of the gap to FP16, versus 31% and 63% for the strongest baseline, with consistent gains in the seven-task zero-shot average, at higher bit-widths, and under a distinct quantizer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两阶段闭式低秩量化误差补偿(LQEC)框架，去除对称校准与仅优化二阶项的简化，无需训练即可在极端量化下大幅恢复精度。
AI.motivation: 现有低秩补偿器存在两点共同简化：一是采用对称校准，在相同激活上评估全精度与补偿后权重，导致补偿目标本身是高秩的，固定秩预算只能捕获一小部分；二是仅最小化损失的二阶项，但补偿后模型非平稳，每层仍留有比补偿本身更大的first-order下降方向，重构目标无法吸收。
AI.method: 两阶段闭式框架：阶段1在Fisher加权非对称目标下对齐每层输出与全精度模型，将秩预算集中于可压缩的补偿目标；阶段2在补偿后模型上重新测量统计量，施加秩约束的自然梯度步以吸收剩余的一阶信号。每个适配器均由一次截断SVD得到，反向传播仅用于收集统计量。
AI.result: 在QuIP# 2bit下，Qwen3-8B的WikiText-2困惑度从12.43降至10.26，Qwen3-4B从21.11降至13.22；在留出C4语料上分别恢复51%和84%的FP16差距（最强基线为31%和63%）；七任务零样本平均、更高位宽及不同量化器下均有一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 去除对称校准与二阶优化简化后，所提两阶段闭式框架在无需训练的情况下显著提升激进权重量化的精度恢复能力，且具有跨模型、跨任务、跨位宽与跨量化器的泛化性。

title: DSV-Mem: Evaluating Multimodal Memory in Professional Workflows for MLLM Agents
summary: Conversational MLLM agents are increasingly expected to assist in professional workflows, from AI research and engineering design to product management and business operations. Yet this capability remains underexplored: existing benchmarks largely focus on informal, everyday interactions and personal-life scenarios featuring photographic natural images, isolated static artifacts, and recall-oriented questions. In contrast, professional scenarios often involve structured, information-heavy artifacts that undergo frequent revisions and authority updates, and compositional queries requiring reconciliation of many artifact versions while tracking state precisely. To address these challenges, we introduce DSV-Mem, a benchmark for evaluating Dense Stateful Visual Memory. DSV-Mem comprises expert-reviewed scenarios and 1,000 questions across five user-oriented categories (Current State, Past State, Derived State, Change History, and Conflict/Refusal). A Hartley-inspired criterion favors questions with broader visual-evidence inspection demands. We also introduce a generation harness that produces evaluation suites by decoupling state-transition synthesis from conversation filling. Evaluation over 27 configurations spanning frontier and open-weight models and memory management methods reveals that the strongest baseline scores below 45% on DSV-Mem. Analysis surfaces findings: 1) multimodality and information density both contribute to difficulty, but state evolution, particularly the number of governing updates, is the dominant tested factor. Raw conversation/haystack length, OCR, and arithmetic are not the primary bottlenecks; 2) models often fail to verify user premises against prior state updates before answering; 3) increased reasoning effort and memory management methods yield limited gains, whereas state-aware designs prove more effective. The benchmark and code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出 DSV-Mem 基准，评估对话式 MLLM 智能体在专业场景下的"密集有状态视觉记忆"能力，最强基线得分不足 45%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多聚焦非正式日常交互与个人生活场景，使用自然照片、孤立静态artifact和回忆型问题；而专业场景涉及结构化、信息密集、频繁修订与权限更新的artifact，以及需精确追踪状态的组合式查询，这些能力尚未被充分评估。
AI.method: 构建 DSV-Mem 基准，包含专家审校的场景与 1000 道问题，覆盖五类面向用户的类别（当前状态、过去状态、派生状态、变更历史、冲突/拒答）；采用 Hartley 启发式准则偏好需要更广泛视觉证据审查的问题；并设计生成框架，将状态转移合成与对话填充解耦以生成评测套件。评测 27 种配置，涵盖前沿与开源权重模型及记忆管理方法。
AI.result: 最强基线在 DSV-Mem 上得分低于 45%。关键发现：1) 多模态性与信息密度均增加难度，但状态演化（尤其主导性更新的数量）是主导因素；原始对话/长文本长度、OCR、算术并非主要瓶颈；2) 模型常在回答前未能对照先前状态更新验证用户前提；3) 增加推理努力与记忆管理方法收益有限，状态感知设计更有效。
AI.conclusion: 专业工作流中的有状态视觉记忆仍是 MLLM 智能体的重大挑战，状态演化追踪是关键瓶颈；需发展状态感知的设计方法。基准与代码将公开发布。

title: CoDe-LoRA: Mitigating the Orthogonality Dilemma in Continual Learning of LLMs via Knowledge Consolidation and Decoupling
summary: Continual learning (CL) is essential for Large Language Models (LLMs) to sequentially adapt to evolving tasks. To mitigate catastrophic forgetting, recent advances implement low-rank adaptation with orthogonal projections (e.g., O-LoRA) to isolate task parameters. However, we reveal that such strict geometric constraints trigger an "Orthogonality Dilemma": rigid parameter isolation impedes the transfer and accumulation of shared representations across semantically related tasks. In this work, we propose a new replay-free method, called Consolidation and Decoupling LoRA (CoDe-LoRA), for CL of LLMs. CoDe-LoRA disentangles the learning process into Consolidating Universal Knowledge and Decoupling Task-Specific Knowledge. To achieve this, CoDe-LoRA leverages an adaptive null space projection mechanism and semantic routing to balance knowledge accumulation with task-specific adaptation. Experimental results across four backbones and three CL benchmarks show that CoDe-LoRA achieves the best average accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/Estrellajer/CoDe-LoRA.

AI.tldr: 提出无回放的CoDe-LoRA方法，通过解耦通用知识整合与任务特定知识分离，缓解正交投影带来的"正交性困境"，在持续学习中取得最佳平均准确率。
AI.motivation: LLM持续学习需顺序适应演变任务，现有低秩适配加正交投影（如O-LoRA）虽能缓解灾难性遗忘，但严格几何约束导致"正交性困境"：刚性参数隔离阻碍语义相关任务间共享表征的迁移与累积。
AI.method: 提出CoDe-LoRA（Consolidation and Decoupling LoRA），将学习过程解耦为"整合通用知识"和"分离任务特定知识"，并利用自适应零空间投影机制与语义路由，平衡知识累积与任务特定适配。
AI.result: 在4个骨干模型和3个持续学习基准上，CoDe-LoRA取得最佳平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: CoDe-LoRA为LLM持续学习提供了一种无回放的有效方案，缓解正交性困境，兼顾知识共享与任务适配，代码已开源。

title: ChartBmkAgent: Harness-Governed Multi-Agent Construction of Chart QA Benchmarks from Sparse Error-Taxonomy Specifications
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance rapidly, while conventional benchmark development lags behind, delaying investigation of newly observed capability gaps. Such investigation requires an expressive task format and an on-demand construction process: information-rich charts make chart question answering (Chart QA) suitable for probing coupled perception and reasoning. Automated Chart QA construction is intended to shorten the benchmark-development cycle by turning identified gaps into targeted samples on demand. Current methods, however, commonly separate target guidance from scratch generation: target-guided systems often require prepared data, charts, or templates, while scratch-generation systems primarily ensure artifact validity, without explicitly controlling whether newly synthesized requirements and content remain aligned with an externally specified diagnostic target. We introduce ChartBmkAgent, which turns an identified capability gap into targeted diagnostic evidence by constructing complete Chart QA samples from sparse error-taxonomy specifications. Throughout construction, a central harness governs specialized agents, requires stage-specific evidence of alignment with the original error category, and records the basis for each acceptance decision. On 300 taxonomy-wide samples, MLLM accuracies ranged from 32.7% to 84.3% with distinct category profiles, showing that generated samples reveal capability differences. Across three source-model comparisons, targeted follow-ups scored 50.0% versus 82.2% on matched controls ($p=8.96\times10^{-6}$); all six cross-model comparisons had the same direction, demonstrating targeted validation and diagnostic-data generation. Multiple evaluator models assessed whether each sample tested its specified error category; 86.4% met this criterion, providing empirical evidence of target preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出 ChartBmkAgent，从稀疏的错误分类规范出发自动构建针对性 Chart QA 诊断样本，验证了其目标保持性与诊断有效性。
AI.motivation: MLLM 发展迅速而基准滞后，难以及时探查新出现的能力缺口。Chart QA 适合探测耦合的感知与推理，但现有自动化构建方法将目标引导与从零生成割裂：引导式需预置数据/模板，生成式只保证样本有效性，无法确保新合成内容与外部诊断目标对齐。
AI.method: ChartBmkAgent 将识别出的能力缺口转化为诊断证据，从稀疏错误分类规范构建完整 Chart QA 样本。构建过程中由中央控制器（harness）调度专用智能体，要求各阶段提供与原始错误类别对齐的证据，并记录每次接受决策的依据。
AI.result: 在 300 个全分类样本上，MLLM 准确率从 32.7% 到 84.3%，呈现不同类别画像；三次源模型对比中，针对性后续样本得分 50.0% vs 匹配对照 82.2%（p=8.96e-6），六次跨模型对比方向一致；多评估模型判定 86.4% 的样本确实测试了其指定错误类别。
AI.conclusion: ChartBmkAgent 实现了按需的针对性验证与诊断数据生成，验证了目标保持性，为缩短基准开发周期、探查 MLLM 能力缺口提供了可行方案。

title: ServeLearnBench: How Well Can Agents Self-Improve from Serving Experience?
summary: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed to perform complex tasks in real-world environments. However, the knowledge required for correct behavior in these environments is often implicit, undisclosed, and subject to change over time. Recent continual-learning harnesses seek to address this challenge by enabling agents to improve from serving experience. Yet the effectiveness and limitations of these methods are not yet well characterized. Existing benchmarks provide only partial coverage: some explicitly provide the target knowledge, others assume a static environment, and those that support continual adaptation remain limited in scale and knowledge diversity. To enable systematic evaluation, we formalize an evolving-environment streaming dataset (EESD), in which agents must infer, apply, and revise latent environment knowledge from interaction and outcome feedback as hidden policies evolve, and introduce ServeLearnBench, spanning retail support, banking, and sales-pitch generation with 53 environment windows and 7,718 tasks. We evaluate five learning harnesses (RAG, Mem0, SkillOpt, Continual Harness, and Prime) across six models (GPT-5.6 Terra, Opus 5, Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and GLM-5.3 Flash), covering 28 model-harness pairs and 252 learning runs. Our evaluation reveals three main findings: a substantial gap remains between task capability and learning from experience; continual adaptation is costly and can degrade already-correct behavior; and insufficient exploration emerges as a key bottleneck to effective adaptation. Overall, ServeLearnBench provides a controlled testbed for diagnosing these limitations and tracking progress toward agents that continually and reliably improve through serving experience.

AI.tldr: 提出ServeLearnBench基准及演进环境流式数据(EESD)，覆盖零售、银行、销售场景(53个环境窗口、7718任务)，评测5种学习框架×6个模型共252次运行，揭示经验学习的三大局限。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在真实环境中依赖隐含、未公开且随时间变化的知识；现有基准要么直接给出目标知识，要么假设静态环境，或规模与知识多样性有限，无法系统刻画持续学习方法的有效性与局限。
AI.method: 形式化演进环境流式数据集EESD，要求智能体从交互与结果反馈中推断、应用并修正潜在环境知识(隐藏策略随时间演化)；构建ServeLearnBench，涵盖零售支持、银行、销售话术生成三类场景，共53个环境窗口、7718个任务；评测RAG、Mem0、SkillOpt、Continual Harness、Prime五种学习框架与GPT-5.6 Terra、Opus 5、Kimi K3、GLM-5.3、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、GLM-5.3 Flash六个模型，共28个模型-框架组合、252次学习运行。
AI.result: 发现三个核心结论：(1)任务能力与"从经验中学习"之间存在显著差距；(2)持续适应成本高，且可能破坏原本已正确的行为；(3)探索不足是有效适应的关键瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: ServeLearnBench为诊断这些局限、追踪智能体通过服务经验持续可靠改进的进展提供了可控测试平台。

title: Toward Alignment Scaling Laws: A Framework and First Preregistered Measurements
comment: 34 pages, 24 figures, 8 tables. Games: https://www.aisafety.fun. Preregistrations: https://osf.io/wda8q, https://osf.io/q2j3y, https://osf.io/8kreb
summary: Whether alignment gets easier or harder as models grow is often argued from isolated findings, as if alignment were one property. We treat it as a family of measurable scaling relations: for each risk category r, the alignment burden needed to hold a fixed safety target is modeled as B_r(N)=a_rN^alpha_r, with N a capability proxy; against a budget proportional to N, scaling helps if alpha_r<1, keeps pace if alpha_r~1, and accumulates alignment debt if alpha_r>1. We give three operationalizations of burden and distinguish observed, audited and true alignment. A toy model, in which corrections consume capability headroom, makes the consequences explicit. We prove that the largest exponent among corrected risks, not an average, sets the long-run regime; that above 1 any policy holding headroom above a floor must grow super-exponentially; that, for burdens that are positive mixtures of power laws, fits on small models underestimate large-scale exponents; and that an audit that uncovers hidden failures without false positives never underestimates true alignment. We propose a pre-registrable protocol and apply reduced versions of it twice. A preregistered reanalysis of public adversarial-training data for Pythia classifiers finds that the compute needed to bring attack success under 10% grows as N^0.60. A preregistered pilot on Qwen2.5 0.5B-72B finds exponents of -0.05 for truthfulness and 0.48 for stated dispositions (both scaling helps under its reduced rule, though local slopes approach 1 at the top; replicated on Qwen3 0.6B-14B), while sycophancy (0.89, or 0.83 with two seeds added at 72B) and a planted backdoor are undetermined: the backdoor is removed quickly when its trigger is known but survives blind safety training at four of five sizes. We release four browser games that play these laws (www.aisafety.fun). We make no claim about which regime holds for current frontier models.

AI.tldr: 将AI对齐建模为一系列可测量的缩放关系：对每个风险类别r，维持固定安全目标所需的对齐负担为B_r(N)=a_rN^alpha_r（N为能力代理）。若alpha_r<1则缩放有益，alpha_r~1则持平，alpha_r>1则累积"对齐债务"。论文区分观测、审计与真实对齐，证明长期由最大指数决定，并给出两个预注册实验：Pythia对抗训练数据重分析得0.60；Qwen2.5/Qwen3试点得真实度-0.05、陈述倾向0.48、谄媚0.89（未定），后门在盲安全训练下5个规模中4个存活。
AI.motivation: 现有关于"模型变大后对齐是变易还是变难"的争论多基于孤立发现，好像对齐是单一属性。作者主张把对齐视为一族可测量的缩放关系，从而以定量、可预注册的方式刻画不同风险类别随能力增长的对齐负担，并用统一框架厘清观察对齐、审计对齐与真实对齐的区别。
AI.method: 提出负担的三种可操作化，区分观测/审计/真实对齐；建立模型：修正消耗能力余量。理论分析给出四条命题（最大指数定长期机制、超1时须超指数增长、幂律混合导致小模型拟合低估、无假阳审计不低估真实对齐）。提出可预注册协议，并做两次缩减版应用：(1)对Pythia分类器公开对抗训练数据的预注册重分析；(2)对Qwen2.5 0.5B-72B的预注册试点（复现于Qwen3 0.6B-14B），含后门触发已知/盲测比较。
AI.result: Pythia对抗训练：将攻击成功率降到10%以下所需计算量按N^0.60增长。Qwen2.5：真实度指数-0.05、陈述倾向0.48（二者在缩减规则下缩放有益，但顶部局部斜率趋近1），复现于Qwen3；谄媚0.89（72B加两seed为0.83）与植入后门未定——后门在触发已知时被快速移除，但在盲安全训练下五个规模中四个存活。发布四款浏览器游戏展示这些规律。
AI.conclusion: 对齐不是单一属性，而是一族按风险类别不同的缩放关系；长期机制由已修正风险中最大指数决定。多数测得的风险指数小于1表明缩放有益，但谄媚接近1、后门难以盲除提示部分风险仍存隐忧。作者不对当前前沿模型属于哪种机制作任何主张，并强调预注册协议与可复现工具的价值。

title: Test-Time Agent Evolution for Long-Horizon Legal Reasoning
summary: Legal intelligence aims to support reliable decision-making across long-horizon legal processes involving evolving case states and multiple roles. However, real-world legal deployment exhibits substantial case heterogeneity in facts, evidence, and procedural contexts, exposing the limitations of static agent strategies. Moreover, legal reasoning is inherently interdependent across roles and procedural stages, making global reliability fundamentally different from isolated role competence. To address these challenges, we study training-free test-time agent adaptation, where agents continuously exploit deployment-time signals from preceding cases and ongoing interactions without updating model parameters. We propose \method, which introduces \emph{Test-Time Memory Evolution} to retrieve reusable experience from previous cases, adapt it to the current factual and procedural context, and consolidate accumulated experience for subsequent decision-making. Further, \emph{Rubric-Aligned Collaboration} verifies and revises role-specific actions according to behavioral and procedural requirements, enabling coordinated decision-making across roles and stages. Extensive experiments on J1-EVAL and LegalWorld across five backbone models demonstrate consistent improvements over representative reasoning and agent baselines with reasonable interaction and computational costs. Ablation and case studies further show that the two components provide complementary benefits in experience adaptation and cross-role coordination, improving the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon legal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出训练免费的测试时智能体自适应框架，含测试时记忆演化与准则对齐协作两模块，在J1-EVAL和LegalWorld上提升长程法律推理可靠性。
AI.motivation: 法律部署存在案件异质性（事实、证据、程序背景各异），静态智能体策略失效；且法律推理在角色与程序阶段间相互依赖，全局可靠性与单一角色能力不同。
AI.method: 研究免训练测试时智能体自适应：智能体利用前序案件与交互的部署信号而不更新参数。提出方法含(1)测试时记忆演化：检索过往案件的可复用经验、适配当前事实与程序情境并巩固积累的经验；(2)准则对齐协作：依据行为与程序要求校验修订角色动作，实现跨角色与阶段协同决策。
AI.result: 在J1-EVAL与LegalWorld、五种骨干模型上，一致优于代表性推理与智能体基线，交互与计算成本合理；消融与案例研究显示两模块在经验适配与跨角色协同上互补。
AI.conclusion: 两大组件协同提升长程法律推理的可靠性与效率，验证测试时自适应在真实法律部署中的有效性。

title: The Geometry of Empowerment
summary: Empowerment captures the capacity for an agent to actively control its environment. While conceptually appealing as an information-theoretic quantity, the connection between empowerment and structurally central states that provide broad access to future outcomes has remained an open question. In this work, we link empowerment maximization and skill-learning methods to provide new geometries for interpreting and analyzing empowerment. Our analyses answer longstanding open questions on the connections between empowerment and structural centrality. Our analyses also reveal distinctions between information and reward geometries, highlighting important theoretical implications to build scalable empowerment-maximization methods. Website and code can be found at https://empowerment-geometry.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文将赋权(empowerment)最大化与技能学习方法相链接，提出新的几何视角来解释和分析赋权，回答了赋权与结构中心性之间长期悬而未决的问题，并揭示了信息几何与奖励几何的区别。
AI.motivation: 赋权作为信息论量度颇具吸引力，但其与"提供广泛未来结果访问的结构中心状态"之间的联系仍是开放问题。作者希望阐明这一联系，并为构建可扩展的赋权最大化方法提供理论基础。
AI.method: 将赋权最大化与技能学习(skill-learning)方法相链接，构建新的几何框架来解读和分析赋权；通过该几何分析考察赋权与结构中心性之间的关系，并对比信息几何与奖励几何。
AI.result: 分析回答了赋权与结构中心性之间长期存在的开放问题，并揭示出信息几何与奖励几何之间的差异，指出这些差异对构建可扩展赋权最大化方法具有重要理论意义。
AI.conclusion: 赋权可用技能学习带来的新几何视角统一理解，其与结构中心性存在明确联系，且信息几何与奖励几何需加以区分，为可扩展赋权最大化方法奠定理论基础。

title: DeltaTTT: Layerwise Optimization for Nonlinear Recurrent Memory
summary: Sequential test-time training adapts a memory network through successive updates, each computing an inner-loop gradient based on the network's previous state. Intuitively, this state dependence should allow each update to account for what the memory has already learned and better incorporate new information. However, we find that this expected advantage does not consistently materialize in nonlinear memories: a fixed-base parallel TTT baseline outperforms its serial counterpart. Our exploratory experiments point to a key underlying difficulty: nonlinear memories can be harder to optimize than linear ones within a single pass over the sequence. To alleviate this optimization difficulty, we introduce DeltaTTT, which replaces joint inner-loop optimization of a two-layer memory network with layerwise learning. Each layer is assigned a local prediction target and updated through a state-dependent delta rule. This formulation retains a nonlinear readout while enabling chunkwise parallel computation. Experiments on DeltaNet and LaCT backbones show improvements in language modeling and retrieval over their recurrent baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出DeltaTTT，用逐层学习替换两层记忆网络的联合内循环优化，缓解非线性记忆的优化困难，兼顾非线性读出与分块并行计算。
AI.motivation: 序列式测试时训练（TTT）理论上应利用状态依赖让每次更新考虑已学内容并更好纳入新信息，但在非线性记忆中这一优势并未稳定出现：固定基座的并行TTT基线反而优于串行版本。实验表明核心困难在于非线性记忆在单次遍历序列时比线性记忆更难优化。
AI.method: DeltaTTT将两层记忆网络的联合内循环优化替换为逐层学习，每层分配局部预测目标，并通过状态依赖的delta规则更新；该形式保留非线性读出，同时支持分块并行计算。
AI.result: 在DeltaNet和LaCT骨干上，DeltaTTT相比各自循环基线在语言建模和检索任务上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 逐层学习是缓解非线性记忆单遍优化困难的有效途径，DeltaTTT在保持非线性表达能力与并行效率的同时提升了性能。

title: Partially Observable Zero-shot coordination by Predicting Intention of Partner
summary: Zero-shot coordination in embodied settings requires acting while the partner is intermittently out of view, leaving existing methods with ambiguous partner representations and uncertainty over hidden partner states. We propose Predicting Intention of Partner (PIP) to jointly address these challenges. PIP uses a Joint-view VAE to distill richer training-time evidence from the union of both agents' local observations into a partner representation available from local observations alone. Partner-state Belief networks further infer the partner's hidden location and behavioral tendencies from the ego agent's interaction history. We evaluate PIP in Burrito-PO, Overcooked-PO, and a Melting Pot substrate, together with a human evaluation in Burrito-PO. PIP attains the highest mean performance among the compared methods across all three benchmarks. Human evaluation and diagnostic analyses further support coordination with unseen partners and the contributions of both components under partner occlusion.

AI.tldr: 提出PIP方法，通过联合视角VAE和伙伴状态信念网络解决具身零样本协作中伙伴间歇不可见的问题。
AI.motivation: 具身场景下的零样本协作要求在伙伴间歇离开视野时仍能行动，但现有方法面临伙伴表征模糊及隐藏状态不确定性的挑战。
AI.method: PIP包含两个组件：联合视角VAE（Joint-view VAE）从双方局部观测的并集中提取更丰富的训练期证据，蒸馏出仅用局部观测即可获得的伙伴表征；伙伴状态信念网络（Partner-state Belief networks）从自我智能体的交互历史推断伙伴的隐藏位置和行为倾向。
AI.result: 在Burrito-PO、Overcooked-PO及Melting Pot环境中评估，并在Burrito-PO进行人类评估；PIP在三个基准上均取得最高平均性能，人类评估与诊断分析支持其与未见伙伴的协作能力及两个组件在伙伴遮挡下的贡献。
AI.conclusion: PIP有效应对伙伴遮挡下的零样本协作，两组件均发挥重要作用，性能优于对比方法。

title: SquidAgent: Parallelize Wisely, Coordinate Efficiently
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 37 pages, including appendices
summary: LLM-based agents solve complex multi-step tasks, but sequential execution incurs substantial latency. In principle, parallelizing work across multiple agents should yield near-linear speedups. Yet existing parallel multi-agent systems often run slower than a single-agent baseline. We attribute this gap to two hidden costs that parallel execution incurs but a serial agent avoids.
